const shortHint = (g, fallback) =>
    SHORT_HINT[g.id] || shortAction(g) || fallback
const guideSentenceCase = (value) => {
    const raw = String(value || "").trim()
    if (!raw) return raw
    const letters = raw.match(/[A-Za-z]/g) || []
    const upper = raw.match(/[A-Z]/g) || []
    const mostlyCaps =
        letters.length > 0 && upper.length / letters.length >= 0.72
    const base = mostlyCaps ? raw.toLowerCase() : raw
    return base
        .replace(/^([a-z])/, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())
        .replace(/([.!?]\s+)([a-z])/g, (_, gap, c) => gap + c.toUpperCase())
}
function globalReleaseGuideText(game, value = 0, status = "", entries = []) {
    const v = pct(value)
    const action = guideSentenceCase(shortHint(game, game.action))
    const cleanStatus = guideSentenceCase(String(status || "").trim())
    if (Number(game?.id) === 105) {
        if (v >= 100) return "Complete · Drama cut ✓"
        if (cleanStatus && !/^\d+%\s/.test(cleanStatus))
            return `Next move · ${cleanStatus}`
        return "How to play · Tap MAKE IT DRAMATIC · Then CUT THE DRAMA"
    }
    const cue = dynamicReleaseActionCue(game, entries, Math.floor(v / 16))
    const emotionalTarget = guideSentenceCase(cue.target)
    const directional = cue.arrow ? `${cue.arrow} ` : ""
    if (v <= 0)
        return `How to play · ${directional}${action} · ${emotionalTarget}`
    if (v >= 100)
        return `Complete · ${releaseEmotionProfile(entries).finish[0]}`
    if (cleanStatus && !/^\d+%\s/.test(cleanStatus))
        return `Next move · ${directional}${cleanStatus} · ${emotionalTarget}`
    return `Next move · ${directional}${action} · ${emotionalTarget}${cleanStatus ? ` · ${cleanStatus}` : ""}`
}

function globalReleaseMindBendText(game) {
    const direct = RELEASE_MIND_BEND[Number(game?.id)]
    if (direct) return direct
    return "Move it. Change your relationship to it."
}
function splitGlobalGuideText(value) {
    const raw = String(value || "").trim()
    const divider = raw.indexOf("·")
    if (divider < 0) return { label: "Next move", copy: raw }
    return {
        label: raw.slice(0, divider).trim(),
        copy: raw.slice(divider + 1).trim(),
    }
}

const SESSION_KEY = "__ts_release_arcade_session_v2"
function readInfinitySession() {
    if (typeof window === "undefined")
        return { runs: 0, remixes: 0, history: [] }
    try {
        const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)
        const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null
        return {
            runs: Math.max(0, Number(parsed?.runs) || 0),
            remixes: Math.max(0, Number(parsed?.remixes) || 0),
            history: Array.isArray(parsed?.history)
                ? parsed.history
                      .filter((n) => Number.isFinite(Number(n)))
                      .map(Number)
                      .slice(-14)
                : [],
        }
    } catch {
        return { runs: 0, remixes: 0, history: [] }
    }
}
function writeInfinitySession(session) {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return
    try {
        window.sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(session))
    } catch {}
}
function noveltyNoise(id, salt) {
    const x = Math.sin((id + 1) * 12.9898 + (salt + 1) * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    return x - Math.floor(x)
}
function infinityChoices(current, history, played, salt, limit = 3) {
    const recent = history.slice(-7)
    const scored = GAMES.map((g) => {
        let score = noveltyNoise(g.id, salt) * 16
        if (!played.includes(g.id)) score += 72
        if (!recent.includes(g.id)) score += 38
        else score -= 120 - Math.max(0, recent.indexOf(g.id)) * 6
        if (current) {
            if (g.id === current.id) score -= 240
            if (g.family !== current.family) score += 46
            else score -= 18
            if (g.engine !== current.engine) score += 28
            else score -= 8
        }
        const familyRecent = recent
            .map((id) => GAMES.find((x) => x.id === id)?.family)
            .filter(Boolean)
        if (!familyRecent.includes(g.family)) score += 20
        return { g, score }
    }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    return scored.slice(0, Math.max(1, limit)).map((x) => x.g)
}
function pickInfinityGame(current, history, played, salt) {
    const picks = infinityChoices(current, history, played, salt, 5)
    if (!picks.length) return GAMES[0]
    const index = Math.floor(
        noveltyNoise((current?.id || 0) + salt, salt + 91) *
            Math.min(3, picks.length)
    )
    return picks[Math.max(0, Math.min(picks.length - 1, index))]
}

const MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES = 6
const MAX_TEXT_WORD_BUBBLES = 6
const MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES = 10
const MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES = 6
const IMAGE_ONLY_BUBBLE_SLOTS = 6
const MAX_WORD_QUEUE = 10
function clamp(n, a, b) {
    return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n))
}
function isImageOnlyEntries(entries = []) {
    const src = (entries || [])
        .map((x) => String(x || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    return src.length > 0 && src.every((x) => x === "UPLOADED IMAGE")
}
function imageOnlyBubbleCount(images = []) {
    const imageCount = (images || []).filter(Boolean).length
    return imageCount ? IMAGE_ONLY_BUBBLE_SLOTS : 0
}
function imageOnlyEntriesForUploads(images = []) {
    return Array.from(
        { length: imageOnlyBubbleCount(images) },
        () => "UPLOADED IMAGE"
    )
}
function normaliseImageOnlyEntries(entries = [], images = []) {
    const src = (entries || [])
        .map((x) => String(x || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    if (!(images || []).filter(Boolean).length) return src
    const hasTypedText = src.some((x) => x !== "UPLOADED IMAGE")
    if (hasTypedText) return src
    return imageOnlyEntriesForUploads(images)
}
function visibleBubbleSlots(entries = []) {
    return isImageOnlyEntries(entries)
        ? clamp(
              entries.length,
              MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
              MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
          )
        : MAX_TEXT_WORD_BUBBLES
}
function lsNum(k, d = 0) {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return d
    try {
        return Number(localStorage.getItem(k) || d) || d
    } catch {
        return d
    }
}
function lsJson(k, d) {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return d
    try {
        const v = localStorage.getItem(k)
        return v ? JSON.parse(v) : d
    } catch {
        return d
    }
}
function tokeniseWords(raw) {
    return raw
        .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
        .replace(/[\u201C\u201D]/g, '"')
        .replace(/[\u2013\u2014]/g, " ")
        .replace(/[\n\r\t]+/g, " ")
        .split(/\s+/)
        .map((s) => s.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((s) => s.replace(/^[^A-Za-z0-9']+|[^A-Za-z0-9'!?]+$/g, ""))
        .filter(Boolean)
}
function cleanEntries(raw) {
    {
        const eosEntries = EosEntries(raw)
        if (eosEntries) return eosEntries
    }
    const tokens = tokeniseWords(raw)
    if (!tokens.length) return []
    if (tokens.length < MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES) {
        return Array.from(
            { length: MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES },
            (_, i) => tokens[i % tokens.length]
        )
    }
    const bubbleCount =
        tokens.length === MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            ? MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            : MAX_TEXT_WORD_BUBBLES
    const base = Math.floor(tokens.length / bubbleCount)
    const extra = tokens.length % bubbleCount
    const groups = []
    let cursor = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < bubbleCount; i++) {
        const take = base + (i < extra ? 1 : 0)
        groups.push(tokens.slice(cursor, cursor + take).join(" "))
        cursor += take
    }
    return groups.filter(Boolean)
}
function displayText(s, maxChars = 24) {
    const value = String(s || "").trim()
    if (!value || value.toUpperCase() === "UPLOADED IMAGE") return ""
    const cap = clamp(Number(maxChars) || 24, 12, 28)
    return compactGamePreviewText(value, 3, cap)
}
function rainPreviewText(s, maxWords = 3, maxChars = 22) {
    const value = String(s || "").trim()
    if (!value || value.toUpperCase() === "UPLOADED IMAGE") return ""
    const tokens = value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    let preview = tokens.slice(0, maxWords).join(" ")
    if (preview.length > maxChars)
        preview = preview.slice(0, maxChars).trimEnd()
    const truncated = tokens.length > maxWords || preview.length < value.length
    preview = preview.replace(/[.,;:!?\-]+$/g, "").trim()
    return truncated && preview ? `${preview}…` : preview
}
function compactGamePreviewText(s, maxWords = 3, maxChars = 24) {
    const value = String(s || "").trim()
    if (!value || value.toUpperCase() === "UPLOADED IMAGE") return ""
    const tokens = value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    let preview = tokens.slice(0, maxWords).join(" ")
    if (preview.length > maxChars)
        preview = preview.slice(0, maxChars).trimEnd()
    const truncated = tokens.length > maxWords || preview.length < value.length
    preview = preview.replace(/[.,;:!?\-]+$/g, "").trim()
    return truncated && preview ? `${preview}…` : preview
}
function vibrate(ms = 18) {
    try {
        if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && "vibrate" in navigator)
            navigator.vibrate(ms)
    } catch {}
}
function useReducedMotion() {
    const [v, setV] = React.useState(false)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return
        const m = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)")
        const u = () => setV(m.matches)
        u()
        m.addEventListener?.("change", u)
        return () => m.removeEventListener?.("change", u)
    }, [])
    return v
}
function useSfx(enabled) {
    const ctx = React.useRef(null)
    return React.useCallback(
        (kind = "tap") => {
            if (!enabled || typeof window === "undefined") return
            try {
                const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext
                if (!AC) return
                const c = ctx.current || (ctx.current = new AC())
                if (c.state === "suspended") c.resume().catch(() => {})
                const now = c.currentTime
                const note = (
                    freq,
                    duration,
                    gainValue,
                    type = "sine",
                    delay = 0,
                    endFreq
                ) => {
                    const o = c.createOscillator()
                    const g = c.createGain()
                    const t = now + delay
                    o.type = type
                    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t)
                    if (endFreq && endFreq > 0)
                        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
                            endFreq,
                            t + duration
                        )
                    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
                    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(
                        Math.max(0.0002, gainValue),
                        t + Math.min(0.012, duration * 0.18)
                    )
                    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + duration)
                    o.connect(g)
                    g.connect(c.destination)
                    o.start(t)
                    o.stop(t + duration + 0.025)
                }
                if (typeof kind === "string" && kind.startsWith("tskey:")) {
                    const parts = kind.split(":")
                    const vibe = parts[1] || "clean"
                    const keyIndex = Math.max(
                        0,
                        Math.min(5, Number(parts[2]) || 0)
                    )
                    const cleanFreqs = [
                        261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 349.23, 392.0, 440.0,
                    ]
                    const f = cleanFreqs[keyIndex]
                    if (vibe === "silly") {
                        const sillyTypes = [
                            "triangle",
                            "square",
                            "triangle",
                            "square",
                            "sine",
                            "triangle",
                        ]
                        note(
                            f * (keyIndex % 2 ? 1.5 : 1.25),
                            0.16,
                            0.04,
                            sillyTypes[keyIndex],
                            0,
                            f * 0.78
                        )
                        note(f * 2.02, 0.09, 0.014, "sine", 0.028, f * 1.55)
                    } else {
                        note(f, 0.28, 0.036, "sine")
                        note(f * 2, 0.22, 0.012, "triangle", 0.015)
                    }
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "chime") {
                    note(659.25, 0.34, 0.04, "sine")
                    note(987.77, 0.42, 0.026, "sine", 0.055)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "bell") {
                    note(523.25, 0.55, 0.038, "sine")
                    note(1046.5, 0.42, 0.019, "sine", 0.008)
                    note(1567.98, 0.3, 0.009, "triangle", 0.012)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "plink") {
                    note(783.99, 0.13, 0.046, "triangle", 0, 620)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "clack") {
                    note(185, 0.075, 0.045, "square", 0, 82)
                    note(310, 0.045, 0.02, "triangle", 0.008, 120)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "hum") {
                    note(196, 0.46, 0.026, "sine")
                    note(294, 0.46, 0.012, "sine", 0.005)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "spark") {
                    note(880, 0.09, 0.032, "triangle")
                    note(1318.51, 0.11, 0.026, "sine", 0.035)
                    note(1760, 0.12, 0.018, "sine", 0.07)
                    return
                }
                if (kind === "tone") {
                    note(440, 0.32, 0.034, "sine")
                    return
                }
                const cfg =
                    kind === "pop"
                        ? [170, 0.08, 0.055]
                        : kind === "win"
                          ? [520, 0.22, 0.04]
                          : kind === "soft"
                            ? [240, 0.12, 0.025]
                            : [320, 0.05, 0.025]
                note(
                    cfg[0],
                    cfg[1],
                    cfg[2],
                    kind === "win" ? "sine" : "triangle",
                    0,
                    kind === "pop" ? 75 : kind === "win" ? 780 : undefined
                )
            } catch {}
        },
        [enabled]
    )
}
function useRainSfx(enabled) {
    const ctx = React.useRef(null)
    const active = React.useRef(null)
    return React.useCallback(
        (duration = 3.15) => {
            if (!enabled || typeof window === "undefined") return
            try {
                const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext
                if (!AC) return
                const c = ctx.current || (ctx.current = new AC())
                if (c.state === "suspended") c.resume().catch(() => {})
                try {
                    active.current?.stop()
                } catch {}
                const length = Math.max(1, Math.floor(c.sampleRate * duration))
                const buffer = c.createBuffer(1, length, c.sampleRate)
                const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
                let brown = 0
                for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
                    const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1
                    brown = brown * 0.965 + white * 0.035
                    data[i] = (white * 0.34 + brown * 1.55) * 0.42
                }
                const source = c.createBufferSource()
                source.buffer = buffer
                const hp = c.createBiquadFilter()
                hp.type = "highpass"
                hp.frequency.value = 260
                const lp = c.createBiquadFilter()
                lp.type = "lowpass"
                lp.frequency.value = 7200
                const gain = c.createGain()
                const now = c.currentTime
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now)
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.075, now + 0.14)
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(
                    0.075,
                    now + Math.max(0.18, duration - 0.45)
                )
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration)
                source.connect(hp)
                hp.connect(lp)
                lp.connect(gain)
                gain.connect(c.destination)
                source.start(now)
                source.stop(now + duration + 0.02)
                active.current = source
            } catch {}
        },
        [enabled]
    )
}
function useSharedMusic(on, volume, bubble) {
    const audio = React.useRef(null)
    const [media, setMedia] = React.useState({})
    const read = React.useCallback(() => {
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return
        try {
            setMedia(
                JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RESET_SHARED_MEDIA_KEY) || "{}")
            )
        } catch {
            setMedia({})
        }
    }, [])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        read()
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return
        const f = () => read()
        window.addEventListener("storage", f)
        window.addEventListener("thinkstill:reset-shared-media", f)
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("storage", f)
            window.removeEventListener("thinkstill:reset-shared-media", f)
        }
    }, [read])
    const url = String(media?.music?.[bubble] || media?.music?.global || "")
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return
        if (!audio.current) {
            audio.current = new Audio()
            audio.current.loop = true
            audio.current.preload = "auto"
        }
        const a = audio.current
        a.volume = clamp(volume, 0, 1)
        if (url && a.src !== url) a.src = url
        if (on && url) a.play().catch(() => {})
        else a.pause()
        return () => {}
    }, [on, url, volume])
    return !!url
}

}
function CinematicStageFX({ game, progress, reduced }) {
    const family = (game.family || "release")
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    const energy = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(1, progress / 100))
    return (
        <div
            className={`cinematicStageFX fx-${family} fx-${game.engine.toLowerCase()}`}
            style={{
                ["--energy"]: energy,
                ["--bloom"]: 0.08 + energy * 0.12,
                ["--bloom2"]: 0.12 + energy * 0.18,
                ["--beam"]: 0.035 + energy * 0.04,
            }}
            aria-hidden="true"
        >
            <div className="cinemaVignette" />
            <div className="cinemaBloom b1" />
            <div className="cinemaBloom b2" />
            <div className="cinemaBeam beam1" />
            <div className="cinemaBeam beam2" />
            {!reduced ? (
                <div className="cinemaDust">
                    {Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => (
                        <i
                            key={i}
                            style={{
                                ["--d"]: i,
                                left: 6 + ((i * 37) % 88) + "%",
                                top: 7 + ((i * 53) % 80) + "%",
                                animationDuration: 5.5 + i * 0.31 + "s",
                                animationDelay: i * -0.43 + "s",
                            }}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="cinemaGrain" />
            <div className="cinemaLetterbox top" />
            <div className="cinemaLetterbox bottom" />
        </div>
    )
}

function bubbleCharacterFromEmotionSrc(src) {
    const match = String(src || "").match(
        /(?:^|\/)(glitch|drop|still|patch|loopie|rush|sync)_E(\d{1,3})\.webp(?:[?#].*)?$/i
    )
    if (!match) return null
    const slug = match[1].toLowerCase()
    const mood = Number(match[2])
    const positiveBank = RELEASE_PHASE_EMOTIONS.positive[slug] || []
    return {
        slug,
        mood,
        happy: positiveBank.includes(mood),
        profile: BUBBLE_BOND_PROFILE[slug],
    }
}
function releaseReactionSalt(value) {
    const s = String(value || "")
    let h = 2166136261
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
        h ^= s.charCodeAt(i)
        h = Math.imul(h, 16777619)
    }
    return h >>> 0
}

function releaseReactionTag(phase, bubble, mood) {
    return (
        RELEASE_REACTION_TAGS?.[phase]?.[bubble]?.[mood] ||
        `${phase}-${bubble}-${mood}`
    )
}
function releaseEmotionSet(
    game,
    positiveFlags = false,
    count = MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
    sessionSeed = 0,
    reactionEpoch = 0,
    inputEntries = []
) {
    const family = game?.family || "Release"
    const baseOrder = [
        ...new Set([...(FAMILY_BUBBLES[family] || []), ...ALL_BUBBLES]),
    ]
    const profileId = releaseEmotionProfile(inputEntries).id
    const profileSalt = releaseReactionSalt(profileId)
    const gameId = Math.abs(Number(game?.id) || 0)
    const shuffleSeed =
        (Number(sessionSeed) || 0) ^
        Math.imul(gameId + 1, 0x45d9f3b) ^
        Math.imul(profileSalt + 1, 0x27d4eb2d)
    const order = [...baseOrder]
        .map((bubble, idx) => ({
            bubble,
            sortKey: releaseReactionSalt(
                `${family}:${bubble}:${shuffleSeed}:${idx}`
            ),
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => a.sortKey - b.sortKey)
        .map((item) => item.bubble)
    const start =
        (gameId + (Number(sessionSeed) || 0) + profileSalt) %
        Math.max(1, order.length)
    const occurrences = {}
    const usedTags = new Map()
    const usedSources = new Set()
    let previousTag = ""
    return Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, count) }, (_, i) => {
        const bubble = order[(start + i) % order.length]
        const occurrence = occurrences[bubble] || 0
        occurrences[bubble] = occurrence + 1
        const positive = Array.isArray(positiveFlags)
            ? !!positiveFlags[i]
            : !!positiveFlags
        const phase = positive ? "positive" : "negative"
        const bank = RELEASE_PHASE_EMOTIONS[phase][bubble] || [1]
        const base = Math.abs(
            Math.imul(gameId + 17, 31) +
                Math.imul(Number(sessionSeed) || 0, 7) +
                Math.imul(profileSalt, 3) +
                Math.imul(i + 1, 13) +
                Math.imul(occurrence + 1, 19) +
                Math.imul(Math.max(0, reactionEpoch) + 1, 23)
        )
        let chosenMood = bank[base % bank.length]
        let chosenTag = releaseReactionTag(phase, bubble, chosenMood)
        let chosenSrc = emotionSrc(bubble, chosenMood)
        let bestScore = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
        for (let offset = 0; offset < bank.length; offset++) {
            const mood = bank[(base + offset) % bank.length]
            const tag = releaseReactionTag(phase, bubble, mood)
            const candidateSrc = emotionSrc(bubble, mood)
            const used = usedTags.get(tag) || 0
            const exactRepeatPenalty = usedSources.has(candidateSrc) ? 10000 : 0
            const score =
                exactRepeatPenalty +
                used * 100 +
                (tag === previousTag ? 45 : 0) +
                offset +
                ((reactionEpoch + i + offset) % 3) * 0.01
            if (score < bestScore) {
                bestScore = score
                chosenMood = mood
                chosenTag = tag
                chosenSrc = candidateSrc
            }
        }
        usedSources.add(chosenSrc)
        usedTags.set(chosenTag, (usedTags.get(chosenTag) || 0) + 1)
        previousTag = chosenTag
        return chosenSrc
    })
}
const GLOBAL_EMOTION_POOL = Array.from(
    new Set(Object.values(FAMILY_EMOTIONS).flat())
)
const BUBBLE_ANIMATION_BANK = Array.from(
    { length: BUBBLE_ANIMATION_VARIANT_COUNT },
    (_, seed) => ({
        mode: seed % 12,
        dir: seed % 2 ? 1 : -1,
        spanX: 14 + ((seed * 7) % 42),
        spanY: 9 + ((seed * 5) % 30),
        rebound: 3 + ((seed * 3) % 14),
        tilt: 5 + ((seed * 11) % 24),
        swell: 0.05 + ((seed * 13) % 16) / 100,
        pulse: 0.14 + ((seed * 17) % 22) / 100,
        duration: 6.4 + (seed % 12) * 0.28,
        delay: (seed % 7) * 0.12,
        phase: (seed % 6) * 0.07,
        spiral: 12 + ((seed * 19) % 54),
        blurPulse: 0.03 + ((seed * 23) % 12) / 100,
    })
)
function useEmotionSecond() {
    const [tick, setTick] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const id = window.setInterval(
            () => setTick((v) => (v + 1) % 100000),
            4200
        )
        return () => window.clearInterval(id)
    }, [])
    return tick
}
function bubbleAnim(seed, intensity = 1, focus = false, baseOpacity = 0.32) {
    const p =
            BUBBLE_ANIMATION_BANK[
                Math.abs(seed) % BUBBLE_ANIMATION_BANK.length
            ],
        sx = p.spanX * intensity,
        sy = p.spanY * intensity,
        d = p.dir,
        t = p.tilt
    let x = [],
        y = [],
        rotate = [],
        scale = []
    switch (p.mode) {
        case 0:
            x = [0, d * sx, d * sx * 0.25, -d * sx * 0.3, 0]
            y = [0, -sy, -sy * 0.2, -sy * 0.7, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t, -d * t * 0.5, d * t * 0.22, 0]
            scale = [0.9, 1 + p.swell, 1, 0.96, 1]
            break
        case 1:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.35, -d * sx * 0.32, d * sx * 0.18, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.35, -sy, sy * 0.15, 0]
            rotate = [-d * t * 0.3, d * t, -d * t, d * t * 0.4, 0]
            scale = [0.88, 1.12, 0.94, 1.06, 1]
            break
        case 2:
            x = [0, d * sx, -d * sx * 0.8, d * sx * 0.55, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.25, -sy * 0.65, -sy * 0.1, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t * 0.45, -d * t * 0.8, d * t, 0]
            scale = [0.92, 1.04, 0.98, 1.08, 1]
            break
        case 3:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.18, d * sx * 0.5, d * sx * 0.08, 0]
            y = [0, sy * 0.25, -sy * 0.75, -sy * 0.12, 0]
            rotate = [0, -d * t, d * t * 0.55, -d * t * 0.25, 0]
            scale = [0.82, 1.16, 0.9, 1.04, 1]
            break
        case 4:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.65, d * sx, -d * sx * 0.15, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.85, sy * 0.08, -sy * 0.35, 0]
            rotate = [-d * t * 0.2, d * t * 0.6, d * t, -d * t * 0.5, 0]
            scale = [0.9, 1.08, 1, 0.94, 1]
            break
        case 5:
            x = [0, -d * sx * 0.42, d * sx * 0.7, -d * sx * 0.18, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.25, -sy * 0.55, -sy, 0]
            rotate = [d * t * 0.4, -d * t, d * t * 0.75, -d * t * 0.35, 0]
            scale = [0.94, 1.03, 0.9, 1.12, 1]
            break
        case 6:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.12, d * sx * 0.22, -d * sx * 0.12, 0]
            y = [0, -sy, sy * 0.18, -sy * 0.45, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t * 0.2, -d * t * 0.25, d * t * 0.12, 0]
            scale = [0.72, 1.2, 0.88, 1.08, 1]
            break
        case 7:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.9, d * sx * 0.35, -d * sx * 0.6, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.7, -sy * 0.05, -sy * 0.45, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t * 1.15, -d * t * 0.65, d * t * 0.32, 0]
            scale = [0.9, 1.05, 0.96, 1.02, 1]
            break
        case 8:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.25, -d * sx * 0.25, d * sx * 0.25, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.2, -sy * 0.4, -sy * 0.6, 0]
            rotate = [-t, t, -t, t, 0]
            scale = [0.96, 1.1, 0.92, 1.1, 1]
            break
        case 9:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.55, d * sx * 0.1, -d * sx * 0.45, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.45, -sy, -sy * 0.2, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t * 0.3, d * t * 1.3, -d * t * 0.5, 0]
            scale = [0.86, 1.14, 1, 0.9, 1]
            break
        case 10:
            x = [0, d * sx, -d * sx * 0.15, d * sx * 0.2, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.12, -sy * 0.25, -sy * 0.8, 0]
            rotate = [-d * t * 0.6, d * t * 0.8, -d * t * 0.2, d * t * 0.45, 0]
            scale = [0.92, 1.06, 0.96, 1.12, 1]
            break
        default:
            x = [0, d * sx * 0.5, -d * sx * 0.5, d * sx * 0.15, 0]
            y = [0, -sy * 0.5, -sy * 0.2, -sy * 0.9, 0]
            rotate = [0, d * t, -d * t, d * t * 0.4, 0]
            scale = [0.88, 1.18, 0.9, 1.05, 1]
            break
    }
    const o0 = baseOpacity * (focus ? 0.7 : 0.45),
        o1 = Math.min(0.9, baseOpacity + (focus ? 0.38 : 0.2)),
        o2 = baseOpacity * (focus ? 0.88 : 0.62),
        o3 = Math.min(0.86, baseOpacity + (focus ? 0.18 : 0.1))
    return {
        animate: { x, y, rotate, scale, opacity: [o0, o1, o2, o3, o0] },
        transition: {
            duration: p.duration + intensity * 0.35,
            repeat: Infinity,
            ease: [0.42, 0.08, 0.58, 0.96],
            delay: p.delay,
        },
        halo: {
            scale: [0.82, 1.22, 1.05, 0.9],
            opacity: [0.04, 0.28, 0.12, 0.04],
            rotate: [0, d * p.spiral, -d * p.spiral * 0.35, 0],
        },
        image: {
            scale: [0.82, 1.12, 0.96, 1.04, 1],
            y: [2, -4 - p.phase * 8, 1, -2, 0],
            rotate: [-d * 4, d * (3 + p.phase * 18), -d * 2, d, 0],
        },
    }
}
function ArcadeCharacterAtmosphere({ stage, game, reduced }) {
    const expressionTick = useEmotionSecond()
    if (stage !== "reveal") return null
    const moods =
            FAMILY_EMOTIONS[game?.family || "Release"] ||
            FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release,
        focus = game ? FAMILY_BUBBLE[game.family] : null
    const moodPool = GLOBAL_EMOTION_POOL.length ? GLOBAL_EMOTION_POOL : moods
    const slots = [
        { left: "1.5%", top: "13%" },
        { right: "2%", top: "23%" },
        { left: "3%", top: "48%" },
        { right: "3%", top: "55%" },
        { left: "8%", bottom: "5%" },
        { right: "9%", bottom: "6%" },
        { left: "46%", bottom: "1%" },
        { left: "11%", top: "4%" },
        { right: "11%", top: "7%" },
        { left: "18%", bottom: "2%" },
        { right: "17%", bottom: "2%" },
        { left: "28%", top: "2%" },
        { right: "29%", top: "3%" },
        { left: "60%", bottom: "1.2%" },
    ]
    return (
        <div
            className={`arcadeCharacterAtmosphere atmosphere-${stage}`}
            aria-hidden="true"
        >
            {slots.map((p, i) => {
                const slug = ALL_BUBBLES[i % ALL_BUBBLES.length],
                    active = !focus || slug === focus,
                    m =
                        moodPool[
                            (expressionTick * 7 +
                                i * 11 +
                                (game?.id || 0) * 3) %
                                moodPool.length
                        ],
                    anim = bubbleAnim(
                        (game?.id || 37) * 13 + i * 17 + expressionTick * 3,
                        active ? 1.12 : 0.92,
                        active,
                        active ? 0.34 : 0.2
                    )
                return (
                    <motion.div
                        key={`${stage}-${slug}-${i}`}
                        className={`ambientEmotionBubble ${active ? "isFocus" : ""}`}
                        style={{ ...p, ["--char-i"]: i }}
                        initial={
                            reduced
                                ? {}
                                : {
                                      opacity: 0,
                                      scale: 0.35,
                                      rotate: i % 2 ? -12 : 12,
                                  }
                        }
                        animate={
                            reduced
                                ? { opacity: active ? 0.28 : 0.12 }
                                : { ...anim.animate }
                        }
                        transition={anim.transition}
                    >
                        <motion.img
                            key={`${slug}-${m}-${expressionTick}-${i}`}
                            src={emotionSrc(slug, m)}
                            draggable={false}
                            initial={
                                reduced
                                    ? {}
                                    : {
                                          opacity: 0,
                                          scale: 0.48,
                                          rotate: i % 2 ? -10 : 10,
                                          filter: "brightness(1.5) saturate(1.25)",
                                      }
                            }
                            animate={
                                reduced
                                    ? { opacity: 0.55 }
                                    : {
                                          opacity: [0, 1, 0.76],
                                          scale: [0.48, 1.18, 1],
                                          rotate: [
                                              i % 2 ? -10 : 10,
                                              0,
                                              i % 2 ? 2 : -2,
                                          ],
                                          filter: [
                                              "brightness(1.5) saturate(1.25)",
                                              "brightness(1.08) saturate(1.08)",
                                              "brightness(.96) saturate(.95)",
                                          ],
                                      }
                            }
                            transition={{
                                duration: 1.35,
                                ease: [0.34, 0.08, 0.36, 1],
                            }}
                            onError={(e) => {
                                e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"
                            }}
                        />
                    </motion.div>
                )
            })}
        </div>
    )
}
function CharacterEmotionFX({ game, progress, reduced }) {
    const expressionTick = useEmotionSecond()
    const bubble = FAMILY_BUBBLE[game.family] || "drop",
        moods = FAMILY_EMOTIONS[game.family] || FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release,
        phase = progress >= 90 ? 3 : progress >= 55 ? 2 : progress >= 20 ? 1 : 0
    const moodPool = GLOBAL_EMOTION_POOL.length ? GLOBAL_EMOTION_POOL : moods
    const picks = Array.from(
        { length: 8 },
        (_, i) =>
            moodPool[
                (expressionTick * 9 + game.id * 5 + phase * 7 + i * 13) %
                    moodPool.length
            ]
    )
    const slots = [
        { left: "1.2%", top: "8%", size: "clamp(38px,4.1vw,52px)" },
        { right: "1.2%", top: "11%", size: "clamp(40px,4.2vw,54px)" },
        { left: "2.5%", bottom: "7%", size: "clamp(40px,4.3vw,54px)" },
        { right: "2.5%", bottom: "8%", size: "clamp(38px,4.1vw,52px)" },
        { right: "14%", top: "3%", size: "clamp(34px,3.7vw,46px)" },
        { left: "14%", top: "4%", size: "clamp(34px,3.7vw,46px)" },
        { left: "12%", bottom: "2%", size: "clamp(32px,3.4vw,42px)" },
        { right: "12%", bottom: "2%", size: "clamp(32px,3.4vw,42px)" },
    ]
    return (
        <div className="characterEmotionUniverse" aria-hidden="true">
            <div className="characterEmotionDrift">
                {slots.map((slot, i) => {
                    const anim = bubbleAnim(
                        game.id * 17 + phase * 29 + i * 7,
                        game.family === "Distance"
                            ? 1.18
                            : game.family === "Rhythm"
                              ? 1.14
                              : 1,
                        progress >= 90 || i === 0,
                        0.3
                    )
                    return (
                        <motion.div
                            key={`${game.id}-${phase}-${i}`}
                            className="emotionOrb transparentBubble"
                            initial={reduced ? {} : { opacity: 0, scale: 0.7 }}
                            animate={
                                reduced
                                    ? { opacity: 0.18 }
                                    : { ...anim.animate }
                            }
                            transition={anim.transition}
                            style={{
                                ...slot,
                                width: slot.size,
                                height: slot.size,
                            }}
                        >
                            <motion.div
                                className="emotionHalo"
                                animate={reduced ? {} : anim.halo}
                                transition={{
                                    duration: 7.2 + (i % 5) * 0.28,
                                    repeat: Infinity,
                                    ease: "easeInOut",
                                    delay: i * 0.16,
                                }}
                            />
                            <motion.img
                                key={`${game.id}-${i}-${picks[i]}-${expressionTick}`}
                                src={emotionSrc(bubble, picks[i])}
                                draggable={false}
                                onError={(e) => {
                                    e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"
                                }}
                                initial={
                                    reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : {
                                              opacity: 0,
                                              scale: 0.45,
                                              rotate: i % 2 ? -11 : 11,
                                          }
                                }
                                animate={
                                    reduced
                                        ? { opacity: 0.5 }
                                        : progress >= 90
                                          ? {
                                                opacity: [0, 1, 0.74],
                                                scale: [
                                                    0.45, 1.22, 0.94, 1.05, 1,
                                                ],
                                                rotate: [
                                                    i % 2 ? -11 : 11,
                                                    0,
                                                    i % 2 ? 4 : -4,
                                                    0,
                                                ],
                                                y: [2, -5, 1, 0],
                                                filter: [
                                                    "brightness(1.45) saturate(1.25)",
                                                    "brightness(1.12) saturate(1.08)",
                                                    "brightness(.94) saturate(.9)",
                                                ],
                                            }
                                          : {
                                                opacity: [0, 1, 0.7],
                                                ...anim.image,
                                            }
                                }
                                transition={{
                                    duration: 1.45,
                                    ease: [0.34, 0.08, 0.36, 1],
                                }}
                            />
                            <i />
                        </motion.div>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function pct(value) {
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(value)))
}
function gameProgressVerb(game) {
    const map = {
        1: "POPPED",
        3: "CRACKED",
        4: "STOMPED",
        6: "ZAPPED",
        15: "SHREDDED",
        16: "MELTED",
        18: "BURNT",
        19: "ERASED",
        22: "FLUSHED",
        23: "VACUUMED",
        24: "LAUNCHED",
        25: "SWIPED",
        41: "UNHOOKED",
        61: "FROZEN",
        67: "TAPPED OUT",
        71: "DEFUSED",
        109: "CLEANSED",
    }
    return map[game.id] || "COMPLETE"
}
function gameProgressStep(game) {
    const special = {
        1: 20,
        3: 25,
        4: 25,
        6: 25,
        15: 25,
        16: 20,
        18: 20,
        19: 25,
        22: 25,
        23: 25,
        24: 25,
        25: 25,
        41: 34,
        61: 25,
        67: 12.5,
        71: 34,
        109: 5,
    }
    if (special[game.id]) return special[game.id]
    const steps = {
        E01: 20,
        E02: 15,
        E03: 25,
        E04: 10,
        E05: 20,
        E06: 12.5,
        E07: 25,
        E08: 10,
        E09: 10,
        E10: 25,
        E11: 25,
        E12: 50,
        E13: 5,
        E14: 10,
        E15: 34,
    }
    return steps[game.engine] || 20
}
function progressLabel(game, value) {
    return `${pct(value)}% ${gameProgressVerb(game)}`
}
function usesExplicitProgress(game) {
    return (
        [
            1, 3, 4, 6, 15, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 41, 61, 71, 94, 101,
            102, 103, 104, 106, 107, 109,
        ].includes(game.id) ||
        game.engine === "E04" ||
        game.engine === "E08" ||
        game.engine === "E09" ||
        game.engine === "E13"
    )
}
function seedPositions(n) {
    const spots = [
        { x: 14, y: 24, r: -4 },
        { x: 31, y: 18, r: 4 },
        { x: 49, y: 22, r: -2 },
        { x: 67, y: 19, r: 5 },
        { x: 84, y: 26, r: -3 },
        { x: 20, y: 43, r: 4 },
        { x: 38, y: 39, r: -5 },
        { x: 58, y: 43, r: 3 },
        { x: 77, y: 41, r: -4 },
        { x: 88, y: 49, r: 3 },
        { x: 14, y: 63, r: -3 },
        { x: 31, y: 61, r: 5 },
        { x: 49, y: 67, r: -2 },
        { x: 67, y: 61, r: 4 },
        { x: 84, y: 64, r: -5 },
    ]
    return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => spots[i % spots.length])
}
function distributeAcrossVisibleSlots(
    items,
    fallback,
    slots = MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
) {
    const src = (items && items.length ? items : [fallback]).slice(
        0,
        Math.max(1, slots)
    )
    return Array.from(
        { length: Math.max(1, slots) },
        (_, i) => src[i % src.length] ?? fallback
    )
}
function buildBubbleWords(entries) {
    const raw = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS THOUGHT"])
        .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    return distributeAcrossVisibleSlots(raw, "THIS", visibleBubbleSlots(raw))
}
function directWords(
    entries,
    max = MAX_WORD_QUEUE,
    minCopies = MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
) {
    const out = buildBubbleWords(entries)
    if (out.length >= Math.min(max, MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES))
        return out.slice(0, Math.min(max, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES))
    while (
        out.length <
        Math.min(max, Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, minCopies))
    )
        out.push(out[out.length % Math.max(1, out.length)] || "THIS")
    return out.slice(0, Math.min(max, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES))
}
function exactInputWords(entries, max = MAX_WORD_QUEUE) {
    const src = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
        .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    const slots = isImageOnlyEntries(src)
        ? Math.min(max, visibleBubbleSlots(src))
        : Math.min(max, MAX_TEXT_WORD_BUBBLES)
    return distributeAcrossVisibleSlots(
        src.length ? src : ["THIS"],
        "THIS",
        slots
    )
}
function activeWord(entries, idx, fallback = "THIS") {
    const words = directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE)
    return words[Math.min(idx, Math.max(0, words.length - 1))] || fallback
}
function wordsFor(
    entries,
    min = MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
    max = MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
) {
    const src = directWords(
        entries,
        MAX_WORD_QUEUE,
        Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, min)
    )
    return src.length
        ? src.slice(
              0,
              Math.min(
                  MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                  Math.max(
                      MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                      Math.min(MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, max)
                  )
              )
          )
        : ["THIS"]
}
function popBubbleWords(entries, count = MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES) {
    const src = directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE, MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
    return src.length
        ? src.slice(
              0,
              Math.min(
                  MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                  Math.max(
                      MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                      Math.min(MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, count)
                  )
              )
          )
        : ["THIS"]
}
function popPositionsMany(n) {
    const spots = [
        { x: 14, y: 25, r: -5 },
        { x: 31, y: 20, r: 4 },
        { x: 49, y: 24, r: -2 },
        { x: 68, y: 20, r: 5 },
        { x: 85, y: 28, r: -3 },
        { x: 20, y: 45, r: 4 },
        { x: 39, y: 42, r: -5 },
        { x: 59, y: 46, r: 3 },
        { x: 79, y: 44, r: -4 },
        { x: 13, y: 66, r: -3 },
        { x: 31, y: 64, r: 5 },
        { x: 50, y: 69, r: -2 },
        { x: 69, y: 63, r: 4 },
        { x: 86, y: 67, r: -5 },
    ]
    return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => spots[i % spots.length])
}
function PopSplash({ x, y }) {
    return (
        <div className="popSplash" style={{ left: x + "%", top: y + "%" }}>
            <span>POP!</span>
            <i className="popRing" />
            <i className="popRing r2" />
            {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
                <b key={i} style={{ ["--pi"]: i }} />
            ))}
        </div>
    )
}
function popPositions(n) {
    const spots = [
        { x: 50, y: 47, r: 0 },
        { x: 32, y: 38, r: -4 },
        { x: 68, y: 38, r: 4 },
        { x: 26, y: 62, r: -5 },
        { x: 74, y: 62, r: 5 },
        { x: 50, y: 68, r: 0 },
        { x: 40, y: 25, r: -3 },
        { x: 60, y: 25, r: 3 },
    ]
    if (n <= 1) return [spots[0]]
    return spots.slice(0, n)
}
function literalFont(s, max, min = 10) {
    const len = Math.max(1, s.length)
    const scaled = max * Math.sqrt(28 / Math.max(28, len))
    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, scaled))
}
function uploadedThoughtImageSrc() {
    try {
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return null
        return String(window.__tsUploadedThoughtImage || "") || null
    } catch {
        return null
    }
}
function ExactWords({ text, max, min = 10 }) {
    const preview = displayText(text, 24)
    if (!preview) return null
    const rawFontSize = literalFont(preview, max, min)
    const fontSize = Math.max(6, rawFontSize * 0.84)
    return (
        <span
            className="plainUserThoughtText tsGlobalThoughtText"
            title={String(text || "")}
            style={{
                fontSize,
                wordBreak: "break-word",
            }}
        >
            {preview}
        </span>
    )
}
function toolWords(entries, min = 5, max = 10) {
    const src = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
        .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    if (!src.length) return Array.from({ length: min }, () => "THIS")
    if (src.length <= max) {
        const total = Math.max(min, src.length)
        const base = Math.floor(total / src.length)
        const rem = total % src.length
        const out = []
        src.forEach((word, i) => {
            for (let n = 0; n < base + (i < rem ? 1 : 0); n++) out.push(word)
        })
        return out.slice(0, max)
    }
    return Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => {
        const start = Math.floor((i * src.length) / max)
        const end = Math.floor(((i + 1) * src.length) / max)
        return src.slice(start, Math.max(start + 1, end)).join(" ")
    })
}

    if (n <= 7)
        return [

            { x: 38, y: 66, r: 2 },
            { x: 62, y: 66, r: -2 },

        ].slice(0, n)
    return [
        { x: 12, y: 27, r: -3 },
        { x: 31, y: 18, r: 2 },
        { x: 50, y: 26, r: -2 },
        { x: 69, y: 18, r: 3 },

        { x: 84, y: 62, r: 2 },
    ].slice(0, n)
}

function BurstEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const sourceWords = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [batchStart, setBatchStart] = React.useState(0)
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            sourceWords.slice(
                batchStart,
                batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            ),
        [sourceWords, batchStart]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            game.id === 1
                ? popPositionsMany(words.length)
                : seedPositions(words.length),
        [game.id, words.length]
    )
    const [alive, setAlive] = React.useState([])
    const [bursting, setBursting] = React.useState([])
    const [combo, setCombo] = React.useState(0)
    const [fx, setFx] = React.useState([])
    const [cleared, setCleared] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setBatchStart(0)
        setBursting([])
        setCombo(0)
        setFx([])
        setCleared(0)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setAlive(words.map((_, i) => i))
        setBursting([])
    }, [batchStart, words.length])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (game.id === 1)
            onProgress?.(
                pct((cleared / Math.max(1, sourceWords.length)) * 100),
                `${pct((cleared / Math.max(1, sourceWords.length)) * 100)}% POPPED`
            )
    }, [cleared, sourceWords.length, game.id])
    const pop = (i) => {
        if (!alive.includes(i) || bursting.includes(i)) return
        setBursting((a) => [...a, i])
        const f = { id: Date.now() + i, x: pos[i]?.x || 50, y: pos[i]?.y || 50 }
        setFx((a) => [...a.slice(-7), f])
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(16)
        const nextCombo = combo + 1
        setCombo(nextCombo)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setAlive((a) => {
                const nx = a.filter((x) => x !== i)
                const totalCleared = cleared + 1
                setCleared(totalCleared)
                if (!nx.length) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (
                            batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES <
                            sourceWords.length
                        )
                            setBatchStart(batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
                        else setTimeout(() => onDone(260 + nextCombo * 18), 420)
                    }, 240)
                }
                return nx
            })
            setBursting((a) => a.filter((x) => x !== i))
        }, 260)
        setTimeout(() => setFx((a) => a.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id)), 900)
    }
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena burstArena premiumArena " +
                (game.id === 1
                    ? "popArenaV2 cinematicPopArena"
                    : "cinematicBurstArena")
            }
        >
            <div className="depthHalo" />
            {game.id === 1 && <div className="popFieldGlow" />}
            <div className="bubbleDepthLayer far" />
            <div className="bubbleDepthLayer near" />
            {words.map((w, i) =>
                alive.includes(i) ? (
                    <motion.button
                        key={batchStart + "-" + i}
                        className={
                            "wordBubble premiumBubble allCircularBubble " +
                            (game.id === 1 ? "popBubbleV2 " : "") +
                            (bursting.includes(i) ? "isBursting" : "")
                        }
                        onPointerDown={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault()
                            pop(i)
                        }}
                        style={{
                            left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                            top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                            rotate: pos[i]?.r || 0,
                            width: 92,
                            height: 92,
                            borderRadius: "999px",
                        }}
                        animate={
                            bursting.includes(i)
                                ? {
                                      scale: [1, 1.17, 1.28, 0.05],
                                      opacity: [1, 1, 0.94, 0],
                                      filter: [
                                          "brightness(1)",
                                          "brightness(1.9) saturate(1.35)",
                                          "brightness(2.8) blur(1px)",
                                          "blur(10px) brightness(2)",
                                      ],
                                      rotate: [
                                          pos[i]?.r || 0,
                                          (pos[i]?.r || 0) + (i % 2 ? 5 : -5),
                                          (pos[i]?.r || 0) + (i % 2 ? 9 : -9),
                                      ],
                                  }
                                : reduced
                                  ? {}
                                  : {
                                        y: [
                                            -8 - (i % 3) * 2,
                                            7 + (i % 4) * 2,
                                            -8 - (i % 3) * 2,
                                        ],
                                        x: [
                                            -4 - (i % 2) * 2,
                                            4 + (i % 3),
                                            -4 - (i % 2) * 2,
                                        ],
                                        scale: [1, 1.045 + (i % 3) * 0.01, 1],
                                        rotate: [
                                            (pos[i]?.r || 0) - 1.4,
                                            (pos[i]?.r || 0) + 1.4,
                                            (pos[i]?.r || 0) - 1.4,
                                        ],
                                    }
                        }
                        transition={
                            bursting.includes(i)
                                ? {
                                      duration: 0.26,
                                      times: [0, 0.28, 0.62, 1],
                                      ease: [0.17, 0.84, 0.28, 1],
                                  }
                                : {
                                      duration: 2.4 + (i % 5) * 0.31,
                                      repeat: Infinity,
                                      ease: "easeInOut",
                                      delay: (i % 4) * 0.08,
                                  }
                        }
                        whileHover={
                            reduced
                                ? {}
                                : {
                                      scale: 1.08,
                                      filter: "brightness(1.2) saturate(1.15)",
                                  }
                        }
                        whileTap={{ scale: 0.82 }}
                    >
                        <ExactWords text={w} max={12} min={7} />
                        <i className="bubbleSheen" />
                        {game.id === 1 && <i className="bubbleRim" />}
                        <i className="bubbleCaustic" />
                    </motion.button>
                ) : null
            )}
            {fx.map((f) =>
                game.id === 1 ? (
                    <React.Fragment key={f.id}>
                        <PopSplash x={f.x} y={f.y} />
                        <PremiumBurst x={f.x} y={f.y} tone="cyan" />
                    </React.Fragment>
                ) : (
                    <PremiumBurst key={f.id} x={f.x} y={f.y} tone="violet" />
                )
            )}
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                {game.id === 1
                    ? `POPPED ${cleared} / ${sourceWords.length}`
                    : `CLEAR ${cleared}/${sourceWords.length}`}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function StompEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => wordsFor(entries, 6, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(() => {
        const n = Math.max(1, words.length),
            left = 7,
            right = 93,
            step = n <= 1 ? 0 : (right - left) / (n - 1)
        return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({
            x: left + step * i,
            y: 43,
            r: 0,
        }))
    }, [words.length])
    const stompBubbleSize =
        words.length <= 6 ? 104 : words.length <= 8 ? 90 : 78
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [toolArmed, setToolArmed] = React.useState(false)
    const [pointerInside, setPointerInside] = React.useState(false)
    const [toolPos, setToolPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 82 })
    const [toolHit, setToolHit] = React.useState(0)
    const [hits, setHits] = React.useState(() => words.map(() => 0))
    const [breaking, setBreaking] = React.useState([])
    const [vanished, setVanished] = React.useState([])
    const [bursts, setBursts] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setToolArmed(false)
        setPointerInside(false)
        setToolHit(0)
        setHits(words.map(() => 0))
        setBreaking(words.map(() => false))
        setVanished(words.map(() => false))
        setBursts([])
        onProgress?.(0, "0% STOMPED")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const updateTool = (e) => {
        if (!toolArmed) return
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        setToolPos({
            x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
            y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
        })
    }
    const armTool = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        setToolArmed(true)
        setPointerInside(true)
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (rect)
            setToolPos({
                x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
                y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
            })
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const stompWord = (i) => {
        if (!toolArmed || breaking[i] || vanished[i] || (hits[i] || 0) >= 3)
            return
        setToolHit((h) => h + 1)
        const nextHit = Math.min(3, (hits[i] || 0) + 1)
        const nextHits = hits.map((v, n) => (n === i ? nextHit : v))
        setHits(nextHits)
        const totalHits = nextHits.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
        const p = pct((totalHits / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% STOMPED`)
        const killed = nextHit >= 3
        sfx(killed ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(killed ? 30 : 15)
        const fx = {
            id: Date.now() + i,
            x: pos[i]?.x || 50,
            y: pos[i]?.y || 43,
            word: i,
            big: killed,
        }
        setBursts((a) => [...a.slice(-10), fx])
        setTimeout(() => setBursts((a) => a.filter((x) => x.id !== fx.id)), 850)
        if (killed) {
            setBreaking((prev) => prev.map((v, n) => (n === i ? true : v)))
            setTimeout(() => {
                setVanished((prev) => prev.map((v, n) => (n === i ? true : v)))
                setBreaking((prev) => prev.map((v, n) => (n === i ? false : v)))
                const completed = nextHits.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
                if (completed >= words.length)
                    setTimeout(() => onDone(320), 440)
            }, 700)
        }
    }
    const completed = hits.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={
                "arena literalStompArena premiumArena multiStompArena " +
                (toolArmed ? "stompToolArmed" : "")
            }
            onPointerMove={updateTool}
            onPointerEnter={() => {
                if (toolArmed) setPointerInside(true)
            }}
            onPointerLeave={() => setPointerInside(false)}
            onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
            }}
        >
            <div className="stompFloor" />
            <div className="stompBubbleField">
                {words.map((w, i) => {
                    if (vanished[i]) return null
                    const isBreaking = !!breaking[i]
                    const h = hits[i] || 0
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={i}
                            className={
                                "stompBubbleSlot " +
                                (isBreaking ? "breaking " : "") +
                                (toolArmed && !isBreaking ? "toolTarget" : "")
                            }
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: (pos[i]?.y || 43) + "%",
                                width: stompBubbleSize,
                                height: stompBubbleSize,
                            }}
                            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                if (!toolArmed || isBreaking) return
                                e.preventDefault()
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                stompWord(i)
                            }}
                        >
                            <motion.div
                                className={
                                    "stompWordBubble allCircularBubble stompDamage" +
                                    h
                                }
                                initial={false}
                                animate={
                                    isBreaking
                                        ? {
                                              scaleX: [1, 1.16, 1.45, 1.9],
                                              scaleY: [1, 0.72, 0.24, 0.035],
                                              y: [0, 8, 20, 34],
                                              rotate: [0, -2, 2, 5],
                                              opacity: [1, 1, 0.9, 0],
                                              filter: [
                                                  "brightness(1)",
                                                  "brightness(1.9) saturate(1.3)",
                                                  "brightness(2.6) blur(1px)",
                                                  "blur(14px) brightness(1.4)",
                                              ],
                                          }
                                        : reduced
                                          ? {}
                                          : {
                                                y: [-4, 4, -4],
                                                scale: [1, 1.025, 1],
                                            }
                                }
                                transition={
                                    isBreaking
                                        ? {
                                              duration: 0.64,
                                              times: [0, 0.22, 0.58, 1],
                                              ease: [0.18, 0.8, 0.22, 1],
                                          }
                                        : {
                                              duration: 2.5 + i * 0.13,
                                              repeat: Infinity,
                                              ease: "easeInOut",
                                          }
                                }
                            >
                                <ExactWords text={w} max={14} min={8} />
                                <i className="stompBubbleRim" />
                                <i className="stompBubbleSheen" />
                                {h >= 1 ? (
                                    <i className="stompCrackOverlay damage1" />
                                ) : null}
                                {h >= 2 ? (
                                    <i className="stompCrackOverlay damage2" />
                                ) : null}
                                <b className="toolHitCount">{h}/3</b>
                            </motion.div>
                            {isBreaking ? (
                                <div className="stompLocalDebris">
                                    {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, n) => (
                                        <motion.i
                                            key={n}
                                            initial={{
                                                x: 0,
                                                y: 0,
                                                opacity: 1,
                                                scale: 1,
                                            }}
                                            animate={{
                                                x: (n - 5.5) * 13,
                                                y: 32 + (n % 3) * 14,
                                                rotate:
                                                    (n % 2 ? 1 : -1) *
                                                    (25 + n * 8),
                                                opacity: 0,
                                                scale: 0.35,
                                            }}
                                            transition={{
                                                duration: 0.66,
                                                delay: n * 0.012,
                                                ease: "easeOut",
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}
                        </div>
                    )
                })}
                {bursts.map((f) => (
                    <PremiumBurst
                        key={f.id}
                        x={f.x}
                        y={f.y}
                        tone={f.word % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                        big={f.big}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>
            <button
                className={"stompToolDock " + (toolArmed ? "selected" : "")}
                onPointerDown={armTool}
                onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault()
                    e.stopPropagation()
                }}
            >
                <span>
                    {toolArmed ? "STOMP TOOL ACTIVE" : "ACTIVATE STOMP TOOL"}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>
            {toolArmed && pointerInside ? (
                <div
                    key={toolHit}
                    className={"stompCursorTool " + (toolHit > 0 ? "hit" : "")}
                    style={{ left: toolPos.x + "%", top: toolPos.y + "%" }}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <i className="stompCursorBoot">
                        <b />
                        <em />
                    </i>
                    <span>STOMP</span>
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="literalStatus stompStatus">
                <b>
                    {completed >= words.length
                        ? "ALL BUBBLES STOMPED"
                        : toolArmed
                          ? `${completed} / ${words.length} DESTROYED · 3 STOMPS PER BUBBLE`
                          : "ACTIVATE THE STOMP TOOL"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {toolArmed
                        ? "Click any bubble three times. The third stomp destroys it."
                        : "Activate once. Your mouse becomes the stomp tool until every bubble is gone."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {completed} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function ImpactEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [hits, setHits] = React.useState(0),
        [impactFx, setImpactFx] = React.useState(0)
    const target = game.id === 63 ? 5 : 7
    const t = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS"), 42)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setHits(0)
        setImpactFx(0)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const hit = () => {
        const n = Math.min(target, hits + 1)
        setHits(n)
        setImpactFx((x) => x + 1)
        sfx(n >= target ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(n >= target ? 35 : 12)
        if (n >= target)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1)
                    setTimeout(() => onDone(180 + n * 26), 540)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setHits(0)
                }
            }, 780)
    }
    const damage = Math.min(1, hits / target)
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena impactArena premiumArena cinematicImpactArena damage" +
                hits
            }
        >
            <div className="depthHalo" />
            <div className="impactFloor">
                <i />
            </div>
            <motion.button
                key={"impact-" + idx + "-" + impactFx}
                className="impactObject premiumImpact cinematicImpactObject"
                onClick={hit}
                animate={
                    hits >= target
                        ? {
                              scale: [1, 0.92, 1.13, 0.18],
                              scaleX: [1, 1.22, 0.84, 0.2],
                              scaleY: [1, 0.7, 1.1, 0.12],
                              y: [0, 12, -8, 62],
                              rotate: [0, -3, 6, 14],
                              opacity: [1, 1, 0.9, 0],
                              filter: [
                                  "brightness(1)",
                                  "brightness(1.5)",
                                  "brightness(2.4) saturate(1.4)",
                                  "blur(18px)",
                              ],
                          }
                        : reduced
                          ? {}
                          : {
                                x: [0, -7, 6, -3, 0],
                                y: [0, 5, -2, 0],
                                rotate: [0, -2.8, 2.2, -0.8, 0],
                                scaleX: [1, 1.08, 0.95, 1],
                                scaleY: [1, 0.88, 1.04, 1],
                            }
                }
                transition={{
                    duration: hits >= target ? 0.82 : 0.34,
                    ease: [0.18, 0.78, 0.26, 1],
                }}
                style={{ ["--damage"]: damage }}
            >
                <span>{t}</span>
                <b>{game.id === 63 ? "PREDICT + TAP" : "HIT"}</b>
                <i className="impactGloss" />
                <i className="impactCrack c1" />
                <i className="impactCrack c2" />
                <i className="impactCrack c3" />
            </motion.button>
            {impactFx > 0 ? (
                <PremiumBurst
                    key={impactFx}
                    x={50}
                    y={47}
                    tone={hits >= target ? "gold" : "cyan"}
                    big={hits >= target}
                />
            ) : null}
            {impactFx > 0 ? (
                <div key={"dust-" + impactFx} className="impactDebris">
                    {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => (
                        <i key={i} style={{ ["--di"]: i }} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="health premiumHealth">
                <i
                    style={{
                        width: `${Math.max(0, 100 - (hits / target) * 100)}%`,
                    }}
                />
            </div>
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length} · {hits} / {target}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function ShredEngine({
    entries,
    imageSrc,
    imageSources,
    onDone,
    sfx,
    reduced,
    onProgress,
}) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [feed, setFeed] = React.useState(0)
    const [gone, setGone] = React.useState(false)
    const [bite, setBite] = React.useState(0)
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setFeed(0)
        setGone(false)
        setBite(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% SHREDDED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const shred = () => {
        if (gone) return
        const n = Math.min(100, feed + 20)
        setFeed(n)
        setBite((v) => v + 1)
        const p = pct(((idx + n / 100) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% SHREDDED`)
        sfx(n >= 100 ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(n >= 100 ? 30 : 12)
        if (n >= 100) {
            setGone(true)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(360), 720)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setFeed(0)
                    setGone(false)
                    setBite(0)
                }
            }, 1120)
        }
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena literalShredArena premiumArena cinematicShredArena">
            <div className="shredRoomGlow" />
            <div className="shredFloorShadow" />

            <div className="shredPaperAnchor">
                <motion.div
                    key={idx + "-" + bite}
                    className="shredPaper premiumShredPaper"
                    animate={
                        gone
                            ? {
                                  y: [feed * 0.92, 112, 142],
                                  scaleY: [0.48, 0.18, 0.04],
                                  scaleX: [1, 0.96, 0.88],
                                  opacity: [1, 0.55, 0],
                                  filter: [
                                      "blur(0px)",
                                      "blur(1px)",
                                      "blur(6px)",
                                  ],
                              }
                            : {
                                  y: feed * 0.92,
                                  scaleY: 1 - feed / 185,
                                  x: feed > 0 ? [0, -2, 2, -1, 0] : 0,
                                  rotate: feed > 0 ? [0, -0.5, 0.5, 0] : 0,
                                  opacity: 1,
                              }
                    }
                    transition={
                        gone
                            ? { duration: 0.58, ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.25, 1] }
                            : { duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }
                    }
                    style={{ transformOrigin: "50% 100%" }}
                >
                    <div className="paperTopCurl" />
                    <div className="shredPaperText">
                        {imageSrc ? (
                            <div className="uploadedPaperFace">
                                <img src={imageSrc} alt="Uploaded thought" />
                            </div>
                        ) : (
                            <ExactWords text={current} max={42} min={11} />
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div
                        className="paperFeedMarks"
                        style={{ opacity: feed > 0 ? 0.65 : 0 }}
                    >
                        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div
                        className="shredCutCurtain"
                        style={{ height: Math.max(0, feed - 6) + "%" }}
                    >
                        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                </motion.div>
            </div>

            <div
                className={
                    "shredderBody premiumShredder " +
                    (feed > 0 && !gone ? "motorOn" : "") +
                    (gone ? " shredComplete" : "")
                }
            >
                <div className="shredderTop">
                    <span>THINKSTILL // CROSS-CUT</span>
                    <i />
                </div>
                <div className="shredFeedGuide">
                    <i />
                    <i />
                    <i />
                </div>
                <div className={"shredderMouth " + (feed > 0 ? "running" : "")}>
                    <div className="shredRoller left">
                        {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="shredRoller right">
                        {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <div className="shredTeeth">
                        {Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    <b>{gone ? "CLEAR" : feed > 0 ? "CUTTING" : "FEED SLOT"}</b>
                </div>
                <div className="shredderBinWindow">
                    <div className="shredBinGlow" />
                    {Array.from({ length: 26 }, (_, i) => (
                        <motion.i
                            key={i}
                            className="shredStrip"
                            initial={false}
                            animate={
                                feed > 0 || gone
