                                    ? {
                                          y: gone
                                              ? [0, 54 + (i % 6) * 5]
                                              : Math.max(0, (feed - 35) * 0.55),
                                          x: (i - 12.5) * 4.2,
                                          rotate:
                                              (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (10 + i * 4),
                                          opacity:
                                              feed > 35
                                                  ? Math.min(
                                                        0.95,
                                                        (feed - 30) / 55
                                                    )
                                                  : 0,
                                      }
                                    : { opacity: 0 }
                            }
                            transition={{
                                duration: gone ? 0.72 : 0.25,
                                delay: gone ? i * 0.014 : 0,
                                ease: "easeOut",
                            }}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
                <div className="shredderFeet">
                    <i />
                    <i />
                </div>
            </div>

            {feed > 0 ? (
                <div key={bite} className="shredMotorFx">
                    <i />
                    <i />
                    <i />
                    <b />
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <button
                className="bigAction shredAction primaryBottomControl"
                onClick={shred}
                disabled={gone}
            >
                {gone
                    ? "SHREDDED"
                    : feed
                      ? `KEEP SHREDDING · ${feed}%`
                      : "START SHREDDER"}
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus shredStatus">
                <b>{gone ? "100% SHREDDED" : `${feed}% SHREDDED`}</b>
                <span>
                    {feed === 0
                        ? "The paper is sitting directly on the feed slot. Start the motor."
                        : gone
                          ? "The original word is gone. Only loose strips remain in the bin."
                          : "Keep pressing. The rollers pull the paper straight down through the slot."}
                </span>
            </div>
            {gone ? <PremiumBurst x={50} y={68} tone="violet" big /> : null}
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function ThrowEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const sourceWords = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [batchStart, setBatchStart] = React.useState(0)
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            sourceWords.slice(
                batchStart,
                batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            ),
        [sourceWords, batchStart]
    )
    const [left, setLeft] = React.useState([]),
        [flying, setFlying] = React.useState({})
    const [fx, setFx] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setBatchStart(0)
        setFlying({})
        setFx([])
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setLeft(words.map((_, i) => i))
        setFlying({})
    }, [batchStart, words.length])
    const release = (i, info) => {
        const d = Math.hypot(info.offset.x, info.offset.y)
        if (d < 45) return
        const vx = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, info.velocity.x / 900 || info.offset.x / 130)
        )
        const vy = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, info.velocity.y / 900 || info.offset.y / 130)
        )
        const portalX = game.id === 21 ? 150 : 0,
            portalY = game.id === 21 ? 270 : 300
        setFlying((a) => ({
            ...a,
            [i]: { x: portalX + vx * 70, y: portalY + Math.max(-40, vy * 35) },
        }))
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(18)
        const f = {
            id: Date.now() + i,
            x: game.id === 21 ? 78 : 50,
            y: game.id === 21 ? 78 : 82,
        }
        setFx((a) => [...a.slice(-3), f])
        setTimeout(() => setFx((a) => a.filter((x) => x.id !== f.id)), 900)
        setTimeout(
            () =>
                setLeft((a) => {
                    const n = a.filter((x) => x !== i)
                    if (!n.length)
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            if (
                                batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES <
                                sourceWords.length
                            )
                                setBatchStart(
                                    batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
                                )
                            else onDone(220 + d)
                        }, 340)
                    return n
                }),
            520
        )
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena throwArena premiumArena cinematicThrowArena">
            <div className="depthHalo" />
            <div className="throwStarfield" />
            <div
                className={
                    "portal premiumPortal " +
                    (game.id === 21
                        ? "binPortal binPortalBottomRight"
                        : "releasePortal")
                }
            >
                <i className="portalSpin" />
                <i className="portalCore" />
                <b>{game.id === 21 ? "BIN" : "RELEASE"}</b>
                <small>FLICK HERE</small>
            </div>
            {left.map((i, k) => {
                const fly = flying[i]
                return (
                    <motion.div
                        key={batchStart + "-" + i}
                        className={
                            "throwCard premiumThrowCard allCircularBubble " +
                            (game.id === 21 ? "binThrowCard " : "") +
                            (fly ? "isFlying" : "")
                        }
                        drag={!fly}
                        dragMomentum={false}
                        dragElastic={0.16}
                        onDragEnd={(_, info) => release(i, info)}
                        initial={
                            game.id === 21
                                ? {
                                      x: -70 + (k - 1) * 18,
                                      y: -8 + k * 10,
                                      rotate: (k - 1) * 3,
                                  }
                                : {
                                      x: (k - 1.5) * 34,
                                      y: k * 8,
                                      rotate: (k - 1) * 3,
                                  }
                        }
                        animate={
                            fly
                                ? {
                                      x: fly.x,
                                      y: fly.y,
                                      scale: [1, 1.08, 0.72, 0.06],
                                      rotate: [0, 8, 26, 70],
                                      opacity: [1, 1, 0.72, 0],
                                      filter: [
                                          "blur(0px)",
                                          "blur(0px)",
                                          "blur(2px)",
                                          "blur(12px) brightness(2)",
                                      ],
                                  }
                                : reduced
                                  ? {}
                                  : {
                                        y: [k * 8 - 5, k * 8 + 5, k * 8 - 5],
                                        rotate: [
                                            (k - 1) * 3 - 1.2,
                                            (k - 1) * 3 + 1.2,
                                            (k - 1) * 3 - 1.2,
                                        ],
                                    }
                        }
                        transition={
                            fly
                                ? {
                                      duration: 0.52,
                                      times: [0, 0.24, 0.65, 1],
                                      ease: [0.18, 0.8, 0.24, 1],
                                  }
                                : {
                                      duration: 2.5 + k * 0.17,
                                      repeat: Infinity,
                                      ease: "easeInOut",
                                  }
                        }
                        whileDrag={{
                            scale: 1.1,
                            zIndex: 20,
                            boxShadow: "0 0 62px rgba(79,231,255,.35)",
                        }}
                    >
                        <span>{displayText(words[i], 40)}</span>
                        <small>FLICK</small>
                        <i className="cardSheen" />
                        <i className="throwTrail" />
                    </motion.div>
                )
            })}
            {fx.map((f) => (
                <PremiumBurst key={f.id} x={f.x} y={f.y} tone="cyan" big />
            ))}
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                {Math.min(batchStart + left.length, sourceWords.length)} /{" "}
                {sourceWords.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function DissolveEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, onProgress }) {
    const [p, setP] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setP(0)
        onProgress?.(0, progressLabel(game, 0))
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const t = displayText(entries.join(" · ") || "THIS THOUGHT", 70)
    const add = (n = 8) =>
        setP((v) => {
            const x = clamp(v + n, 0, 100)
            onProgress?.(x, progressLabel(game, x))
            if (x >= 100 && v < 100) {
                sfx("win")
                vibrate(30)
                setTimeout(() => onDone(260), 760)
            }
            return x
        })
    const visible = Math.max(0, Math.round(t.length * (1 - p / 100)))
    const front = t.slice(0, visible)
    const gone = t.slice(visible)
    return (
        <div
            className="arena dissolveArena premiumArena"
            onPointerMove={(e) => {
                if (e.buttons) add(4)
            }}
        >
            <div
                className="dissolveMist"
                style={{
                    opacity: p / 110,
                    transform: `scale(${0.7 + p / 180})`,
                }}
            />
            <div className="inkStack">
                <div
                    className="inkGhost g1"
                    style={{
                        opacity: p / 150,
                        transform: `translate(${p / 10}px,${p / 18}px) skewX(${-p / 12}deg)`,
                    }}
                >
                    {t}
                </div>
                <div
                    className="inkGhost g2"
                    style={{
                        opacity: p / 190,
                        transform: `translate(${-p / 13}px,${p / 12}px) scale(${1 + p / 420})`,
                    }}
                >
                    {t}
                </div>
                <div
                    className="inkWord premiumInk"
                    style={{
                        filter: `blur(${p / 22}px)`,
                        transform: `scale(${1 + p / 520})`,
                    }}
                >
                    <span>{front}</span>
                    <em
                        style={{
                            opacity: Math.max(0, 1 - p / 34),
                            filter: `blur(${3 + p / 10}px)`,
                            transform: `translateY(${p / 5}px)`,
                        }}
                    >
                        {gone}
                    </em>
                </div>
            </div>
            <button className="wave premiumWave" onPointerDown={() => add(14)}>
                <span>DRAG / HOLD THE LIGHT</span>
                <i />
            </button>
            <div className="meter premiumMeter">
                <i style={{ width: p + "%" }} />
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function LaserSliceEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => toolWords(entries, 5, 10),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            meltOrganizedRandomPattern(
                words.length,
                entries.join("|") + "|" + words.length
            ),
        [words.length, entries.join("|")]
    )
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [toolArmed, setToolArmed] = React.useState(false)
    const [pointerInside, setPointerInside] = React.useState(false)
    const [toolPos, setToolPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 82 })
    const [shots, setShots] = React.useState([])
    const [vanished, setVanished] = React.useState([])
    const [firing, setFiring] = React.useState(-1)
    const [pulse, setPulse] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setToolArmed(false)
        setPointerInside(false)
        setShots(words.map(() => 0))
        setVanished(words.map(() => false))
        setFiring(-1)
        setPulse(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% SLICED")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const updateTool = (e) => {
        if (!toolArmed) return
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        setToolPos({
            x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
            y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
        })
    }
    const armTool = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        setToolArmed(true)
        setPointerInside(true)
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (rect)
            setToolPos({
                x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
                y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
            })
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const fireAt = (i) => {
        if (!toolArmed || vanished[i] || firing >= 0 || (shots[i] || 0) >= 3)
            return
        const nextHit = Math.min(3, (shots[i] || 0) + 1)
        const next = shots.map((v, n) => (n === i ? nextHit : v))
        setShots(next)
        setFiring(i)
        setPulse((p) => p + 1)
        const totalHits = next.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
        const p = pct((totalHits / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% SLICED`)
        const killed = nextHit >= 3
        sfx(killed ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(killed ? 26 : 10)
        setTimeout(() => setFiring(-1), 260)
        if (killed)
            setTimeout(() => {
                setVanished((v) => v.map((gone, n) => (n === i ? true : gone)))
                const completed = next.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
                if (completed >= words.length)
                    setTimeout(() => onDone(300), 420)
            }, 650)
    }
    const completed = shots.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={
                "arena laserSliceArena premiumArena multiLaserArena " +
                (toolArmed ? "laserToolArmed" : "")
            }
            onPointerMove={updateTool}
            onPointerEnter={() => {
                if (toolArmed) setPointerInside(true)
            }}
            onPointerLeave={() => setPointerInside(false)}
            onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
            }}
        >
            <div className="laserBubbleField">
                {words.map((w, i) => {
                    if (vanished[i]) return null
                    const h = shots[i] || 0
                    const active = firing === i
                    return (
                        <motion.button
                            key={i}
                            className={
                                "laserTargetBubble allCircularBubble laserDamage" +
                                h
                            }
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                                rotate: pos[i]?.r || 0,
                            }}
                            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                if (!toolArmed) return
                                e.preventDefault()
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                fireAt(i)
                            }}
                            animate={
                                h >= 3
                                    ? {
                                          scale: [1, 1.1, 0.05],
                                          opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                          rotate: [
                                              pos[i]?.r || 0,
                                              (pos[i]?.r || 0) +
                                                  (i % 2 ? 12 : -12),
                                              30,
                                          ],
                                      }
                                    : active
                                      ? {
                                            scale: [1, 1.08, 1],
                                            filter: [
                                                "brightness(1)",
                                                "brightness(3)",
                                                "brightness(1)",
                                            ],
                                        }
                                      : reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : { y: [-3, 3, -3] }
                            }
                            transition={
                                h >= 3
                                    ? { duration: 0.62, ease: "easeOut" }
                                    : active
                                      ? { duration: 0.24 }
                                      : {
                                            duration: 2.2 + i * 0.11,
                                            repeat: Infinity,
                                            ease: "easeInOut",
                                        }
                            }
                        >
                            <ExactWords text={w} max={15} min={7} />
                            <i className="laserTargetGlow" />
                            <i className={"laserCutMark c" + Math.min(3, h)} />
                            <b className="toolHitCount">{h}/3</b>
                            {active ? (
                                <div key={pulse} className="laserLocalBeam">
                                    <i />
                                    <b />
                                    <em />
                                </div>
                            ) : null}
                        </motion.button>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <button
                className={"laserToolDock " + (toolArmed ? "selected" : "")}
                onPointerDown={armTool}
            >
                <span>{toolArmed ? "LASER ACTIVE" : "ACTIVATE LASER"}</span>
                <i />
            </button>
            {toolArmed && pointerInside ? (
                <div
                    className={
                        "laserCursorTool " + (firing >= 0 ? "firing" : "")
                    }
                    style={{ left: toolPos.x + "%", top: toolPos.y + "%" }}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <i className="laserCursorBody" />
                    <i className="laserCursorNozzle" />
                    <i className="laserCursorGlow" />
                    <span>LASER</span>
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="literalStatus laserStatus">
                <b>
                    {completed >= words.length
                        ? "ALL BUBBLES LASERED"
                        : toolArmed
                          ? `${completed} / ${words.length} DESTROYED · 3 LASERS PER BUBBLE`
                          : "ACTIVATE THE LASER"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {toolArmed
                        ? "Point at any bubble and click. Three laser shots destroy that bubble."
                        : "Activate once. Your mouse becomes the laser until every bubble is gone."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {completed} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function DetachEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const [links, setLinks] = React.useState([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
    const [lastCut, setLastCut] = React.useState(-1)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setLinks([0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
        setLastCut(-1)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const t = displayText(entries[0] || "THIS THOUGHT", 52)
    const cut = (i) => {
        if (!links.includes(i)) return
        setLastCut(i)
        sfx("tap")
        vibrate(12)
        setLinks((a) => {
            const n = a.filter((x) => x !== i)
            if (!n.length) setTimeout(() => onDone(220), 700)
            return n
        })
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena detachArena premiumArena">
            <div className="detachGlow" />
            <motion.div
                className="detachWord premiumDetachWord"
                animate={
                    reduced ? {} : { y: [-4, 4, -4], scale: [1, 1.018, 1] }
                }
                transition={{
                    duration: 2.8,
                    repeat: Infinity,
                    ease: "easeInOut",
                }}
            >
                {t}
            </motion.div>
            <div className="cords premiumCords">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
                    <button
                        key={i}
                        className={
                            "cord premiumCord " +
                            (!links.includes(i) ? "cut" : "")
                        }
                        onClick={() => cut(i)}
                        style={{ ["--ci"]: i }}
                    >
                        <span>⌁</span>
                        <i />
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {lastCut >= 0 ? (
                <PremiumBurst
                    key={lastCut + "-" + links.length}
                    x={20 + lastCut * 15}
                    y={64}
                    tone={lastCut % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                />
            ) : null}
            <div className="detachCount">{5 - links.length}/5 RELEASED</div>
            <div className="hint">TAP EACH CONNECTION</div>
        </div>
    )
}
function RhythmEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, tapOutBpm }) {
    const [beat, setBeat] = React.useState(0),
        [hits, setHits] = React.useState(0)
    const [perfect, setPerfect] = React.useState(0)
    const lastBeat = React.useRef(Date.now())
    const tapOutInterval = Math.round(
        60000 / Math.max(40, Math.min(180, Number(tapOutBpm) || 92))
    )
    const beatInterval = game.id === 67 ? tapOutInterval : reduced ? 900 : 650
    const hitWindow = Math.min(
        340,
        Math.max(170, Math.round(beatInterval * 0.46))
    )
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setBeat(0)
        setHits(0)
        setPerfect(0)
        lastBeat.current = Date.now()
        const id = setInterval(() => {
            setBeat((b) => (b + 1) % 4)
            lastBeat.current = Date.now()
        }, beatInterval)
        return () => clearInterval(id)
    }, [game.id, reduced, beatInterval])
    const tap = (side) => {
        const delta = Date.now() - lastBeat.current
        const good = delta < hitWindow
        const n = hits + 1
        setHits(n)
        setPerfect((p) => (good ? p + 1 : p))
        sfx(good ? "pop" : "tap")
        vibrate(good ? 18 : 8)
        if (n >= 8) setTimeout(() => onDone(200 + (good ? 80 : 0)), 720)
    }
    const t = displayText(entries[0] || "THIS LOOP", 38)
    const remain = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(t.length * (1 - hits / 8)))
    const visible = t.slice(0, remain)
    const vanished = t.slice(remain)
    return (
        <div className="arena rhythmArena premiumArena">
            <div className="rhythmTunnel">
                {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => (
                    <i key={i} style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.11}s` }} />
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="rhythmWord premiumRhythmWord">
                <span>{visible}</span>
                <em>{vanished}</em>
            </div>
            <div className="beatRail">
                <i
                    className="travelPulse"
                    style={{ animationDuration: beatInterval * 4 + "ms" }}
                />
            </div>
            <div className="beatRow">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <motion.button
                        key={i}
                        className={
                            "beat premiumBeat " + (beat === i ? "on" : "")
                        }
                        onClick={() => tap(i)}
                        animate={
                            beat === i && !reduced
                                ? {
                                      scale: [1, 1.24, 1],
                                      boxShadow: [
                                          "0 0 8px rgba(79,231,255,.15)",
                                          "0 0 42px rgba(79,231,255,.7)",
                                          "0 0 8px rgba(79,231,255,.15)",
                                      ],
                                  }
                                : {}
                        }
                    >
                        {i % 2 ? "R" : "L"}
                    </motion.button>
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                FLOW × {hits}
                <small>
                    PERFECT {perfect}
                    {game.id === 67
                        ? ` · ${Math.round(60000 / beatInterval)} BPM`
                        : ""}
                </small>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function sortLabels(game) {
    if (game.id === 56) return ["PROOF", "ASSUMPTION", "UNKNOWN"]
    if (game.id === 72) return ["FACT", "STORY", "MAYBE"]
    if (game.id === 83) return ["NOW", "LATER", "NOT MINE"]
    if (game.id === 84) return ["MINE", "NOT MINE", "PARK"]
    if (game.id === 85) return ["CONTROL", "INFLUENCE", "OUTSIDE MY CONTROL"]
    if (game.id === 86) return ["FACT", "STORY", "UNSURE"]
    return ["KEEP", "LATER", "RELEASE"]
}
function SortEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const sourceWords = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [batchStart, setBatchStart] = React.useState(0),
        [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [picked, setPicked] = React.useState(-1)
    const items = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            sourceWords.slice(
                batchStart,
                batchStart + MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            ),
        [sourceWords, batchStart]
    )
    const labels = sortLabels(game)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setBatchStart(0)
        setIdx(0)
        setPicked(-1)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setPicked(-1)
    }, [batchStart, items.length])
    const choose = (lane) => {
        if (picked >= 0) return
        setPicked(lane)
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(10)
        const n = idx + 1
        setTimeout(() => {
            setPicked(-1)
            if (n >= items.length) {
                if (batchStart + items.length < sourceWords.length)
                    setBatchStart(batchStart + items.length)
                else setTimeout(() => onDone(180), 400)
            } else setIdx(n)
        }, 620)
    }
    const laneX =
        labels.length === 3
            ? [-190, 0, 190]
            : labels.map((_, i) => (i - (labels.length - 1) / 2) * 170)
    return (
        <div className="arena sortArena premiumArena cinematicSortArena">
            <div className="sortConveyor">
                <i />
                <i />
                <i />
            </div>
            <div className="sortLaneGlow" />
            {idx < items.length ? (
                <>
                    <motion.div
                        key={batchStart + "-" + idx}
                        className={
                            "sortCard premiumSortCard allCircularBubble " +
                            (picked >= 0 ? "sorting" : "")
                        }
                        initial={{
                            y: -36,
                            opacity: 0,
                            scale: 0.82,
                            rotateX: -18,
                        }}
                        animate={
                            picked >= 0
                                ? {
                                      x: laneX[picked] || 0,
                                      y: 150,
                                      opacity: [1, 1, 0.2, 0],
                                      scale: [1, 1.04, 0.72, 0.3],
                                      rotate: [
                                          0,
                                          picked === 0
                                              ? -9
                                              : picked === 2
                                                ? 9
                                                : 0,
                                          picked === 0
                                              ? -18
                                              : picked === 2
                                                ? 18
                                                : 0,
                                      ],
                                      filter: [
                                          "blur(0px)",
                                          "blur(0px)",
                                          "blur(2px)",
                                          "blur(10px)",
                                      ],
                                  }
                                : {
                                      x: 0,
                                      y: 0,
                                      opacity: 1,
                                      scale: 1,
                                      rotateX: 0,
                                  }
                        }
                        transition={
                            picked >= 0
                                ? {
                                      duration: 0.6,
                                      times: [0, 0.25, 0.72, 1],
                                      ease: [0.16, 0.82, 0.22, 1],
                                  }
                                : {
                                      type: "spring",
                                      stiffness: 150,
                                      damping: 18,
                                  }
                        }
                    >
                        <span>{displayText(items[idx], 58)}</span>
                        <i className="sortGlow" />
                        <i className="sortReflection" />
                    </motion.div>
                    <div className="bucketRow premiumBuckets">
                        {labels.map((l, i) => (
                            <button
                                key={l}
                                onClick={() => choose(i)}
                                className={picked === i ? "picked" : ""}
                            >
                                <i>{["◈", "◇", "○"][i] || "◇"}</i>
                                <span>{l}</span>
                            </button>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                    {picked >= 0 ? (
                        <PremiumBurst
                            x={labels.length === 3 ? [25, 50, 75][picked] : 50}
                            y={78}
                            tone={picked % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                        />
                    ) : null}
                    <div className="sortProgress">
                        {Math.min(batchStart + idx + 1, sourceWords.length)} /{" "}
                        {sourceWords.length}
                    </div>
                    <div className="hint">
                        YOU choose the lane. There is no hidden right answer.
                    </div>
                </>
            ) : (
                <motion.div
                    className="doneGlyph premiumDone"
                    initial={{ scale: 0.3, opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{
                        scale: [0.3, 1.2, 1],
                        opacity: 1,
                        filter: ["blur(8px)", "blur(0px)", "blur(0px)"],
                    }}
                >
                    ✓
                </motion.div>
            )}
        </div>
    )
}
function BalanceEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const [v, setV] = React.useState(game.id === 103 ? 15 : 18)
    const [done, setDone] = React.useState(false)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setV(game.id === 103 ? 15 : 18)
        setDone(false)
        onProgress?.(0, progressLabel(game, 0))
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const finish = (x) => {
        if (done) return
        if (x >= 42 && x <= 58) {
            setDone(true)
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(24)
            setTimeout(() => onDone(230), 750)
        }
    }
    const t = displayText(entries[0] || "THIS", 38)
    const tilt = (v - 50) / 7
    return (
        <div className="arena balanceArena premiumArena">
            <div className="balanceAura" />
            <div className="goodZone premiumGoodZone">
                <span>GOOD-ENOUGH ZONE</span>
                <i />
            </div>
            <motion.div
                className="balanceBeam premiumBeam"
                animate={{ rotate: tilt }}
                transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 95, damping: 14 }}
            >
                <motion.div
                    className="weight premiumWeight"
                    animate={reduced ? {} : { y: [-2, 2, -2] }}
                    transition={{ duration: 1.8, repeat: Infinity }}
                >
                    {t}
                </motion.div>
                <i className="beamLight" />
            </motion.div>
            <div className="balanceReadout">
                <b>{Math.round(v)}</b>
                <span>{done ? "STABLE" : "FIND THE RANGE"}</span>
            </div>
            <input
                className="premiumRange"
                aria-label="balance"
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={v}
                onChange={(e) => {
                    const x = +e.target.value
                    setV(x)
                    const pr = pct(100 - Math.abs(50 - x) * 2)
                    onProgress?.(pr, progressLabel(game, pr))
                    finish(x)
                }}
            />
            {done ? <PremiumBurst x={50} y={48} tone="cyan" big /> : null}
            <div className="hint">
                Aim for the broad middle — not a perfect pixel.
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function LensEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [v, setV] = React.useState(0)
    const done = React.useRef(false)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setV(0)
        done.current = false
        onProgress?.(0, progressLabel(game, 0))
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const t = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS"), 44)
    const ch = (x) => {
        setV(x)
        const p = pct(((idx + x / 100) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, progressLabel(game, p))
        if (x > 88 && !done.current) {
            done.current = true
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(18)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(220)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setV(0)
                    done.current = false
                }
            }, 520)
        }
    }
    const s = Math.max(0.15, 1.8 - v / 62)
    return (
        <div className="arena lensArena premiumArena">
            <div className="spaceDots premiumSpaceDots" />
            <div className="lensRings">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <i
                        key={i}
                        style={{
                            transform: `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(${1 + i * 0.42 + v / 240})`,
                            opacity: 0.32 - i * 0.05,
                        }}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>
            <motion.div
                key={idx}
                className="lensWord premiumLensWord"
                animate={{
                    scale: s,
                    opacity: 1 - v / 190,
                    filter: `blur(${v > 82 ? (v - 82) / 7 : 0}px)`,
                }}
                transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 110, damping: 18 }}
            >
                {t}
            </motion.div>
            <div className="perspectiveReadout">
                <b>{Math.round(v)}%</b>
                <span>
                    {v < 30 ? "CLOSE UP" : v < 70 ? "WIDER FRAME" : "DISTANCE"}
                </span>
            </div>
            <input
                className="premiumRange"
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="100"
                value={v}
                onChange={(e) => ch(+e.target.value)}
            />
            {v > 88 ? <PremiumBurst x={50} y={46} tone="violet" /> : null}
            <div className="hint">
                CHANGE THE FRAME · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function TransformEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0)
    const [slider, setSlider] = React.useState(100)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setStep(0)
        setSlider(100)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const tx = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS THOUGHT"), 64)
    const sliderMode = [29, 55, 104].includes(game.id)
    const nextWord = (bonus = 0) => {
        if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(230 + bonus), 300)
        else {
            setIdx((i) => i + 1)
            setStep(0)
            setSlider(100)
        }
    }
    const go = () => {
        const n = step + 1
        setStep(n)
        sfx(n >= 4 ? "win" : "soft")
        vibrate(n >= 4 ? 22 : 8)
        if (n >= 4) setTimeout(() => nextWord(), 420)
    }
    if (sliderMode)
        return (
            <div className="arena transformArena premiumArena">
                <div
                    className="productionHalo"
                    style={{
                        opacity: slider / 100,
                        transform: `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(${0.65 + slider / 140})`,
                    }}
                />
                <motion.div
                    key={idx}
                    className="transformWord premiumTransformWord"
                    animate={{
                        fontSize: `${18 + slider * 0.28}px`,
                        letterSpacing: `${slider / 35}px`,
                        opacity: 0.4 + slider / 170,
                        filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 ${slider / 4}px rgba(67,224,255,.7))`,
                    }}
                    transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 90, damping: 18 }}
                >
                    {tx}
                </motion.div>
                <div className="productionMeter">
                    <span>PRODUCTION</span>
                    <b>{slider}%</b>
                </div>
                <input
                    className="premiumRange"
                    type="range"
                    min="1"
                    max="100"
                    value={slider}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                        const x = +e.target.value
                        setSlider(x)
                        if (x < 8) setTimeout(() => nextWord(10), 260)
                    }}
                />
                <div className="hint">
                    TURN THE PRODUCTION DOWN · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
                </div>
            </div>
        )
    const styles = [
        { fontWeight: 1000, letterSpacing: "-.04em", transform: "scale(1)" },
        {
            fontFamily: "Georgia,serif",
            fontStyle: "italic",
            transform: "scale(.95) rotate(-1deg)",
        },
        { letterSpacing: ".18em", fontWeight: 600, transform: "scale(.9)" },
        { transform: "rotate(-2deg) scale(.78)", opacity: 0.7 },
    ]
    return (
        <div className="arena transformArena premiumArena">
            <div className="costumeField">
                {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => (
                    <i key={i} style={{ ["--ti"]: i }} />
                ))}
            </div>
            <motion.div
                key={idx + "-" + step}
                className="transformWord premiumTransformWord"
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.68, filter: "blur(12px)" }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px)" }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.42 }}
                style={styles[step % styles.length]}
            >
                {tx}
            </motion.div>
            <button className="bigAction premiumBigAction" onClick={go}>
                {game.id === 108 ? "SHUFFLE SAME WORDS" : "CHANGE THE COSTUME"}
            </button>
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                {Math.min(step, 4)} / 4 · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function CatchEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [caught, setCaught] = React.useState(0)
    const [p, setP] = React.useState({ x: 42, y: 40 })
    const [trail, setTrail] = React.useState([])
    const t = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS THOUGHT"), 30)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setCaught(0)
        setTrail([])
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const id = setInterval(
            () =>
                setP((q) => {
                    setTrail((a) => [...a.slice(-4), { ...q, id: Date.now() }])
                    return {
                        x: 8 + Math.random() * 76,
                        y: 12 + Math.random() * 62,
                    }
                }),
            reduced ? 1200 : 720
        )
        return () => clearInterval(id)
    }, [game.id, reduced, entries.join("|"), idx])
    const hit = () => {
        const n = caught + 1
        setCaught(n)
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(12)
        if (n >= 4)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(190)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setCaught(0)
                }
            }, 420)
        setP((q) => {
            setTrail((a) => [...a.slice(-4), { ...q, id: Date.now() + 1 }])
            return { x: 8 + Math.random() * 76, y: 12 + Math.random() * 62 }
        })
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena catchArena premiumArena">
            <div className="catchField" />
            {trail.map((q, i) => (
                <i
                    key={q.id + i}
                    className="catchTrail"
                    style={{
                        left: q.x + "%",
                        top: q.y + "%",
                        opacity: ((i + 1) / (trail.length + 1)) * 0.24,
                    }}
                />
            ))}
            <motion.button
                key={idx}
                className="catchTarget premiumCatch allCircularBubble"
                onClick={hit}
                animate={{
                    left: p.x + "%",
                    top: p.y + "%",
                    rotate: [-2, 2, -2],
                    boxShadow: [
                        "0 0 16px rgba(79,231,255,.12)",
                        "0 0 36px rgba(79,231,255,.38)",
                        "0 0 16px rgba(79,231,255,.12)",
                    ],
                }}
                transition={{
                    left: { type: "spring", stiffness: 120, damping: 18 },
                    top: { type: "spring", stiffness: 120, damping: 18 },
                    rotate: { duration: 1.4, repeat: Infinity },
                    boxShadow: { duration: 1.4, repeat: Infinity },
                }}
            >
                {t}
                <i />
            </motion.button>
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                CAUGHT {caught} / 4 · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function choiceLabels(game, entries) {
    if (game.id === 35) return ["LET PASS", "LET PASS AGAIN"]
    if (game.id === 65) return ["PAUSE", "PAUSE AGAIN"]
    if (game.id === 80) return ["DON’T TAP", "I WAITED"]
    if (game.id === 89) return [entries[0] || "DOOR A", entries[1] || "DOOR B"]
    if (game.id === 90) return ["FLIP RANDOM COIN", "NOTICE MY REACTION"]
    if (game.id === 98) return ["PICK THE WORD", "PULL LEVER"]
    return ["OPTION A", "OPTION B"]
}
function ChoiceEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0)
    const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState(-1)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setStep(0)
        setPicked(-1)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const currentEntries =
        game.id === 89
            ? [
                  words[idx] || "DOOR A",
                  words[Math.min(idx + 1, words.length - 1)] || "DOOR B",
              ]
            : [words[idx] || game.name]
    const labs = choiceLabels(game, currentEntries)
    const noTap = game.id === 80
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (!noTap) return
        const id = setTimeout(() => {
            setStep(2)
            sfx("win")
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(260)
            else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                setStep(0)
                setPicked(-1)
            }
        }, 5000)
        return () => clearTimeout(id)
    }, [noTap, game.id, idx, words.length])
    const choose = (i) => {
        if (noTap) return
        setPicked(i)
        const n = step + 1
        setStep(n)
        sfx(n >= 2 ? "win" : "soft")
        vibrate(10)
        if (n >= 2)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(220)
                else {
                    setIdx((x) => x + 1)
                    setStep(0)
                    setPicked(-1)
                }
            }, 520)
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena choiceArena premiumArena">
            <div className="choiceGlow" />
            <motion.div
                key={idx}
                className="choiceObject premiumChoiceObject allCircularBubble"
                animate={reduced ? {} : { y: [-4, 5, -4], scale: [1, 1.02, 1] }}
                transition={{
                    duration: 2.6,
                    repeat: Infinity,
                    ease: "easeInOut",
                }}
            >
                {displayText(words[idx] || game.name, 50)}
            </motion.div>
            <div className="choiceRow premiumChoices">
                {labs.map((l, i) => (
                    <motion.button
                        key={i}
                        disabled={noTap}
                        onClick={() => choose(i)}
                        className={step > i || picked === i ? "picked" : ""}
                        whileTap={noTap ? {} : { scale: 0.94 }}
                    >
                        <i>{["◈", "◇", "○"][i] || "◇"}</i>
                        <span>{l}</span>
                    </motion.button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {picked >= 0 && !noTap ? (
                <PremiumBurst
                    key={picked + "-" + step}
                    x={
                        labs.length === 2
                            ? picked
                                ? 65
                                : 35
                            : 25 + picked * 25
                    }
                    y={70}
                    tone={picked % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                />
            ) : null}
            {noTap ? (
                <div className="waitRing premiumWaitRing">
                    <i style={{ animationDuration: "5s" }} />
                    <b>5</b>
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="hint">
                {noTap
                    ? "DO NOTHING FOR 5 SECONDS"
                    : "Explore. This game does not choose for you."}{" "}
                · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function CleanseEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            wordsFor(
                entries,
                MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
            ),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [p, setP] = React.useState(0)
    const pRef = React.useRef(0)
    const [releasedIndices, setReleasedIndices] = React.useState([])
    const releasedRef = React.useRef([])
    const [holdingIndex, setHoldingIndex] = React.useState(null)
    const holdingIndexRef = React.useRef(null)
    const holdT0Ref = React.useRef(0)
    const [releasingIndex, setReleasingIndex] = React.useState(null)
    const [pulse, setPulse] = React.useState(0)
    const timer = React.useRef(null)
    const finishTimer = React.useRef([])
    const finishLock = React.useRef(false)
    const cleanseStepVisualHoldMs = 3200
    const stopChargeTimer = React.useCallback(() => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        timer.current = null
    }, [])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        stopChargeTimer()
        setP(0)
        pRef.current = 0
        setReleasedIndices([])
        releasedRef.current = []
        setHoldingIndex(null)
        holdingIndexRef.current = null
        setReleasingIndex(null)
        setPulse(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% CLEANSED")
        finishTimer.current.forEach(clearTimeout)
        finishLock.current = false
        finishTimer.current = []
        return () => {
            stopChargeTimer()
            finishTimer.current.forEach(clearTimeout)
        }
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const beginHold = React.useCallback(
        (index, e) => {
            if (releasingIndex !== null || releasedRef.current.includes(index))
                return
            e?.preventDefault?.()
            e?.stopPropagation?.()
            try {
                if (
                    e?.currentTarget &&
                    e?.pointerId !== undefined &&
                    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture
                ) {
                    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)
                }
            } catch {}
            stopChargeTimer()
            holdingIndexRef.current = index
            setHoldingIndex(index)
            pRef.current = 0
            setP(0)
            sfx("soft")
            vibrate(8)
            // F6/v1: the charge follows the time held (full in ~1.06 s, same speed as before) — a busy phone that
            // drops interval ticks no longer leaves a real 1.5 s hold at 13 % (CLEANSE stuck at 0 %)
            const holdT0 = performance.now()
            holdT0Ref.current = holdT0
            timer.current = setInterval(() => {
                if (holdingIndexRef.current !== index) return
                const next = Math.min(100, Math.max(pRef.current + 3.2, ((performance.now() - holdT0) / 1062) * 100))
                pRef.current = next
                setP(next)
                if (next >= 100) stopChargeTimer()
            }, 34)
        },
        [releasingIndex, sfx, stopChargeTimer]
    )
    const finishHold = React.useCallback(
        (index, e) => {
            e?.preventDefault?.()
            e?.stopPropagation?.()
            if (holdingIndexRef.current !== index) return
            try {
                if (
                    e?.currentTarget &&
                    e?.pointerId !== undefined &&
                    e.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
                ) {
                    e.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)
                }
            } catch {}
            stopChargeTimer()
            const charge = Math.max(pRef.current, holdT0Ref.current ? ((performance.now() - holdT0Ref.current) / 1062) * 100 : 0)
            holdT0Ref.current = 0
            holdingIndexRef.current = null
            setHoldingIndex(null)
            if (charge < 72) {
                const fallback = Math.max(0, Math.min(36, charge * 0.38))
                pRef.current = fallback
                setP(fallback)
                sfx("soft")
                finishTimer.current.push(
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        pRef.current = 0
                        setP(0)
                    }, 280)
                )
                return
            }
            if (
                releasedRef.current.includes(index) ||
                releasingIndex !== null
            ) {
                pRef.current = 0
                setP(0)
                return
            }
            const nextReleased = [...releasedRef.current, index]
            releasedRef.current = nextReleased
            setReleasingIndex(index)
            setPulse((v) => v + 1)
            pRef.current = 100
            setP(100)
            const isLast = nextReleased.length >= words.length
            sfx(isLast ? "win" : "pop")
            vibrate(isLast ? 34 : 24)
            const total =
                (nextReleased.length / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100
            onProgress?.(total, `${Math.round(total)}% CLEANSED`)
            finishTimer.current.push(
                setTimeout(
                    () => {
                        setReleasedIndices((prev) =>
                            prev.length >= releasedRef.current.length
                                ? prev
                                : releasedRef.current.slice()
                        )
                    },
                    isLast ? 170 : cleanseStepVisualHoldMs
                )
            )
            finishTimer.current.push(
                setTimeout(
                    () => {
                        setReleasingIndex(null)
                        pRef.current = 0
                        setP(0)
                    },
                    isLast ? 650 : 720
                )
            )
        },
        [onProgress, releasingIndex, sfx, stopChargeTimer, words.length]
    )
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (releasedIndices.length < words.length || finishLock.current) return
        finishLock.current = true
        stopChargeTimer()
        const t = setTimeout(() => onDone(340 + words.length * 25), 2200)
        // no per-run cleanup: once the lock is set this hand-off must fire (a dep change used to clear it while the
        // lock stayed set = 100% and no reveal); unmount / new entries still clear it via finishTimer above
        finishTimer.current.push(t)
    }, [releasedIndices.length, words.length])
    const complete = releasedIndices.length >= words.length
    const cleanseSlots =
        words.length <= 5
            ? [
                  { x: 15, y: 15 },
                  { x: 50, y: 11 },
                  { x: 85, y: 15 },
                  { x: 31, y: 54 },
                  { x: 73, y: 54 },
              ]
            : [
                  { x: 15, y: 14 },
                  { x: 50, y: 10 },
                  { x: 85, y: 14 },
                  { x: 29, y: 53 },
                  { x: 57, y: 61 },
                  { x: 83, y: 53 },
              ]
    const emotionProfile = releaseEmotionProfile(entries)
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena cleanseArena premiumArena " +
                (complete ? "released" : "")
            }
        >
            <div className="cleanseSpace" />
            <div className="cleanseWaveField" style={{ opacity: p / 115 }} />

            {releasingIndex !== null ? (
                <React.Fragment key={pulse}>
                    <motion.i
                        className="cleanseShock w1"
                        initial={{ scale: 0.2, opacity: 0.9 }}
                        animate={{ scale: 3.4, opacity: 0 }}
                        transition={{ duration: 1.05, ease: "easeOut" }}
                    />
                    <motion.i
                        className="cleanseShock w2"
                        initial={{ scale: 0.2, opacity: 0.7 }}
                        animate={{ scale: 2.7, opacity: 0 }}
                        transition={{
                            duration: 1.25,
                            delay: 0.08,
                            ease: "easeOut",
                        }}
                    />
                </React.Fragment>
            ) : null}

            <div className="lotusCore" style={{ ["--charge"]: p }}>
                <div
                    className="chargeRing"
                    style={{
                        background: `conic-gradient(var(--a) ${p * 3.6}deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0deg)`,
                    }}
                />
                <div className="lotus">
                    {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => (
                        <i key={i} style={{ ["--r"]: `${i * 36}deg` }} />
                    ))}
                    <b>
                        {complete
                            ? "RELEASED"
                            : releasingIndex !== null
                              ? "RELEASE"
                              : Math.round(p) + "%"}
                    </b>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="stoneRing">
                {words.map((w, i) => {
                    const slot = cleanseSlots[i % cleanseSlots.length]
                    const gone = releasedIndices.includes(i)
                    const releasing = releasingIndex === i
                    const holding = holdingIndex === i
                    const pendingGone = releasedRef.current.includes(i)
                    const available = !pendingGone && releasingIndex === null
                    return (
                        <motion.div
                            key={i}
                            className={
                                "cleanseStone allCircularBubble " +
                                (gone ? "gone " : "") +
                                (holding ? "active " : "")
                            }
                            style={{
                                left: slot.x + "%",
                                top: slot.y + "%",
                            }}
                            initial={false}
                            animate={
                                gone
                                    ? {
                                          scale: [1, 1.18, 0.2],
                                          opacity: [1, 0.95, 0],
                                          rotate: [0, i % 2 ? 18 : -18, 48],
                                          filter: [
                                              "blur(0px) brightness(1)",
                                              "blur(2px) brightness(2)",
                                              "blur(16px) brightness(1.6)",
                                          ],
                                          y: [0, -8, -42],
                                      }
                                    : releasing
                                      ? {
                                            scale: [1, 1.2, 0.18],
                                            opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                            rotate: [0, i % 2 ? 14 : -14, 42],
                                            filter: [
                                                "blur(0px) brightness(1)",
                                                "blur(1px) brightness(2.25)",
                                                "blur(15px) brightness(1.5)",
                                            ],
                                            y: [0, -10, -48],
                                        }
                                      : reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : {
                                              y: [-3, 5, -3],
                                              scale: holding
                                                  ? [1.04, 1.08, 1.04]
                                                  : [1, 1.022, 1],
                                          }
                            }
                            transition={
                                gone || releasing
                                    ? {
                                          duration: 0.72,
                                          ease: [0.18, 0.8, 0.2, 1],
                                      }
                                    : {
                                          duration: 2.4 + i * 0.17,
                                          repeat: Infinity,
                                          ease: "easeInOut",
                                      }
                            }
                        >
                            <span>{displayText(w, 30)}</span>
                            <i className="stoneCrack" />

                            {!gone ? (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className={
                                        "cleanseBubbleHoldButton " +
                                        (available ? "active " : "") +
                                        (holding ? "holding " : "")
                                    }
                                    style={{
                                        ["--hold-pct"]: `${holding ? p : 0}%`,
                                        ["--hold-delay"]: `${(i % 6) * 0.11}s`,
                                    }}
                                    disabled={!available}
                                    onPointerDown={(e) => beginHold(i, e)}
                                    onPointerUp={(e) => finishHold(i, e)}
                                    onPointerCancel={(e) => finishHold(i, e)}
                                    onLostPointerCapture={(e) => {
                                        if (holdingIndexRef.current === i)
                                            finishHold(i, e)
                                    }}
                                    onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                                >
                                    {`HOLD TO ${emotionProfile.actions[i % emotionProfile.actions.length]}`}
                                </button>
                            ) : null}

                            {releasing ? (
                                <PremiumBurst
                                    x={50}
                                    y={50}
                                    tone={i % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                                />
                            ) : null}
                        </motion.div>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function ChargeEngine(p) {
    const { game, entries, onDone, sfx, onProgress } = p
    if (game.id === 109) return <CleanseEngine {...p} />
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [v, setV] = React.useState(0)
    const [released, setReleased] = React.useState(false)
    const timer = React.useRef(null)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setV(0)
        setReleased(false)
        return () => clearInterval(timer.current)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const start = () => {
        if (released) return
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        timer.current = setInterval(
            () =>
                setV((x) => {
                    const n = Math.min(100, x + 3)
                    const p = pct(
                        ((idx + n / 100) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100
                    )
                    onProgress?.(p, progressLabel(game, p))
                    return n
                }),
            30
        )
    }
    const end = () => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        if (v >= 78 && !released) {
            setReleased(true)
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(30)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(280)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setV(0)
                    setReleased(false)
                }
            }, 500)
        }
    }
    const t = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS"), 42)
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena chargeArena premiumArena " + (released ? "released" : "")
            }
        >
            <div className="depthHalo" />
            {released ? <PremiumBurst x={50} y={42} tone="cyan" big /> : null}
            <motion.div
                key={idx}
                className="chargeOrb premiumCharge allCircularBubble"
                animate={
                    released
                        ? { scale: [1, 1.16, 0.82], opacity: [1, 1, 0.15] }
                        : { scale: 0.82 + v / 420 }
                }
                transition={{ duration: released ? 0.9 : 0.08 }}
            >
                <i className="orbCurrent" style={{ opacity: v / 100 }} />
                <span>{t}</span>
                <b>{released ? "RELEASED" : Math.round(v) + "%"}</b>
            </motion.div>
            {!released ? (
                <button
                    className="bigAction"
                    onPointerDown={start}
                    onPointerUp={end}
                    onPointerCancel={end}
                    onPointerLeave={end}
                >
                    HOLD TO CHARGE · RELEASE
                </button>
            ) : (
                <div className="releaseCaption">ENERGY RELEASED</div>
            )}
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function EraseEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [gone, setGone] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setGone([])
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const t = displayText(activeWord(words, idx, "THIS LABEL"), 52)
    const erase = (i) => {
        if (gone.includes(i)) return
        const n = [...gone, i]
        setGone(n)
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(6)
        if (n.length >= 10)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(210)
                else {
                    setIdx((x) => x + 1)
                    setGone([])
                }
            }, 360)
    }
    const pct = gone.length * 10
    return (
        <div className="arena eraseArena premiumArena">
            <div className="eraseDust" style={{ opacity: pct / 125 }} />
            <motion.div
                key={idx}
                className="eraseWord premiumEraseWord"
                animate={{
                    opacity: 1 - pct / 125,
                    filter: `blur(${pct / 22}px)`,
                    scale: 1 + pct / 700,
                }}
            >
                {t}
            </motion.div>
            <div className="scratchGrid premiumScratch">
                {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => (
                    <button
                        key={i}
                        onPointerEnter={(e) => {
                            if (e.buttons) erase(i)
                        }}
                        onClick={() => erase(i)}
                        className={gone.includes(i) ? "gone" : ""}
                    >
                        <i />
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="eraseSweep" style={{ width: pct + "%" }} />
            <div className="combo premiumCombo">
                CLEARED {pct}% · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
            {pct === 100 ? (
                <PremiumBurst x={50} y={48} tone="cyan" big />
            ) : null}
        </div>
    )
}
function SequenceEngine({ game, entries, onDone, sfx, reduced }) {
    if (game.id === 50)
        return (
            <UnfinishedSentence entries={entries} onDone={onDone} sfx={sfx} />
        )
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const seq = [2, 0, 3]
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0)
    const [pulse, setPulse] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setStep(0)
        setPulse(0)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|")])
    const tap = (i) => {
        if (i !== seq[step]) {
            sfx("tap")
            setStep(0)
            setPulse((x) => x + 1)
            return
        }
        const n = step + 1
        setStep(n)
        setPulse((x) => x + 1)
        sfx(n >= seq.length ? "win" : "soft")
        vibrate(n >= seq.length ? 24 : 8)
        if (n >= seq.length)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) onDone(260)
                else {
                    setIdx((x) => x + 1)
                    setStep(0)
                }
            }, 420)
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena sequenceArena premiumArena">
            <div className="sequenceCircuit">
                {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                    <i key={i} className={step > i ? "lit" : ""} />
                ))}
            </div>
            <motion.div
                key={idx}
                className="sequenceObject premiumSequenceObject"
                animate={
                    step >= seq.length
                        ? { scale: [1, 1.12, 0.88], opacity: [1, 1, 0.18] }
                        : reduced
                          ? {}
                          : {
                                boxShadow: [
                                    "0 0 14px rgba(79,231,255,.08)",
                                    "0 0 38px rgba(79,231,255,.28)",
                                    "0 0 14px rgba(79,231,255,.08)",
                                ],
                            }
                }
                transition={{
                    duration: 1.4,
                    repeat: step >= seq.length ? 0 : Infinity,
                }}
            >
                {displayText(words[idx] || "THIS URGENCY", 48)}
                <i />
            </motion.div>
            <div className="sequenceRow premiumSequenceRow">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <motion.button
                        key={i}
                        onClick={() => tap(i)}
                        className={
                            (seq[step] === i ? "next " : "") +
                            (seq.slice(0, step).includes(i) ? "done" : "")
                        }
                        animate={
                            seq[step] === i && !reduced
                                ? { scale: [1, 1.12, 1] }
                                : {}
                        }
                    >
                        {["◇", "○", "△", "□"][i]}
                    </motion.button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {pulse > 0 ? (
                <PremiumBurst
                    key={pulse}
                    x={50}
                    y={68}
                    tone={step >= seq.length ? "gold" : "cyan"}
                />
            ) : null}
            <div className="hint">
                FOLLOW THE 3-STEP SIGNAL · {idx + 1}/{words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function UnfinishedSentence({ entries, onDone, sfx }) {
    const [parts, setParts] = React.useState(["", "", ""])
    const [show, setShow] = React.useState(false)
    const update = (i, v) => setParts((p) => p.map((x, j) => (j === i ? v : x)))
    const finish = () => {
        setShow(true)
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(18)
        setTimeout(() => onDone(260), 900)
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena chainArena premiumArena">
            <div className="chainDepth">
                {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
                    <i
                        key={i}
                        style={{
                            transform: `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(${1 + i * 0.38})`,
                            opacity: 0.18 - i * 0.03,
                        }}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>
            <motion.div
                className="chainStart premiumChainStart"
                animate={show ? { scale: 0.82, opacity: 0.65 } : { scale: 1 }}
            >
                {displayText(entries[0] || "WHAT IF…", 60)}
            </motion.div>
            {parts.map((p, i) => (
                <motion.div
                    key={i}
                    className="chainLink premiumChainLink"
                    animate={
                        show
                            ? {
                                  x: (i + 1) * 18,
                                  scale: 1 - i * 0.12,
                                  opacity: 0.78 - i * 0.18,
                              }
                            : { opacity: 1 - i * 0.16, scale: 1 - i * 0.08 }
                    }
                    transition={{ type: "spring", stiffness: 100, damping: 16 }}
                >
                    <span>AND THEN…</span>
                    <input
                        value={p}
                        onChange={(e) => update(i, e.target.value)}
                        placeholder={
                            i === 0 ? "what happens next?" : "and then?"
                        }
                    />
                    <i />
                </motion.div>
            ))}
            <button
                className="bigAction premiumBigAction"
                disabled={!parts[0].trim()}
                onClick={finish}
            >
                {show ? "DISTANCE REVEALED" : "SHOW ME THE DISTANCE"}
            </button>
        </div>
    )
}
function expandUploadImageSlots(images = [], slots = IMAGE_ONLY_BUBBLE_SLOTS) {
    const src = (images || [])
        .map((x) => String(x || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES)
    if (!src.length) return []
    const totalSlots = clamp(
        slots,
        MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
        MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
    )
    // F8 six-image rule, spread (never all copies of one image together): 2 -> A B A B A B, 3 -> A B C A B C,
    // 4 -> A B C D A B, 5 -> A B C D E A, 6 -> one each (same as the shared tsSpreadUploads)
    return Array.from({ length: totalSlots }, (_, i) => src[i % src.length])
}
function uploadImageAt(images = [], index = 0) {
    if (!images.length) return null
    return (
        images[((index % images.length) + images.length) % images.length] ||
        images[0] ||
        null
    )
}
const ALLOWED_UPLOAD_IMAGE_TYPES = new Set([
    "image/jpeg",
    "image/png",
    "image/gif",
])
function isAllowedUploadImage(file) {
    const type = String(file?.type || "").toLowerCase()
    if (ALLOWED_UPLOAD_IMAGE_TYPES.has(type)) return true
    const name = String(file?.name || "").toLowerCase()
    return /\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif)$/.test(name)
}
function fileToDataUrl(file) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!isAllowedUploadImage(file)) {
            reject(new Error("Only JPG, PNG, and GIF images are allowed"))
            return
        }
        const reader = new FileReader()
        reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ""))
        reader.onerror = () =>
            reject(reader.error || new Error("Image read failed"))
        reader.readAsDataURL(file)
    })
}
function CrackEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => wordsFor(entries, 6, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () => seedPositions(words.length).slice(0, words.length),
        [words.length]
    )
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [cracks, setCracks] = React.useState([])
    const [vanished, setVanished] = React.useState([])
    const [bursts, setBursts] = React.useState([])
    const [toolArmed, setToolArmed] = React.useState(false)
    const [pointerInside, setPointerInside] = React.useState(false)
    const [toolPos, setToolPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 72 })
    const [toolHit, setToolHit] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setCracks(words.map(() => 0))
        setVanished(words.map(() => false))
        setBursts([])
        setToolArmed(false)
        setPointerInside(false)
        setToolPos({ x: 50, y: 72 })
        setToolHit(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% CRACKED")
