    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const registerBurst = (i) => {
        const fx = {
            id: Date.now() + i,
            x: pos[i]?.x || 50,
            y: pos[i]?.y || 50,
            word: i,
        }
        setBursts((a) => [...a.slice(-10), fx])
        setTimeout(() => setBursts((a) => a.filter((x) => x.id !== fx.id)), 850)
    }
    const crackWord = (i) => {
        if (!toolArmed) return
        setToolHit((x) => x + 1)
        setCracks((prev) => {
            if (prev[i] >= 3) return prev
            const next = [...prev]
            next[i] = Math.min(3, next[i] + 1)
            const completed = next.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
            const totalHits = next.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.min(3, b), 0)
            const progress = pct(
                (totalHits / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100
            )
            onProgress?.(progress, `${progress}% CRACKED`)
            const broke = next[i] === 3 && prev[i] < 3
            sfx(broke ? "win" : "tap")
            vibrate(broke ? 24 : 10)
            registerBurst(i)
            if (broke) {
                setTimeout(
                    () =>
                        setVanished((v) =>
                            v.map((gone, n) => (n === i ? true : gone))
                        ),
                    760
                )
            }
            if (completed >= words.length) {
                setTimeout(() => onDone(320), 1080)
            }
            return next
        })
    }
    const updateTool = (e) => {
        if (!toolArmed) return
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        const x = clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98)
        const y = clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98)
        setToolPos({ x, y })
    }
    const armTool = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        setToolArmed(true)
        setPointerInside(true)
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (rect) {
            setToolPos({
                x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
                y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
            })
        }
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const completed = cracks.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={
                "arena literalCrackArena premiumArena multiCrackArena " +
                (toolArmed ? "crackToolArmed" : "")
            }
            onPointerMove={updateTool}
            onPointerEnter={() => {
                if (toolArmed) setPointerInside(true)
            }}
            onPointerLeave={() => setPointerInside(false)}
            onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
            }}
        >
            <div className="crackGround" />
            <div className="crackBubbleField">
                {words.map((w, i) => {
                    const broken = cracks[i] >= 3
                    if (vanished[i]) return null
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={i}
                            className={
                                "crackBubbleSlot " +
                                (broken ? "breaking " : "") +
                                (toolArmed && !broken ? "toolTarget" : "")
                            }
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                            }}
                            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                if (!toolArmed || broken) return
                                e.preventDefault()
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                crackWord(i)
                            }}
                        >
                            {!broken ? (
                                <motion.div
                                    className={
                                        "eggShell multiEgg allCircularBubble crackStage" +
                                        Math.min(3, cracks[i] || 0)
                                    }
                                    animate={
                                        reduced
                                            ? {}
                                            : {
                                                  y: [-3, 3, -3],
                                                  rotate: [-0.6, 0.6, -0.6],
                                              }
                                    }
                                    transition={{
                                        duration: 2.8,
                                        repeat: Infinity,
                                        ease: "easeInOut",
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <div className="eggHighlight" />
                                    <ExactWords text={w} max={14} min={8} />
                                    <svg
                                        className="eggCracks"
                                        viewBox="0 0 100 100"
                                        preserveAspectRatio="none"
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                    >
                                        <path
                                            className="eggCrackPath c1"
                                            d="M50 3 L47 20 L56 31 L48 42"
                                        />
                                        <path
                                            className="eggCrackPath c2"
                                            d="M48 42 L34 52 L43 61 L28 73"
                                        />
                                        <path
                                            className="eggCrackPath c3"
                                            d="M48 42 L63 50 L57 61 L73 70"
                                        />
                                        <path
                                            className="eggCrackPath c4"
                                            d="M43 61 L49 72 L38 84 L45 97"
                                        />
                                        <path
                                            className="eggCrackPath c5"
                                            d="M57 61 L51 73 L64 84 L55 97"
                                        />
                                    </svg>
                                    <div className="miniCrackCount">
                                        {cracks[i] || 0}/3
                                    </div>
                                </motion.div>
                            ) : (
                                <div className="eggBroken multiEggBroken allCircularBubble">
                                    <motion.div
                                        className="eggHalf left"
                                        initial={{
                                            x: 0,
                                            y: 0,
                                            rotate: 0,
                                            opacity: 1,
                                        }}
                                        animate={{
                                            x: -44,
                                            y: 58,
                                            rotate: -42,
                                            opacity: 0,
                                        }}
                                        transition={{
                                            duration: 0.82,
                                            ease: [0.16, 0.8, 0.2, 1],
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <ExactWords text={w} max={12} min={8} />
                                    </motion.div>
                                    <motion.div
                                        className="eggHalf right"
                                        initial={{
                                            x: 0,
                                            y: 0,
                                            rotate: 0,
                                            opacity: 1,
                                        }}
                                        animate={{
                                            x: 44,
                                            y: 62,
                                            rotate: 44,
                                            opacity: 0,
                                        }}
                                        transition={{
                                            duration: 0.88,
                                            ease: [0.16, 0.8, 0.2, 1],
                                        }}
                                    >
                                        <ExactWords text={w} max={12} min={8} />
                                    </motion.div>
                                    <div className="eggFragments">
                                        {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, n) => (
                                            <motion.i
                                                key={n}
                                                initial={{
                                                    x: 0,
                                                    y: 0,
                                                    opacity: 1,
                                                    scale: 1,
                                                }}
                                                animate={{
                                                    x: (n - 2.5) * 16,
                                                    y: 34 + (n % 3) * 14,
                                                    rotate:
                                                        (n % 2 ? 1 : -1) *
                                                        (18 + n * 8),
                                                    opacity: 0,
                                                    scale: 0.4,
                                                }}
                                                transition={{
                                                    duration: 0.72,
                                                    delay: n * 0.02,
                                                    ease: "easeOut",
                                                }}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    )
                })}
                {bursts.map((f) => (
                    <PremiumBurst
                        key={f.id}
                        x={f.x}
                        y={f.y}
                        tone={(cracks[f.word] || 0) >= 3 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>

            <button
                className={"crackToolDock " + (toolArmed ? "selected" : "")}
                onPointerDown={armTool}
                onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault()
                    e.stopPropagation()
                }}
            >
                <span>
                    {toolArmed ? "CRACK TOOL ACTIVE" : "SELECT CRACK TOOL"}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>

            {toolArmed && pointerInside ? (
                <div
                    key={toolHit}
                    className={"crackCursorTool " + (toolHit > 0 ? "hit" : "")}
                    style={{ left: toolPos.x + "%", top: toolPos.y + "%" }}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <i className="hammerHead" />
                    <i className="hammerHandle" />
                    <b>CRACK</b>
                </div>
            ) : null}

            <div className="literalStatus crackStatus">
                <b>
                    {completed >= words.length
                        ? "ALL BUBBLES CRACKED"
                        : toolArmed
                          ? `${completed} / ${words.length} BUBBLES CRACKED · 3 CLICKS PER BUBBLE`
                          : "SELECT THE CRACK TOOL"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {toolArmed
                        ? "Your mouse is now the crack tool. Move over any bubble and click it three times. The third hit breaks it."
                        : "Select the tool once. After that, your mouse becomes the tool until the game is complete."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {completed} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function ZapEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(() => {
        const src = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
            .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
        if (!src.length)
            return Array.from(
                { length: MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES },
                () => "THIS"
            )
        return distributeAcrossVisibleSlots(
            src,
            "THIS",
            visibleBubbleSlots(src)
        )
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () => [
            { x: 50, y: 22, r: 0 },
            { x: 29, y: 41, r: -4 },
            { x: 71, y: 41, r: 4 },
            { x: 38, y: 66, r: -3 },
            { x: 62, y: 66, r: 3 },
        ],
        []
    )
    const [zaps, setZaps] = React.useState(0)
    const [firing, setFiring] = React.useState(false)
    const [dead, setDead] = React.useState(false)
    const [pulse, setPulse] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setZaps(0)
        setFiring(false)
        setDead(false)
        setPulse(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% ZAPPED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const zap = () => {
        if (firing || dead) return
        const n = Math.min(3, zaps + 1)
        setZaps(n)
        setFiring(true)
        setPulse((p) => p + 1)
        const p = n === 1 ? 33 : n === 2 ? 67 : 100
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% ZAPPED`)
        sfx(n >= 3 ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(n >= 3 ? 34 : 16)
        setTimeout(() => setFiring(false), 360)
        if (n >= 3) {
            setTimeout(() => setDead(true), 190)
            setTimeout(() => onDone(340), 1180)
        }
    }
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena literalZapArena premiumArena multiZapArena zapLevel" +
                zaps +
                (dead ? " zapDead" : "")
            }
        >
            <div className="zapGround" />
            <div className="teslaTower left">
                <i className="coilTop" />
                <i className="coilBody" />
                <b />
            </div>
            <div className="teslaTower right">
                <i className="coilTop" />
                <i className="coilBody" />
                <b />
            </div>

            {firing ? (
                <div className="multiLightningField" key={"field-" + pulse}>
                    <div className="zapScreenFlash" />
                    <svg
                        className="multiLightningSvg"
                        viewBox="0 0 1000 520"
                        preserveAspectRatio="none"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                    >
                        <path
                            className="multiBolt main"
                            d="M18 270 L120 225 L190 290 L275 195 L360 275 L445 210 L520 270 L610 205 L690 285 L775 205 L860 275 L980 235"
                        />
                        <path
                            className="multiBolt b2"
                            d="M32 310 L135 265 L225 330 L310 245 L405 325 L500 248 L595 318 L690 238 L785 322 L875 250 L968 300"
                        />
                        <path
                            className="multiBolt branch"
                            d="M190 290 L145 390 M360 275 L320 390 M520 270 L550 392 M690 285 L735 390 M860 275 L900 382"
                        />
                    </svg>
                </div>
            ) : null}

            <div className="zapBubbleField zapBubbleFieldFive">
                {words.map((w, i) => (
                    <motion.div
                        key={i}
                        className={
                            "zapMultiBubble allCircularBubble " +
                            (zaps >= 1 ? "charged1 " : "") +
                            (zaps >= 2 ? "charged2 " : "") +
                            (dead ? "dead " : "")
                        }
                        style={{
                            left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                            top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                            rotate: pos[i]?.r || 0,
                        }}
                        initial={false}
                        animate={
                            dead
                                ? {
                                      scale: [1, 1.16, 0.06],
                                      opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                      rotate: [
                                          pos[i]?.r || 0,
                                          (pos[i]?.r || 0) + (i % 2 ? 8 : -8),
                                          (pos[i]?.r || 0) + (i % 2 ? 28 : -28),
                                      ],
                                      filter: [
                                          "brightness(1)",
                                          "brightness(3) saturate(1.6)",
                                          "blur(18px) brightness(2)",
                                      ],
                                  }
                                : firing
                                  ? {
                                        x: [0, -5, 5, -4, 3, 0],
                                        y: [0, 3, -3, 2, -2, 0],
                                        scale: [1, 1.07, 1],
                                        filter: [
                                            "brightness(1)",
                                            "brightness(2.5) saturate(1.45)",
                                            "brightness(1.1)",
                                        ],
                                    }
                                  : reduced
                                    ? {}
                                    : { y: [-3, 3, -3], scale: [1, 1.018, 1] }
                        }
                        transition={
                            dead
                                ? {
                                      duration: 0.86,
                                      delay: i * 0.05,
                                      ease: [0.16, 0.82, 0.23, 1],
                                  }
                                : firing
                                  ? { duration: 0.34 }
                                  : {
                                        duration: 2.5 + i * 0.12,
                                        repeat: Infinity,
                                        ease: "easeInOut",
                                    }
                        }
                    >
                        <ExactWords text={w} max={18} min={7} />
                        <i className="zapBubbleSheen" />
                        <i className="zapBubbleRing" />
                        {zaps >= 1 ? <i className="zapArc a1" /> : null}
                        {zaps >= 1 ? <i className="zapArc a2" /> : null}
                        {zaps >= 2 ? <i className="zapCrack zc1" /> : null}
                        {zaps >= 2 ? <i className="zapCrack zc2" /> : null}
                        <b className="zapBubbleCount">
                            {dead ? "✦" : `${Math.min(zaps, 3)}/3`}
                        </b>
                        {firing ? (
                            <div className="zapMiniImpact">
                                <b>ZAP!</b>
                                {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, n) => (
                                    <i
                                        key={n}
                                        style={{
                                            ["--zi"]: n,
                                        }}
                                    />
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                    </motion.div>
                ))}
                {dead
                    ? words.map((_, i) => (
                          <PremiumBurst
                              key={"zap-dead-" + i}
                              x={pos[i]?.x || 50}
                              y={pos[i]?.y || 50}
                              tone={i % 2 ? "violet" : "cyan"}
                              big
                          />
                      ))
                    : null}
            </div>

            <button
                className={
                    "zapGroundButton multiZapButton " +
                    (firing ? "pressed" : "")
                }
                onClick={zap}
                disabled={firing || dead}
            >
                <span>
                    {dead
                        ? "ALL 5 ZAPPED"
                        : `ZAP FIELD ${Math.min(3, zaps + 1)} / 3`}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus zapStatus">
                <b>
                    {dead
                        ? "ALL 5 BUBBLES ZAPPED AWAY"
                        : zaps === 0
                          ? "5 BUBBLES · 3 ZAPS EACH"
                          : zaps === 1
                            ? "ALL 5 BUBBLES CHARGED · 2 ZAPS LEFT"
                            : "ALL 5 BUBBLES OVERLOADING · 1 ZAP LEFT"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {dead
                        ? "Every bubble took its third zap and died together."
                        : "This Zapper game always shows exactly 5 bubbles. Every field zap hits all 5, and each bubble needs 3 zaps to die."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {zaps} / 3 FIELD ZAPS · 5 BUBBLES
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function BurnEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [burn, setBurn] = React.useState(0),
        [holding, setHolding] = React.useState(false),
        [gone, setGone] = React.useState(false)
    const timer = React.useRef(null),
        milestone = React.useRef(0)
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        setIdx(0)
        setBurn(0)
        setHolding(false)
        setGone(false)
        milestone.current = 0
        onProgress?.(0, "0% BURNT")
        return () => clearInterval(timer.current)
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const stop = () => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        setHolding(false)
    }
    const finishWord = () => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        setHolding(false)
        setGone(true)
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(30)
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(340), 520)
            else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                setBurn(0)
                setGone(false)
                milestone.current = 0
            }
        }, 900)
    }
    const start = () => {
        if (gone || holding) return
        setHolding(true)
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        timer.current = setInterval(() => {
            setBurn((v) => {
                const n = Math.min(100, v + 1.15)
                const p = pct(
                    ((idx + n / 100) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100
                )
                onProgress?.(p, `${p}% BURNT`)
                const mm = Math.floor(n / 20)
                if (mm > milestone.current) {
                    milestone.current = mm
                    sfx(mm >= 5 ? "win" : "soft")
                    vibrate(mm >= 5 ? 28 : 8)
                }
                if (n >= 100) {
                    setTimeout(finishWord, 0)
                    return 100
                }
                return n
            })
        }, 34)
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena literalBurnArena premiumArena">
            <div className="burnAmbient" />
            <div className="burnGround" />
            <div className={"realBurnStage " + (gone ? "gone" : "")}>
                <div className="paperAshShadow" />
                <div className="burnPaperFull" />
                <div
                    className="burnPaperRemaining"
                    style={{ clipPath: `inset(0 0 0 ${burn}%)` }}
                >
                    <div className="burnWordCenter">
                        <span>{displayText(current, 24)}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="paperFibres" />
                </div>
                <div className="burnedVoid" style={{ width: burn + "%" }} />
                <div
                    className={"charFront " + (holding ? "active" : "")}
                    style={{ left: `calc(${burn}% - 8px)` }}
                >
                    <i className="charGlow" />
                </div>
                <div
                    className="fireCanvasWrap"
                    style={{
                        left: `calc(${burn}% - 72px)`,
                        opacity: holding && burn < 100 ? 1 : 0,
                    }}
                >
                    <FireCanvas progress={burn} active={holding} />
                </div>
                <div className="emberTrail" style={{ width: burn + "%" }}>
                    {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
                        <i
                            key={i}
                            style={{
                                left: i * 8.3 + "%",
                                animationDelay: i * 0.08 + "s",
                                opacity: burn > i * 7 ? 1 : 0,
                            }}
                        />
                    ))}
                </div>
            </div>
            <button
                className={"burnGroundButton " + (holding ? "pressed" : "")}
                onPointerDown={start}
                onPointerUp={stop}
                onPointerCancel={stop}
                onPointerLeave={stop}
            >
                <span>
                    {gone ? "BURNT" : holding ? "BURNING" : "HOLD TO BURN"}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus burnStatus">
                <b>{gone ? "100% BURNT" : `${Math.round(burn)}% BURNT`}</b>
                <span>
                    {holding
                        ? "Fire is consuming the paper and letters left to right."
                        : "Hold the button to control the fire. Release to stop it."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function FlushEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [flushing, setFlushing] = React.useState(false),
        [phase, setPhase] = React.useState(0)
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setFlushing(false)
        setPhase(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% FLUSHED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const flush = () => {
        if (flushing) return
        setFlushing(true)
        setPhase(1)
        const total = Math.max(1, words.length)
        const report = (part) => {
            const p = pct(((idx + part) / total) * 100)
            onProgress?.(p, `${p}% FLUSHED`)
        }
        report(0.18)
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(10)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setPhase(2)
            report(0.52)
        }, 360)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setPhase(3)
            report(0.88)
            sfx("pop")
            vibrate(16)
        }, 860)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setPhase(4)
            report(1)
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(24)
        }, 1220)
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(320), 260)
            else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                setFlushing(false)
                setPhase(0)
            }
        }, 1580)
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena literalFlushArena sinkFlushArena premiumArena">
            <div className="sinkSceneGlow" />
            <div className="sinkBacksplash">
                <i />
                <i />
                <i />
            </div>
            <div className={"sinkFaucet " + (phase > 0 ? "running" : "")}>
                <i className="faucetStem" />
                <i className="faucetNeck" />
                <i className="faucetSpout" />
                <i className="faucetHandle" />
                {phase > 0 ? (
                    <div className="faucetWater">
                        <i />
                        <i />
                    </div>
                ) : null}
            </div>
            <div className={"sinkBasin phase" + phase}>
                <div className="sinkRim" />
                <div className="sinkWater">
                    <i className="waterRing r1" />
                    <i className="waterRing r2" />
                    <i className="waterRing r3" />
                    <i className="waterSpiral s1" />
                    <i className="waterSpiral s2" />
                </div>
                <div className={"sinkDrain phase" + phase}>
                    <i />
                    <b />
                </div>
                <div className="sinkPaperAnchor">
                    <motion.div
                        className={
                            "sinkPaperWord " + (flushing ? "active" : "")
                        }
                        initial={false}
                        animate={
                            phase === 0
                                ? {
                                      x: 0,
                                      y: 0,
                                      rotate: 0,
                                      scale: 1,
                                      opacity: 1,
                                      filter: "blur(0px)",
                                  }
                                : phase === 1
                                  ? {
                                        x: [0, 18, -10, 8],
                                        y: [0, 18, 34, 48],
                                        rotate: [0, 35, 80, 125],
                                        scale: [1, 0.97, 0.94, 0.9],
                                        opacity: 1,
                                    }
                                  : phase === 2
                                    ? {
                                          x: [8, -20, 18, -12, 8, 0],
                                          y: [48, 62, 76, 90, 104, 114],
                                          rotate: [
                                              125, 205, 285, 365, 445, 520,
                                          ],
                                          scale: [
                                              0.9, 0.84, 0.76, 0.67, 0.57, 0.48,
                                          ],
                                          opacity: 1,
                                          filter: "blur(0px)",
                                      }
                                    : phase === 3
                                      ? {
                                            x: [0, 9, -6, 0],
                                            y: [114, 118, 121, 124],
                                            rotate: [520, 610, 700, 790],
                                            scale: [0.48, 0.34, 0.22, 0.13],
                                            opacity: [1, 1, 1, 0.96],
                                            filter: [
                                                "blur(0px)",
                                                "blur(0px)",
                                                "blur(.4px)",
                                                "blur(.8px)",
                                            ],
                                        }
                                      : {
                                            x: 0,
                                            y: 132,
                                            rotate: 900,
                                            scale: 0.015,
                                            opacity: 0,
                                            filter: "blur(7px)",
                                        }
                        }
                        transition={{
                            duration:
                                phase === 4 ? 0.38 : phase >= 2 ? 0.58 : 0.36,
                            ease: [0.18, 0.8, 0.24, 1],
                        }}
                    >
                        <ExactWords text={current} max={26} min={11} />
                        <i className="wetPaperSheen" />
                    </motion.div>
                </div>
                {phase > 0 ? (
                    <div className="sinkSplashFx">
                        {Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => (
                            <i key={i} style={{ ["--i"]: i }} />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : null}
            </div>
            <div className="sinkCounter">
                <i className="counterEdge" />
            </div>
            <button
                className={
                    "flushLever primaryBottomControl " +
                    (flushing ? "active" : "")
                }
                onClick={flush}
                disabled={flushing}
            >
                <i />
                <span>
                    {phase === 4
                        ? "DRAINED"
                        : flushing
                          ? "DRAINING"
                          : "FLUSH DOWN THE DRAIN"}
                </span>
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus flushStatus">
                <b>
                    {phase === 4
                        ? "WORD WENT THROUGH THE DRAIN"
                        : flushing
                          ? `${Math.min(100, phase * 25)}% DRAINING`
                          : `READY · ${idx + 1}/${words.length}`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {flushing
                        ? "Keep watching the word: it stays visible while the water spirals it directly over the drain hole, then it slips through and disappears."
                        : "Press once. The water will physically carry this word into the sink hole."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function SwipeAwayEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [x, setX] = React.useState(0),
        [dragging, setDragging] = React.useState(false),
        [swiped, setSwiped] = React.useState(false)
    const startX = React.useRef(0),
        threshold = 140
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setX(0)
        setDragging(false)
        setSwiped(false)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% SWIPED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const onDown = (e) => {
        if (swiped) return
        startX.current = e.clientX - x
        setDragging(true)
        e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
    }
    const onMove = (e) => {
        if (!dragging || swiped) return
        const nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(260, e.clientX - startX.current))
        setX(nx)
        const p = pct(
            ((idx + Math.min(1, nx / threshold)) / Math.max(1, words.length)) *
                100
        )
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% SWIPED`)
    }
    const finish = () => {
        setSwiped(true)
        const p = pct(((idx + 1) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% SWIPED`)
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(18)
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(240), 240)
            else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                setX(0)
                setSwiped(false)
            }
        }, 520)
    }
    const onUp = () => {
        if (!dragging) return
        setDragging(false)
        if (x > threshold) finish()
        else {
            setX(0)
            const p = pct((idx / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
            onProgress?.(p, `${p}% SWIPED`)
            sfx("soft")
        }
    }
    return (
        <div className="arena literalSwipeArena premiumArena">
            <div className="swipeTrack" />
            <div className="swipeHintLane">
                <i />
                <i />
                <i />
            </div>
            <motion.div
                className={
                    "swipeCard physical " +
                    (dragging ? "dragging" : "") +
                    " " +
                    (swiped ? "done" : "")
                }
                style={{ x }}
                animate={
                    swiped
                        ? { x: 520, rotate: 20, opacity: 0, scale: 0.88 }
                        : { x, rotate: x / 16, opacity: 1, scale: 1 }
                }
                transition={{ duration: swiped ? 0.42 : 0.16, ease: "easeOut" }}
                onPointerDown={onDown}
                onPointerMove={onMove}
                onPointerUp={onUp}
                onPointerCancel={onUp}
            >
                <ExactWords text={current} max={42} min={12} />
                <b>SWIPE RIGHT</b>
            </motion.div>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {swiped
                        ? "SWIPED AWAY"
                        : dragging
                          ? "KEEP GOING"
                          : "GRAB THE CARD"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    Physically drag the thought to the right until it flies
                    off-screen.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function VacuumEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [suck, setSuck] = React.useState(0),
        [holding, setHolding] = React.useState(false),
        [gone, setGone] = React.useState(false),
        [contact, setContact] = React.useState(false)
    const [target, setTarget] = React.useState({ x: 0, y: 0 })
    const timer = React.useRef(null),
        milestone = React.useRef(0),
        completing = React.useRef(false)
    const activeRef = React.useRef(null),
        bagRef = React.useRef(null)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        setIdx(0)
        setSuck(0)
        setHolding(false)
        setGone(false)
        setContact(false)
        setTarget({ x: 0, y: 0 })
        milestone.current = 0
        completing.current = false
        onProgress?.(0, "0% VACUUMED")
        return () => clearInterval(timer.current)
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setSuck(0)
        setHolding(false)
        setGone(false)
        setContact(false)
        milestone.current = 0
        completing.current = false
        setTimeout(() => measureTarget(), 30)
    }, [idx])
    const measureTarget = () => {
        const a = activeRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect(),
            m = bagRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!a || !m) return
        setTarget({
            x: m.left + m.width / 2 - (a.left + a.width / 2),
            y: m.top + m.height / 2 - (a.top + a.height / 2),
        })
    }
    const finish = () => {
        if (completing.current) return
        completing.current = true
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        setHolding(false)
        setContact(true)
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(14)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setGone(true)
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(22)
        }, 260)
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(300), 260)
            else setIdx((i) => i + 1)
        }, 820)
    }
    const start = () => {
        if (gone || holding || completing.current || idx >= words.length) return
        measureTarget()
        setHolding(true)
        clearInterval(timer.current)
        timer.current = setInterval(
            () =>
                setSuck((v) => {
                    const n = Math.min(100, v + 2.15),
                        p = pct(
                            ((idx + n / 100) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100
                        )
                    onProgress?.(p, `${p}% VACUUMED`)
                    const mm = Math.floor(n / 25)
                    if (mm > milestone.current) {
                        milestone.current = mm
                        sfx(mm >= 4 ? "pop" : "soft")
                        vibrate(mm >= 4 ? 12 : 5)
                    }
                    if (n >= 96) setContact(true)
                    if (n >= 100 && !completing.current) {
                        setTimeout(finish, 0)
                        return 100
                    }
                    return n
                }),
            28
        )
    }
    const t = Math.min(1, suck / 100),
        approach = Math.min(1, t / 0.96)
    const activeX = target.x * approach,
        activeY = target.y * approach
    const slotCount = Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)
    return (
        <div className="arena literalVacuumArena premiumArena vacuumSixArena">
            <div className="vacuumFloor">
                <i />
            </div>
            <div
                className={
                    "realVacuumMachine " +
                    (holding ? "running " : "") +
                    (contact ? "contact" : "")
                }
                aria-hidden="true"
            >
                <svg
                    viewBox="0 0 560 300"
                    role="img"
                    aria-label="Vacuum cleaner"
                >
                    <defs>
                        <linearGradient
                            id="vacBodyGrad"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="0"
                            y2="1"
                        >
                            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#40dfff" />
                            <stop offset="18%" stopColor="#167da5" />
                            <stop offset="58%" stopColor="#0b3650" />
                            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#04131e" />
                        </linearGradient>
                        <linearGradient
                            id="vacMetalGrad"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="1"
                            y2="0"
                        >
                            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#6f8d9d" />
                            <stop offset="20%" stopColor="#e9fbff" />
                            <stop offset="52%" stopColor="#8fc6d8" />
                            <stop offset="80%" stopColor="#f8ffff" />
                            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#587486" />
                        </linearGradient>
                        <linearGradient
                            id="vacNozzleGrad"
                            x1="0"
                            y1="0"
                            x2="0"
                            y2="1"
                        >
                            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#2e6f8a" />
                            <stop offset="42%" stopColor="#10384d" />
                            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#020a10" />
                        </linearGradient>
                        <radialGradient
                            id="vacGlassGrad"
                            cx="35%"
                            cy="28%"
                            r="80%"
                        >
                            <stop
                                offset="0%"
                                stopColor="#dffcff"
                                stopOpacity=".62"
                            />
                            <stop
                                offset="32%"
                                stopColor="#56dbff"
                                stopOpacity=".24"
                            />
                            <stop
                                offset="100%"
                                stopColor="#071b2a"
                                stopOpacity=".78"
                            />
                        </radialGradient>
                        <filter
                            id="vacGlow"
                            x="-40%"
                            y="-40%"
                            width="180%"
                            height="180%"
                        >
                            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="b" />
                            <feMerge>
                                <feMergeNode in="b" />
                                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
                            </feMerge>
                        </filter>
                    </defs>
                    <ellipse
                        cx="392"
                        cy="245"
                        rx="128"

                        fill="rgba(0,0,0,.45)"
                    />
                    <path
                        className="vacuumHoseSvg"

                        fill="none"
                        stroke="#06141e"
                        strokeWidth="24"
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                    />
                    <path
                        className="vacuumHoseRib"
                        d="M337 132 C292 78 232 72 200 108 C177 135 182 164 205 177"
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="#315b70"
                        strokeWidth="16"
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeDasharray="4 8"
                    />
                    <path
                        className="vacuumHandle"
                        d="M350 91 Q368 53 414 53 Q455 53 470 88"
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="#163f54"
                        strokeWidth="17"
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                    />
                    <path
                        d="M354 89 Q370 61 414 61 Q447 61 462 90"
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="#5aa7c5"
                        strokeOpacity=".5"
                        strokeWidth="4"
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                    />
                    <rect
                        x="318"
                        y="86"
                        width="179"

                {Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, i) => (
                    <i key={i} style={{ ["--i"]: i }} />

            </div>
            <div className="vacuumBubbleGrid">
                {Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {

                            <div
                                key={`vac-empty-${i}`}
                                className="vacuumCircleBubble emptyBubble"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                        )
                    if (i < idx) return null
                    const active = i === idx
                    if (active)
                        return (
                            <motion.div
                                ref={activeRef}
                                key={`vacuum-bubble-${i}-${word}`}
                                className={
                                    "vacuumCircleBubble active " +
                                    (contact ? "touchingBag " : "") +
                                    (gone ? "gone" : "")
                                }
                                initial={false}
                                animate={
                                    gone
                                        ? {
                                              x: target.x,
                                              y: target.y,
                                              scale: [1, 1, 0.06],
                                              opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                              filter: [
                                                  "blur(0px)",
                                                  "blur(0px)",
                                                  "blur(5px)",
                                              ],

                                              x: activeX,
                                              y: activeY,
                                              scale: 1,
                                              opacity: 1,
                                              rotate: t * 4,
                                          }
                                }
                                transition={
                                    gone
                                        ? { duration: 0.34, ease: "easeIn" }
                                        : { duration: 0.08, ease: "linear" }
                                }
                            >
                                <span>{displayText(word, 28)}</span>
                                <div
                                    className="vacuumTrails"
                                    style={{ opacity: holding ? 0.98 : 0 }}
                                >
                                    {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, k) => (
                                        <i
                                            key={k}
                                            style={{
                                                top: 12 + k * 12 + "%",
                                                animationDelay: k * 0.04 + "s",
                                            }}
                                        />
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            </motion.div>
                        )
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={`vacuum-bubble-${i}-${word}`}
                            className="vacuumCircleBubble"
                        >
                            <span>{displayText(word, 28)}</span>
                        </div>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <button
                className={
                    "bigAction literalActionBtn vacuumBtn " +
                    (holding ? "pressed" : "")
                }
                onClick={start}
                disabled={holding || gone || idx >= words.length}
            >
                {gone
                    ? "INSIDE BAG"
                    : contact
                      ? "TOUCHING BAG…"
                      : holding
                        ? "SUCKING…"
                        : "VACUUM SUCK"}
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {gone
                        ? "WORD INSIDE THE RUBBISH BAG"
                        : contact
                          ? "WORD HAS TOUCHED THE BAG"
                          : holding
                            ? "KEEP WATCHING THE WORD"
                            : "READY TO SUCK"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    The word stays full-size and fully visible for the entire
                    trip. It only compresses and disappears after it physically
                    reaches the vacuum rubbish-bag intake.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {Math.min(idx + 1, words.length)} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function SlingshotEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => directWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [dx, setDx] = React.useState(0),
        [dy, setDy] = React.useState(0),
        [dragging, setDragging] = React.useState(false),
        [launched, setLaunched] = React.useState(false)
    const frameRef = React.useRef(null)
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setDx(0)
        setDy(0)
        setDragging(false)
        setLaunched(false)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% LAUNCHED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const onDown = (e) => {
        if (launched) return
        setDragging(true)
        e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
    }
    const onMove = (e) => {
        if (!dragging || launched || !frameRef.current) return
        const rect = frameRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        const originX = rect.width * 0.5,
            originY = rect.height * 0.67
        const halfW = Math.min(73, rect.width * 0.16),
            halfH = Math.min(41, rect.height * 0.12),
            pad = 8
        const minX = -(originX - halfW - pad),
            maxX = rect.width - originX - halfW - pad
        const minY = -(originY - halfH - pad),
            maxY = rect.height - originY - halfH - pad
        const rawX = e.clientX - (rect.left + originX),
            rawY = e.clientY - (rect.top + originY)
        const nx = Math.max(minX, Math.min(maxX, rawX)),
            ny = Math.max(minY, Math.min(maxY, rawY))
        setDx(nx)
        setDy(ny)
        const cornerDistance = Math.max(
            90,
            Math.hypot(
                Math.max(Math.abs(minX), Math.abs(maxX)),
                Math.max(Math.abs(minY), Math.abs(maxY))
            )
        )
        const dist = Math.min(1, Math.hypot(nx, ny) / cornerDistance)
        const p = pct(((idx + dist) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% LAUNCHED`)
    }
    const release = () => {
        if (!dragging) return
        setDragging(false)
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if (dist > 72) {
            setLaunched(true)
            const p = pct(((idx + 1) / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
            onProgress?.(p, `${p}% LAUNCHED`)
            sfx("win")
            vibrate(24)
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(280), 260)
                else {
                    setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                    setDx(0)
                    setDy(0)
                    setLaunched(false)
                }
            }, 700)
        } else {
            setDx(0)
            setDy(0)
            sfx("soft")
            const p = pct((idx / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
            onProgress?.(p, `${p}% LAUNCHED`)
        }
    }
    const bandX =
            50 + (dx / Math.max(1, frameRef.current?.clientWidth || 540)) * 100,
        bandY =
            67 + (dy / Math.max(1, frameRef.current?.clientHeight || 360)) * 100
    return (
        <div className="arena literalSlingshotArena premiumArena">
            <div className="slingshotFrame" ref={frameRef}>
                <div className={"skyLaunchRings " + (launched ? "active" : "")}>
                    {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                        <i key={i} />
                    ))}
                </div>
                <div className="fork left" />
                <div className="fork right" />
                <svg
                    className="slingshotBands"
                    viewBox="0 0 100 100"
                    preserveAspectRatio="none"
                >
                    <line
                        x1="42"
                        y1="48"
                        x2={String(bandX)}
                        y2={String(bandY)}
                    />
                    <line
                        x1="58"
                        y1="48"
                        x2={String(bandX)}
                        y2={String(bandY)}
                    />
                </svg>
                <motion.div
                    className={
                        "slingshotWord " +
                        (dragging ? "dragging" : "") +
                        " " +
                        (launched ? "launched" : "")
                    }
                    style={{ left: "50%", top: "67%" }}
                    animate={
                        launched
                            ? {
                                  x: [dx, 160, 330],
                                  y: [dy, -90, -250],
                                  scale: [1, 0.72, 0.12],
                                  opacity: [1, 0.92, 0],
                              }
                            : { x: dx, y: dy, scale: 1, opacity: 1 }
                    }
                    transition={{
                        duration: launched ? 0.74 : 0.18,
                        ease: "easeOut",
                    }}
                    onPointerDown={onDown}
                    onPointerMove={onMove}
                    onPointerUp={release}
                    onPointerCancel={release}
                >
                    <ExactWords text={current} max={34} min={12} />
                </motion.div>
            </div>
            <div className="literalStatus slingshotStatus">
                <b>
                    {launched
                        ? "LAUNCHED INTO THE SKY"
                        : dragging
                          ? "PULL IT BACK"
                          : "PULL AND RELEASE"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    Grab the word, pull it all the way toward any corner, then
                    release it far away.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function EraseClickEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const lastRub = React.useRef([])
    const [armed, setArmed] = React.useState(false),
        [inside, setInside] = React.useState(false),
        [pointerDown, setPointerDown] = React.useState(false)
    const [pos, setPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 50 })
    const [passes, setPasses] = React.useState([])
    const [dust, setDust] = React.useState(null)
    const [rubFx, setRubFx] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setArmed(false)
        setInside(false)
        setPointerDown(false)
        setPasses(words.map(() => 0))
        setRubFx(words.map(() => 0))
        lastRub.current = words.map(() => 0)
        setDust(null)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% ERASED")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const updatePointer = (e) => {
        if (!arenaRef.current) return
        const r = arenaRef.current.getBoundingClientRect()
        setPos({
            x: Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                    100,
                    ((e.clientX - r.left) / Math.max(1, r.width)) * 100
                )
            ),
            y: Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                    100,
                    ((e.clientY - r.top) / Math.max(1, r.height)) * 100
                )
            ),
        })
    }
    const rubWord = (i, e, force = false) => {
        if (!armed || (passes[i] || 0) >= 3) return
        const now = Date.now()
        if (!force && now - (lastRub.current[i] || 0) < 210) return
        lastRub.current[i] = now
        const next = [...passes]
        next[i] = Math.min(3, (next[i] || 0) + 1)
        setPasses(next)
        setRubFx((prev) => {
            const q = [...prev]
            q[i] = (q[i] || 0) + 1
            return q
        })
        const finished = next.every((v) => v >= 3)
        sfx(next[i] >= 3 ? "pop" : "tap")
        vibrate(next[i] >= 3 ? 18 : 7)
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (rect)
            setDust({
                id: now,
                x: ((e.clientX - rect.left) / Math.max(1, rect.width)) * 100,
                y: ((e.clientY - rect.top) / Math.max(1, rect.height)) * 100,
            })
        const total = next.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.min(3, b), 0),
            p = pct((total / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% ERASED`)
        if (finished) setTimeout(() => onDone(320), 700)
    }
    const erased = passes.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    const slotCount = Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={
                "arena literalEraseArena premiumArena eraseBubbleArena " +
                (armed ? "eraserArmed" : "")
            }
            onPointerMove={updatePointer}
            onPointerDown={() => setPointerDown(true)}
            onPointerUp={() => setPointerDown(false)}
            onPointerCancel={() => setPointerDown(false)}
            onPointerEnter={() => setInside(true)}
            onPointerLeave={() => {
                setInside(false)
                setPointerDown(false)
            }}
        >
            <div className="eraseBubbleField">
                {Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const word = words[i]
                    if (!word)
                        return (
                            <div
                                key={`erase-empty-${i}`}
                                className="eraseWordBubble emptyBubble"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                        )
                    const n = passes[i] || 0,
                        gone = n >= 3,
                        clip =
                            n === 0
                                ? "inset(0 0 0 0)"
                                : n === 1
                                  ? "inset(0 28% 0 0)"
                                  : n === 2
                                    ? "inset(0 68% 0 0)"
                                    : "inset(0 100% 0 0)"
                    return (
                        <motion.button
                            key={`erase-bubble-${i}-${word}`}
                            className={
                                "eraseWordBubble allCircularBubble pass" +
                                n +
                                (gone ? " erased" : "")
                            }
                            disabled={!armed || gone}
                            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                setPointerDown(true)
                                rubWord(i, e, true)
                            }}
                            onPointerEnter={(e) => {
                                if (armed && pointerDown) rubWord(i, e, false)
                            }}
                            onPointerMove={(e) => {
                                if (armed && (pointerDown || e.buttons))
                                    rubWord(i, e, false)
                            }}
                            onPointerUp={() => setPointerDown(false)}
                            initial={false}
                            animate={{ scale: gone ? 0.96 : 1, opacity: 1 }}
                            transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: "easeOut" }}
                        >
                            <motion.span
                                animate={{
                                    clipPath: clip,
                                    filter: `blur(${n * 1.8}px)`,
                                    opacity: gone ? 0 : 1,
                                }}
                                transition={{
                                    duration: 0.34,
                                    ease: [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1],
                                }}
                            >
                                {displayText(word, 26)}
                            </motion.span>
                            {n > 0 && !gone ? (
                                <motion.i
                                    key={`rub-${i}-${rubFx[i] || 0}`}
                                    className="eraserLiveStroke"
                                    initial={{ x: "-130%", opacity: 0 }}
                                    animate={{ x: "130%", opacity: [0, 1, 0] }}
                                    transition={{
                                        duration: 0.42,
                                        ease: "easeInOut",
                                    }}
                                />
                            ) : null}
                            <i className="eraseBubbleSmear" />
                            <b>{gone ? "ERASED" : `${n}/3`}</b>
                        </motion.button>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <button
                className={"eraseActivateBtn " + (armed ? "active" : "")}
                onClick={() => {
                    setArmed(true)
                    sfx("tap")
                    vibrate(8)
                }}
            >
                {armed ? "ERASER ACTIVE" : "ACTIVATE ERASER"}
            </button>
            {dust ? (
                <div
                    key={dust.id}
                    className="eraseClickDust"
                    style={{ left: dust.x + "%", top: dust.y + "%" }}
                >
                    {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => (
                        <i key={i} style={{ ["--i"]: i }} />
                    ))}
                </div>
            ) : null}
            {armed && inside ? (
                <div
                    className="eraserCursorTool"
                    style={{ left: pos.x + "%", top: pos.y + "%" }}
                >
                    <div className="eraserCursorBody">
                        <b>ERASER</b>
                        <i />
                    </div>
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {erased >= words.length
                        ? "ALL WORDS ERASED"
                        : armed
                          ? `${erased} / ${words.length} GONE · 3 ERASES EACH`
                          : "WORD BUBBLES READY"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {armed
                        ? "The very first click immediately rubs part of that word away. Click, move or swipe the eraser across it three times; the third erase removes the word completely."
                        : "Every entered word has its own bubble. Activate the eraser to begin."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {erased} / {words.length} ERASED
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function CutLoopLiteralEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [armed, setArmed] = React.useState(false)
    const [cuts, setCuts] = React.useState([])
    const [fx, setFx] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setArmed(false)
        setCuts(words.map(() => 0))
        setFx(words.map(() => 0))
        onProgress?.(0, "0% CUT")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const slotCount = Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)
    const points = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {
                const a = ((-90 + (360 / slotCount) * i) * Math.PI) / 180
                return { x: 50 + 39 * Math.cos(a), y: 46 + 34 * Math.sin(a) }
            }),
        [slotCount]
    )
    const cutWord = (i) => {
        if (!armed || !words[i] || (cuts[i] || 0) >= 3) return
        const next = [...cuts]
        next[i] = Math.min(3, (next[i] || 0) + 1)
        setCuts(next)
        setFx((prev) => {
            const q = [...prev]
            q[i] = (q[i] || 0) + 1
            return q
        })
        const total = next.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.min(3, b), 0),
            p = pct((total / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% CUT`)
        const freed = next[i] >= 3,
            allDone = next.every((v) => v >= 3)
        sfx(freed ? "pop" : "tap")
        vibrate(freed ? 18 : 7)
        if (allDone) setTimeout(() => onDone(360), 850)
    }
    const released = cuts.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    return (
        <div
            className={
                "arena cutLoopLiteralArena premiumArena " +
                (armed ? "scissorsArmed" : "")
            }
        >
            <div className="cutLoopRing">
                <i className="loopTapeGlow" />
                <i className="loopTapeTrack" />
            </div>
            <div className="cutLoopWords">
                {Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const word = words[i],
                        p = points[i],
                        n = cuts[i] || 0,
                        done = n >= 3
                    if (!word)
                        return (
                            <div
                                key={`loop-empty-${i}`}
                                className="cutLoopWordSlot emptyBubble"
                                style={{ left: p.x + "%", top: p.y + "%" }}
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                        )
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={`loop-slot-${i}-${word}`}
                            className="cutLoopWordSlot"
                            style={{ left: p.x + "%", top: p.y + "%" }}
                        >
                            <motion.button
                                className={
                                    "cutLoopWord allCircularBubble cut" +
                                    n +
                                    (done ? " severed" : "")
                                }
                                disabled={!armed || done}
                                onClick={() => cutWord(i)}
                                initial={false}
                                animate={
                                    done
                                        ? {
                                              x: [
                                                  0,
                                                  i % 2 ? 24 : -24,
                                                  55 * (i % 2 ? 1 : -1),
                                              ],
                                              y: [0, 12, 72],
                                              rotate: [
                                                  0,
                                                  i % 2 ? 12 : -12,
                                                  30 * (i % 2 ? 1 : -1),
                                              ],
                                              scale: [1, 0.88, 0.38],
                                              opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                          }
                                        : reduced
                                          ? {}
                                          : { scale: [1, 1.025, 1] }
                                }
                                transition={
                                    done
                                        ? { duration: 0.62, ease: "easeIn" }
                                        : {
                                              duration: 2.3,
                                              repeat: Infinity,
                                              ease: "easeInOut",
                                          }
                                }
                            >
                                <span>{displayText(word, 20)}</span>
                                <i
                                    className={
                                        "cutScar c1 " + (n >= 1 ? "on" : "")
                                    }
                                />
                                <i
                                    className={
                                        "cutScar c2 " + (n >= 2 ? "on" : "")
                                    }
                                />
                                <i
                                    className={
                                        "cutScar c3 " + (n >= 3 ? "on" : "")
                                    }
                                />
                                {n > 0 && !done ? (
                                    <motion.b
                                        key={`scissor-fx-${i}-${fx[i] || 0}`}
                                        className="cutScissorFx"
                                        initial={{
                                            x: -34,
                                            rotate: -20,
                                            opacity: 0,
                                        }}
                                        animate={{
                                            x: 34,
                                            rotate: 20,
                                            opacity: [0, 1, 0],
                                        }}
                                        transition={{ duration: 0.42 }}
                                    >
                                        ✂
                                    </motion.b>
                                ) : null}
                                <em>{done ? "CUT FREE" : `${n}/3 CUTS`}</em>
                            </motion.button>
                        </div>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <button
                className={"cutLoopScissorPicker " + (armed ? "active" : "")}
                onClick={() => {
                    setArmed(true)
                    sfx("tap")
                    vibrate(8)
                }}
            >
                <span>✂</span>
                {armed ? "SCISSORS SELECTED" : "SELECT SCISSORS"}
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {released >= words.length
                        ? "THE LOOP IS CUT"
                        : armed
                          ? `${released} / ${words.length} WORDS CUT FREE`
                          : "SELECT THE SCISSORS"}
                </b>
                <span>
                    All words sit around one continuous loop. Select the
                    scissors, then click a word three times. Every click shows a
                    real cut across that word; the third cut snips it completely
                    off the loop and it falls away.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {released} / {words.length} CUT FREE
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
// UNHOOK (founder F1 + decision C11, 2026-10-09): ONE big, real metal hook; the user's words become THREE
// bubbles, each hanging from the hook on its OWN string. The strings are drawn in arena pixels from MEASURED
// positions (the hook's tie points and each bubble's live rim, read every frame), so they stay attached on every
// size, through resizes, the bubbles' bob and the hook's swing. Tapping a string (its clip above the bubble, the
// string itself or the bubble) snaps it: the upper half whips back to the hook, the hook recoils and swings, the
// other bubbles jolt, and the freed bubble floats away trailing its snapped end. The reveal burst is unchanged.
// Hook drawing: viewBox 0 0 100 140; the bend's lowest stretch carries the three twine wraps.

    { x: 32.25, y: 116, a: 0, sx: 32.25, sy: 120.6 },
    { x: 39.9, y: 112.8, a: 22, sx: 41.6, sy: 117.2 },
]
