function unhookThreeBubbles(entries) {
    const src = (entries && entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
        .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    if (!src.length) return ["THIS", "THIS", "THIS"]
    // cleanEntries repeats a short thought up to six chunks: recover the user's own sequence first
    let k = src.length
    for (let n = 1; n < src.length; n++) {
        if (src.every((v, i) => v === src[i % n])) {
            k = n
            break
        }
    }
    const base = src.slice(0, k)
    if (base.length <= 3)
        return Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, i) => base[i % base.length])
    const per = base.length / 3
    return [0, 1, 2].map((g) =>
        base.slice(Math.round(g * per), Math.round((g + 1) * per)).join(" ")
    )
}
function unhookLayout(w, h, statusTop) {
    const W = Math.max(220, w || 360)
    const H = Math.max(300, h || 560)
    const hookW = Math.round(Math.max(96, Math.min(W * 0.4, H * 0.26, 200)))
    const hookH = Math.round(hookW * 1.4)
    const hookLeft = Math.round(W / 2 - hookW * 0.3225)
    const hangY = hookH * (120 / 140)
    const d = Math.round(Math.max(88, Math.min(W * 0.29, H * 0.21, 150)))
    // the lowest bubble stays above the status line (measured), never under it
    const st = Number.isFinite(statusTop) && statusTop > 0 ? statusTop - 10 : H - 150
    const floor = Math.max(H * 0.55, Math.min(H - 48, st)) - d / 2
    const sideY = Math.min(floor - d * 0.55, hangY + (H - hangY) * 0.42)
    const midY = Math.min(floor, hangY + (H - hangY) * 0.62)
    const spread = Math.min(W * 0.31, d * 1.95)
    return {
        hookW,
        hookH,
        hookLeft,
        d,
        at: [
            { x: W / 2 - spread, y: sideY },
            { x: W / 2, y: midY },
            { x: W / 2 + spread, y: sideY },
        ],
    }
}
function UnhookLiteralEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(() => unhookThreeBubbles(entries), [entries.join("|")])
    const rawUid = typeof React.useId === "function" ? React.useId() : "uh"
    const uid = "uh" + String(rawUid).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "")
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const tieRefs = React.useRef([])
    const bubRefs = React.useRef([])
    const gripRefs = React.useRef([])
    const strRefs = React.useRef([])
    const snapRef = React.useRef([null, null, null])
    const cutRef = React.useRef([false, false, false])
    const doneRef = React.useRef(false)
    const timers = React.useRef([])
    const layoutRef = React.useRef(null)
    const reducedRef = React.useRef(!!reduced)
    reducedRef.current = !!reduced
    const [box, setBox] = React.useState({ w: 360, h: 560 })
    const [cut, setCut] = React.useState([false, false, false])
    const [freed, setFreed] = React.useState([false, false, false])
    const [swing, setSwing] = React.useState({ n: 0, dir: 1, last: false })
    React.useEffect(() => {
        cutRef.current = [false, false, false]
        snapRef.current = [null, null, null]
        bubRefs.current.forEach((b) => {
            if (!b) return
            b.style.removeProperty("translate")
            b.style.removeProperty("scale")
        })
        doneRef.current = false
        setCut([false, false, false])
        setFreed([false, false, false])
        onProgress?.(0, "0% UNHOOKED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    React.useEffect(() => () => timers.current.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t)), [])
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const el = arenaRef.current
        if (!el) return
        const read = () => {
            const w = el.offsetWidth
            const h = el.offsetHeight
            const stEl = el.querySelector(":scope > .literalStatus")
            const s = stEl && stEl.offsetParent === el ? stEl.offsetTop : 0
            if (w > 0 && h > 0)
                setBox((b) =>
                    Math.abs(b.w - w) > 1 || Math.abs(b.h - h) > 1 || Math.abs((b.s || 0) - s) > 2
                        ? { w, h, s }
                        : b
                )
        }
        read()
        let ro = null
        if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
            ro = new ResizeObserver(read)
            ro.observe(el)
        }
        window.addEventListener("resize", read)
        // the shared layout guard may re-dock the status line after mount: measure again once it has settled
        const later = [setTimeout(read, 350), setTimeout(read, 1200)]
        return () => {
            if (ro) ro.disconnect()
            window.removeEventListener("resize", read)
            later.forEach((t) => clearTimeout(t))
        }
    }, [])
    // per-frame string renderer: every end point is measured from the live DOM (never assumed)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        let raf = 0
        const f = (n) => (Math.round(n * 10) / 10).toString()
        const unit = (x, y) => {
            const l = Math.hypot(x, y) || 1
            return { x: x / l, y: y / l }
        }
        const draw = () => {
            const arena = arenaRef.current
            if (!arena) return
            const ar = arena.getBoundingClientRect()
            const k = ar.width / Math.max(1, arena.offsetWidth) || 1
            const centre = (el) => {
                const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                return {
                    x: (r.left + r.width / 2 - ar.left) / k,
                    y: (r.top + r.height / 2 - ar.top) / k,
                    r: Math.min(r.width, r.height) / 2 / k,
                }
            }
            const now = performance.now()
            const still = reducedRef.current
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                const S = strRefs.current[i]
                const tie = tieRefs.current[i]
                const bub = bubRefs.current[i]
                if (!S || !tie || !bub) continue
                const snap0 = snapRef.current[i]
                if (snap0) {
                    // the freed bubble's float is driven HERE, in the same frame callback that draws its string,
                    // so bubble and trailing string are always painted together (never one ahead of the other)
                    const q = Math.min(1, (now - snap0.at) / (still ? 700 : 1500))
                    const lay = layoutRef.current
                    const rise = still ? 40 : (lay.at[i].y + lay.d * 1.3) * q * q * (3 - 2 * q)
                    const dx = still ? 0 : (i === 0 ? -1 : 1) * 16 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI)
                    bub.style.setProperty("translate", `${f(dx)}px ${f(-rise)}px`, "important")
                    if (!still) bub.style.setProperty("scale", f(1 + 0.08 * Math.min(1, q * 3)), "important")
                }
                const Hp = centre(tie)
                const c = centre(bub)
                // the string is tied to a brass ring on the bubble's rim, straight above its centre
                const A = { x: c.x, y: c.y - c.r + 2 }
                S.clip.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${f(A.x)} ${f(A.y)})`)
                const snap = snapRef.current[i]
                if (!snap) {
                    const sag = 3 + Math.min(10, Math.abs(A.x - Hp.x) * 0.02)
                    const d = `M${f(Hp.x)} ${f(Hp.y)} Q${f((Hp.x + A.x) / 2)} ${f((Hp.y + A.y) / 2 + sag)} ${f(A.x)} ${f(A.y)}`
                    S.line.setAttribute("d", d)
                    S.shadow.setAttribute("d", d)
                    S.hit.setAttribute("d", d)
                    S.last = { Hp, A }
                    const g = gripRefs.current[i]
                    if (g) {
                        // the grip sits ON the string a little above the bubble, so the guide hand never covers
                        // the bubble's picture or the user's words
                        const u = unit(Hp.x - A.x, Hp.y - A.y)
                        const reach = Math.min(Math.max(40, c.r * 0.85), Math.hypot(Hp.x - A.x, Hp.y - A.y) * 0.35)
                        g.style.transform = `translate(${f(A.x + u.x * reach - 22)}px, ${f(A.y + u.y * reach - 22)}px)`
                    }
                    continue
                }
                if (!snap.B) {
                    const last = S.last || { Hp, A }
                    snap.B = {
                        x: last.Hp.x + (last.A.x - last.Hp.x) * 0.44,
                        y: last.Hp.y + (last.A.y - last.Hp.y) * 0.44,
                    }
                    snap.Lu = Math.hypot(snap.B.x - last.Hp.x, snap.B.y - last.Hp.y)
                    snap.Ll = Math.hypot(last.A.x - snap.B.x, last.A.y - snap.B.y)
                    snap.u0 = unit(snap.B.x - last.Hp.x, snap.B.y - last.Hp.y)
                    snap.l0 = unit(snap.B.x - last.A.x, snap.B.y - last.A.y)
                    S.line.style.display = "none"
                    S.shadow.style.display = "none"
                    S.hit.style.display = "none"
                    S.upper.style.display = ""
                    S.lower.style.display = ""
                }
                const e = now - snap.at
                // upper half: whips back to the hook and ends as a short frayed stub hanging from its wrap
                const t1 = Math.min(1, e / 520)
                const k1 = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t1, 3)
                const ud = unit(snap.u0.x + (0 - snap.u0.x) * k1, snap.u0.y + (1 - snap.u0.y) * k1)
                const lenU = Math.max(9, snap.Lu * (1 - 0.82 * k1))
                const wU = still ? 0 : 18 * Math.exp(-e / 190) * Math.sin(e / 36)
                const Ue = { x: Hp.x + ud.x * lenU, y: Hp.y + ud.y * lenU }
                S.upper.setAttribute(
                    "d",
                    `M${f(Hp.x)} ${f(Hp.y)} Q${f((Hp.x + Ue.x) / 2 - ud.y * wU)} ${f((Hp.y + Ue.y) / 2 + ud.x * wU)} ${f(Ue.x)} ${f(Ue.y)}`
                )
                // lower half: flops over the rim and drapes OUTSIDE the freed bubble (never across its picture or
                // words) while it floats away; geometry is relative to the bubble's live centre and radius
                const t2 = Math.min(1, e / 700)
                const k2 = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t2, 2)
                const side = i === 0 ? -1 : 1
                const rr = c.r
                if (!snap.rel) snap.rel = { x: snap.B.x - A.x, y: snap.B.y - A.y }
                const lerp = (p0, p1) => p0 + (p1 - p0) * k2
                const wL = still ? 0 : 7 * Math.exp(-e / 260) * Math.sin(e / 44)
                const Le = { x: A.x + lerp(snap.rel.x, side * rr * 1.25), y: A.y + lerp(snap.rel.y, rr * 1.1 + wL) }
                const Lc = { x: A.x + lerp(snap.rel.x / 2, side * rr * 1.15), y: A.y + lerp(snap.rel.y / 2, -rr * 0.05) }
                S.lower.setAttribute("d", `M${f(A.x)} ${f(A.y)} Q${f(Lc.x)} ${f(Lc.y)} ${f(Le.x)} ${f(Le.y)}`)
                // the arena clips the bubble and its string as they float out of the top; fade only at the very end
                const fade = bub.classList.contains("gone") ? 0 : e < 1350 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (e - 1350) / 200)
                S.lower.style.opacity = String(fade)
                S.clip.style.opacity = String(fade)
                // the snap itself: a bright flash + shards at the break point
                const ft = e / 300
                if (ft < 1) {
                    S.flash.style.display = ""
                    S.flash.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${f(snap.B.x)} ${f(snap.B.y)}) scale(${f(0.5 + ft * 1.3)})`)
                    S.flash.style.opacity = String(1 - ft)
                } else if (S.flash.style.display !== "none") S.flash.style.display = "none"
            }
        }
        // draw right after framer-motion has written this frame's transforms (postRender), so the strings and
        // the moving bubbles / swinging hook are always painted from the same frame; plain rAF as a fallback
        const fm = FramerMotionNS || {}
        draw()
        if (fm.frame && typeof fm.frame.postRender === "function" && typeof fm.cancelFrame === "function") {
            fm.frame.postRender(draw, true)
            return () => fm.cancelFrame(draw)
        }
        const tick = () => {
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
            draw()
        }
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
        return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
    }, [])
    const L = unhookLayout(box.w, box.h, box.s)
    layoutRef.current = L
    const released = cut.filter(Boolean).length
    const snapString = (i) => {
        if (doneRef.current || cutRef.current[i]) return
        cutRef.current = cutRef.current.map((v, j) => (j === i ? true : v))
        snapRef.current[i] = { at: performance.now(), B: null }
        const n = cutRef.current.filter(Boolean).length
        setCut(cutRef.current.slice())
        const p = pct((n / 3) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% UNHOOKED`)
        const last = n >= 3
        sfx(last ? "win" : "pop")
        vibrate(last ? 22 : 12)
        // the load on the other strings pulls the hook the other way once this one lets go
        const left = cutRef.current[0] ? 0 : 1
        const right = cutRef.current[2] ? 0 : 1
        const dir = i === 0 ? -1 : i === 2 ? 1 : right >= left ? -1 : 1
        setSwing((s) => ({ n: s.n + 1, dir, last }))
        timers.current.push(
            setTimeout(
                () => setFreed((fr) => fr.map((v, j) => (j === i ? true : v))),
                reduced ? 700 : 1550
            )
        )
        if (last) {
            doneRef.current = true
            timers.current.push(setTimeout(() => onDone(280), reduced ? 800 : 1300))
        }
    }
    const eps = swing.n * 1e-4
    const sw = swing.dir * (swing.last ? 1.6 : 1)
    const hookSwing =
        reduced || !swing.n
            ? { rotate: 0, y: 0 }
            : {
                  rotate: [0, 10 * sw, -6.5 * sw, 3.5 * sw, -1.2 * sw, eps],
                  y: swing.last ? [0, -16, 4, -2, 0] : [0, -5, 1, 0],
              }
    const jolt = reduced || !swing.n ? 0 : [0, -7 * swing.dir, 4 * swing.dir, -1.5 * swing.dir, eps]
    const tieWrap = (t, i) => (
        <g key={`tie-${i}`} transform={`translate(${t.x} ${t.y}) rotate(${t.a})`}>
            <ellipse rx="2.3" ry="5.6" fill="none" stroke="#5b4a2a" strokeWidth="1.9" opacity=".55" transform="translate(.5 .6)" />
            <ellipse rx="2.3" ry="5.6" fill="none" stroke="#f6ecd4" strokeWidth="1.5" />
            <ellipse rx="1.5" ry="5.2" fill="none" stroke="#f6ecd4" strokeWidth="1.1" transform="translate(1.9 0)" opacity=".85" />
        </g>
    )
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className="arena literalUnhookArena premiumArena unhookOneHookArena"
            style={{ "--uh-d": L.d + "px" }}
        >
            <style>{UNHOOK_ONE_HOOK_CSS}</style>
            <div className="unhookOceanGlow" />
            <motion.div
                className="unhookHookRig"
                style={{ left: L.hookLeft, width: L.hookW, height: L.hookH, originX: 0.5, originY: 0 }}
                aria-hidden="true"
                initial={false}
                animate={reduced ? { rotate: 0 } : { rotate: [-1.4, 1.4] }}
                transition={
                    reduced
                        ? { duration: 0 }
                        : { duration: 3.4, repeat: Infinity, repeatType: "mirror", ease: "easeInOut" }
                }
            >
                <motion.div
                    className="unhookHookSwing"
                    style={{ originX: 0.5, originY: 0 }}
                    initial={false}
                    animate={hookSwing}
                    transition={{ duration: swing.last ? 1.3 : 1.05, ease: "easeOut" }}
                >
                    <svg className="unhookHookSvg" viewBox="0 0 100 140" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMin meet">
                        <defs>
                            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-steel`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2=".3">
                                <stop offset="0" stopColor="#4a5462" />
                                <stop offset=".17" stopColor="#c9d2dc" />
                                <stop offset=".31" stopColor="#f7f9fb" />
                                <stop offset=".5" stopColor="#8c98a7" />
                                <stop offset=".7" stopColor="#3d4653" />
                                <stop offset=".86" stopColor="#a9b4c1" />
                                <stop offset="1" stopColor="#e3e8ee" />
                            </linearGradient>
                            <linearGradient id={`${uid}-link`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
                                <stop offset="0" stopColor="#59636f" />
                                <stop offset=".45" stopColor="#eef2f6" />
                                <stop offset="1" stopColor="#5d6773" />
                            </linearGradient>
                        </defs>
                        {/* chain from above */}
                        <ellipse cx="50" cy="5" rx="4.4" ry="7.6" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${uid}-link)`} strokeWidth="2.8" />
                        <rect x="48.5" y="9" width="3" height="15" rx="1.5" fill={`url(#${uid}-link)`} />
                        {/* soft cast shadow, then the forged hook: eye, shank, bend, point and barb */}
                        <g transform="translate(3 4)" opacity=".3">
                            <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="6.6" fill="none" stroke="#08041a" strokeWidth="4.6" />
                            <path d={UNHOOK_BEND} fill="none" stroke="#08041a" strokeWidth="9.5" strokeLinecap="round" />
                        </g>
                        <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="6.6" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${uid}-steel)`} strokeWidth="4.4" />
                        <circle cx="50" cy="30" r="6.6" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.7)" strokeWidth=".9" transform="translate(-.9 -.9)" />
                        <path d={UNHOOK_BEND} fill="none" stroke="#2a313b" strokeWidth="9.6" strokeLinecap="round" />
                        <path d={UNHOOK_BEND} fill="none" stroke={`url(#${uid}-steel)`} strokeWidth="8.2" strokeLinecap="round" />
                        <path d={UNHOOK_BEND} fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.72)" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" transform="translate(-2 -1.2)" />
                        <path d="M12 95.5 L16.6 74 L20.6 95.5 Z" fill={`url(#${uid}-steel)`} stroke="#2a313b" strokeWidth=".9" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                        <path d="M19.4 84 L26.4 93.6 L19.9 92.2 Z" fill={`url(#${uid}-steel)`} stroke="#2a313b" strokeWidth=".8" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                        <path d="M15.4 92 L16.7 77" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,.75)" strokeWidth=".8" strokeLinecap="round" />
                        <circle cx="44" cy="109" r="1.5" fill="#fff" opacity=".85" />
                        {UNHOOK_TIES.map((t, i) => (cut[i] ? null : tieWrap(t, i)))}
                        {UNHOOK_TIES.map((t, i) => (
                            <circle
                                key={`tie-pt-${i}`}
                                className="unhookTiePoint"
                                ref={(el) => (tieRefs.current[i] = el)}
                                cx={t.sx}
                                cy={t.sy}
                                r=".6"
                                fill="transparent"
                            />
                        ))}
                    </svg>
                </motion.div>
            </motion.div>
            <svg className="unhookStringLayer" aria-hidden="true">
                {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
                    <g
                        key={`str-${i}`}
                        className="uhString"
                        ref={(el) => {
                            if (!el) return
                            strRefs.current[i] = {
                                shadow: el.querySelector(".uhStrShadow"),
                                line: el.querySelector(".uhStr"),
                                hit: el.querySelector(".uhStrHit"),
                                upper: el.querySelector(".uhUpper"),
                                lower: el.querySelector(".uhLower"),
                                clip: el.querySelector(".uhClip"),
                                flash: el.querySelector(".uhFlash"),
                                last: strRefs.current[i] && strRefs.current[i].last,
                            }
                        }}
                    >
                        <path className="uhStrShadow" />
                        <path className="uhStr" data-unhook-string={i} />
                        <path className="uhStrHit" onClick={() => snapString(i)} />
                        <path className="uhStrPiece uhUpper" data-unhook-piece="upper" style={{ display: "none" }} />
                        <path className="uhStrPiece uhLower" data-unhook-piece="lower" style={{ display: "none" }} />
                        <g className="uhClip">
                            <circle className="o" r="4.4" />
                            <circle className="h" r="4.4" transform="translate(-.8 -.8)" />
                        </g>
                        <g className="uhFlash" style={{ display: "none" }}>
                            <circle r="5" />
                            {[0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300].map((a) => (
                                <line key={a} x1="8" y1="0" x2="17" y2="0" transform={`rotate(${a + 15 * i})`} />
                            ))}
                        </g>
                    </g>
                ))}
            </svg>
            {words.map((word, i) => {
                const p = L.at[i]
                const isCut = cut[i]
                const gone = freed[i]
                const text = word === "UPLOADED IMAGE" ? "" : displayText(word, 28)
                return (
                    <motion.button
                        key={`unhook-word-${i}`}
                        ref={(el) => (bubRefs.current[i] = el)}
                        type="button"
                        data-unhook-bubble={i}
                        aria-label={`Snap the string holding ${text || "this bubble"}`}
                        className={
                            "unhookWordBubble " +
                            (gone ? "gone " : "") +
                            (isCut && !gone ? "floating" : "")
                        }
                        style={{ left: p.x - L.d / 2, top: p.y - L.d / 2 }}
                        onClick={() => snapString(i)}
                        disabled={isCut}
                        initial={false}
                        animate={
                            isCut
                                ? { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, opacity: reduced ? 0 : 1 }
                                : {
                                      x: jolt,
                                      y: reduced ? 0 : [0, -6, 0],
                                      scale: 1,
                                      opacity: 1,
                                  }
                        }
                        transition={
                            isCut
                                ? { duration: reduced ? 0.6 : 0.25, ease: "easeOut" }
                                : {
                                      x: { duration: 0.9, ease: "easeOut" },
                                      y: reduced
                                          ? { duration: 0 }
                                          : { duration: 2.3 + i * 0.37, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut" },
                                      default: { duration: 0.3 },
                                  }
                        }
                    >
                        <span className="tsExactUserText">{text}</span>
                    </motion.button>
                )
            })}
            {[0, 1, 2].map((i) =>
                cut[i] ? null : (
                    <div
                        key={`grip-${i}`}
                        role="button"
                        tabIndex={0}
                        ref={(el) => (gripRefs.current[i] = el)}
                        className="unhookStringGrip"
                        aria-label={`Snap string ${i + 1}`}
                        onClick={() => snapString(i)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                                e.preventDefault()
                                snapString(i)
                            }
                        }}
                    />
                )
            )}
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {released < 3
                        ? `${3 - released} BUBBLE${3 - released === 1 ? "" : "S"} STILL ON THE HOOK`
                        : "ALL BUBBLES FREE"}
                </b>
                <span>Snap a string and its bubble floats free.</span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">{released} / 3 FREE</div>
        </div>
    )
}
function FreezeLiteralEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [fills, setFills] = React.useState([])
    const [iceFx, setIceFx] = React.useState([])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setFills(words.map(() => 0))
        setIceFx(words.map(() => 0))
        onProgress?.(0, "0% FROZEN")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const freezeWord = (i) => {
        if ((fills[i] || 0) >= 3) return
        const next = [...fills]
        next[i] = Math.min(3, (next[i] || 0) + 1)
        setFills(next)
        setIceFx((prev) => {
            const q = [...prev]
            q[i] = (q[i] || 0) + 1
            return q
        })
        const total = next.reduce((a, b) => a + Math.min(3, b), 0),
            p = pct((total / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% FROZEN`)
        const dead = next[i] === 3,
            allDone = next.every((v) => v >= 3)
        sfx(dead ? "pop" : "tap")
        vibrate(dead ? 18 : 7)
        if (allDone) setTimeout(() => onDone(340), 900)
    }
    const finished = fills.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    const slotCount = Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)
    return (
        <div className="arena literalFreezeArena premiumArena freezeCubeArena freezeThreeFillArena">
            <div className="freezeCubeMist">
                {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
                    <i key={i} style={{ ["--i"]: i }} />
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="freezeCubeGrid">
                {Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const word = words[i]
                    if (!word)
                        return (
                            <div
                                key={`freeze-empty-${i}`}
                                className="freezeWordCube emptyCube"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                        )
                    const n = fills[i] || 0,
                        dead = n >= 3
                    return (
                        <motion.button
                            key={`freeze-cube-${i}-${word}`}
                            className={
                                "freezeWordCube fill" +
                                n +
                                (dead ? " frozen dead" : "")
                            }
                            disabled={dead}
                            onClick={() => freezeWord(i)}
                            initial={false}
                            animate={
                                dead
                                    ? {
                                          scale: [1, 1.06, 1],
                                          filter: [
                                              "brightness(1)",
                                              "brightness(1.7)",
                                              "brightness(1.15)",
                                          ],
                                      }
                                    : reduced
                                      ? {}
                                      : { y: [-2, 3, -2] }
                            }
                            transition={
                                dead
                                    ? { duration: 0.48 }
                                    : {
                                          duration: 2.5,
                                          repeat: Infinity,
                                          ease: "easeInOut",
                                      }
                            }
                        >
                            <i
                                className={
                                    "realIceLayer ice1 " + (n >= 1 ? "on" : "")
                                }
                            />
                            <i
                                className={
                                    "realIceLayer ice2 " + (n >= 2 ? "on" : "")
                                }
                            />
                            <i
                                className={
                                    "realIceLayer ice3 " + (n >= 3 ? "on" : "")
                                }
                            />
                            <i className="cubeIceGlass" />
                            <motion.span
                                animate={{
                                    opacity: dead ? 0 : 1,
                                    scale: dead ? 0.82 : 1,
                                    filter: dead ? "blur(7px)" : "blur(0px)",
                                }}
                                transition={{
                                    duration: 0.42,
                                    delay: dead ? 0.16 : 0,
                                }}
                            >
                                {displayText(word, 24)}
                            </motion.span>
                            <b>{dead ? "FROZEN OUT" : `${n}/3 ICE FILLS`}</b>
                            {n > 0 ? (
                                <motion.div
                                    key={`iceburst-${i}-${iceFx[i] || 0}`}
                                    className="cubeIceBurst"
                                    initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.6 }}
                                    animate={{
                                        opacity: [0, 1, 0],
                                        scale: [0.6, 1.2, 1.5],
                                    }}
                                    transition={{ duration: 0.48 }}
                                >
                                    {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, k) => (
                                        <i key={k} />
                                    ))}
                                </motion.div>
                            ) : null}
                            {dead ? (
                                <div className="cubeCrystals">
                                    {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, k) => (
                                        <i key={k} />
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}
                        </motion.button>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {finished >= words.length
                        ? "EVERY WORD FROZEN OUT"
                        : `${finished} / ${words.length} WORDS FINISHED`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    Each word needs exactly three clicks: first third of real
                    ice, second third, then a full solid ice fill. On the third
                    fill the word disappears inside the frozen cube.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {finished} / {words.length} FROZEN OUT
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function DefuseLiteralEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_WORD_QUEUE),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0),
        [opened, setOpened] = React.useState(false),
        [wireCut, setWireCut] = React.useState(false),
        [safePressed, setSafePressed] = React.useState(false)
    const current = words[Math.min(idx, words.length - 1)] || "THIS"
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setIdx(0)
        setOpened(false)
        setWireCut(false)
        setSafePressed(false)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% DEFUSED")
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const total = Math.max(1, words.length)
    const openPanel = () => {
        if (opened) return
        setOpened(true)
        const p = pct(((idx + 1 / 3) / total) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% DEFUSED`)
        sfx("tap")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const cutWire = () => {
        if (!opened || wireCut) return
        setWireCut(true)
        const p = pct(((idx + 2 / 3) / total) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% DEFUSED`)
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(12)
    }
    const pressSafe = () => {
        if (!opened || !wireCut || safePressed) return
        setSafePressed(true)
        const p = pct(((idx + 1) / total) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% DEFUSED`)
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(22)
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) setTimeout(() => onDone(300), 320)
            else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                setOpened(false)
                setWireCut(false)
                setSafePressed(false)
            }
        }, 760)
    }
    const step = safePressed ? 3 : wireCut ? 2 : opened ? 1 : 0
    return (
        <div className="arena literalDefuseArena premiumArena defuseSeparatedArena">
            <div className="defuseV2Device">
                <div className="defuseV2Header">
                    <div className="defuseV2Screen">
                        <small>THOUGHT SIGNAL</small>
                        <ExactWords text={current} max={38} min={12} />
                    </div>
                    <div
                        className={
                            "defuseV2Timer " + (safePressed ? "safe" : "")
                        }
                    >
                        <b>{safePressed ? "SAFE" : 3 - step}</b>
                        <span>{safePressed ? "CALM" : "STEPS LEFT"}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div className="defuseV2Zones">
                    <section
                        className={
                            "defuseZone z1 " + (opened ? "done" : "active")
                        }
                    >
                        <small>STEP 1</small>
                        <strong>OPEN PANEL</strong>
                        <div className={"miniPanel " + (opened ? "open" : "")}>
                            <i />
                        </div>
                        <button onClick={openPanel} disabled={opened}>
                            {opened ? "PANEL OPEN ✓" : "OPEN PANEL"}
                        </button>
                    </section>
                    <section
                        className={
                            "defuseZone z2 " +
                            (wireCut ? "done" : opened ? "active" : "locked")
                        }
                    >
                        <small>STEP 2</small>
                        <strong>CUT BLUE</strong>
                        <div className="miniWires">
                            <i className="red" />
                            <i className={"blue " + (wireCut ? "cut" : "")} />
                            <i className="yellow" />
                        </div>
                        <button onClick={cutWire} disabled={!opened || wireCut}>
                            {wireCut ? "BLUE CUT ✓" : "CUT BLUE WIRE"}
                        </button>
                    </section>
                    <section
                        className={
                            "defuseZone z3 " +
                            (safePressed
                                ? "done"
                                : wireCut
                                  ? "active"
                                  : "locked")
                        }
                    >
                        <small>STEP 3</small>
                        <strong>PRESS SAFE</strong>
                        <div
                            className={
                                "miniSafe " + (safePressed ? "pressed" : "")
                            }
                        >
                            <i />
                        </div>
                        <button
                            onClick={pressSafe}
                            disabled={!wireCut || safePressed}
                        >
                            {safePressed ? "SAFE ✓" : "PRESS SAFE"}
                        </button>
                    </section>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {safePressed
                        ? "DEVICE SAFE"
                        : `STEP ${Math.min(3, step + 1)} OF 3`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    Each control has its own space. Complete them left to right:
                    open the panel, cut the blue wire, then press SAFE.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {idx + 1} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function FireCanvas({ progress, active }) {
    const ref = React.useRef(null)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const canvas = ref.current
        if (!canvas) return
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
        if (!ctx) return
        let raf = 0
        let particles = []
        const resize = () => {
            const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
            const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1)
            canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(box.width * dpr))
            canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(box.height * dpr))
            ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
        }
        resize()
        const spawn = (w, h) => {
            const front = Math.max(10, Math.min(w - 10, (progress / 100) * w))
            for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                particles.push({
                    x: front + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24,
                    y: h * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.23),
                    vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.65,
                    vy: -(0.9 + Math.random() * 1.9),
                    life: 0,
                    max: 34 + Math.random() * 34,
                    size: 10 + Math.random() * 22,
                    heat: Math.random(),
                })
            }
        }
        const draw = () => {
            const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
            const w = box.width
            const h = box.height
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
            if (active && progress > 0 && progress < 100) spawn(w, h)
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter"
            particles = particles.filter((p) => p.life < p.max)
            particles.forEach((p) => {
                p.life += 1
                p.x += p.vx
                p.y += p.vy
                p.vx *= 0.99
                p.vy -= 0.012
                const t = p.life / p.max
                const a = Math.max(0, 1 - t)
                const r = p.size * (1 + t * 0.45)
                const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, r)
                if (p.heat > 0.55) {
                    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,225,${0.95 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(0.2, `rgba(255,222,92,${0.92 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(0.58, `rgba(255,92,18,${0.74 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,30,0,0)")
                } else {
                    g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,245,190,${0.86 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(0.25, `rgba(255,166,45,${0.84 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(0.62, `rgba(255,55,10,${0.62 * a})`)
                    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(170,0,0,0)")
                }
                ctx.fillStyle = g
                ctx.beginPath()
                ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, r * 0.72, r * 1.18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
                ctx.fill()
            })
            ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over"
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(draw)
        }
        draw()
        window.addEventListener("resize", resize)
        return () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
            window.removeEventListener("resize", resize)
        }
    }, [progress, active])
    return <canvas ref={ref} className="proceduralFireCanvas" />
}
function MeltTextCanvas({ text, progress }) {
    const ref = React.useRef(null)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        const canvas = ref.current
        if (!canvas) return
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
        if (!ctx) return
        const box = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
        const cssW = Math.max(260, box.width || 620)
        const cssH = Math.max(150, box.height || 190)
        const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1)
        const W = Math.round(cssW * dpr)
        const H = Math.round(cssH * dpr)
        canvas.width = W
        canvas.height = H
        const off = document.createElement("canvas")
        off.width = W
        off.height = H
        const o = off.getContext("2d")
        if (!o) return
        const words = text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
        let lines = [text.trim() || "THIS"]
        if (words.length > 3 || text.length > 22) {
            let a = []
            let b = []
            let chars = 0
            const half = Math.ceil(text.length / 2)
            words.forEach((w) => {
                if (chars < half) {
                    a.push(w)
                    chars += w.length + 1
                } else b.push(w)
            })
            if (b.length) lines = [a.join(" "), b.join(" ")]
        }
        const maxFont = lines.length > 1 ? 58 : 76
        let font = maxFont
        const fit = () => {
            o.font = `1000 ${font * dpr}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`
            return Math.max(...lines.map((line) => o.measureText(line).width))
        }
        while (font > 24 && fit() > W * 0.88) font -= 2
        o.clearRect(0, 0, W, H)
        o.textAlign = "center"
        o.textBaseline = "middle"
        o.font = `1000 ${font * dpr}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`
        o.lineJoin = "round"
        o.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.1 * dpr)
        const grad = o.createLinearGradient(0, H * 0.18, 0, H * 0.82)
        grad.addColorStop(0, "#f4feff")
        grad.addColorStop(0.28, "#b9f2ff")
        grad.addColorStop(0.65, "#53c9ec")
        grad.addColorStop(1, "#277da8")
        o.fillStyle = grad
        o.strokeStyle = "rgba(235,253,255,.62)"
        o.shadowColor = "rgba(79,231,255,.32)"
        o.shadowBlur = 10 * dpr
        const ys = lines.length === 1 ? [H * 0.44] : [H * 0.34, H * 0.61]
        lines.forEach((line, i) => {
            o.strokeText(line, W / 2, ys[i])
            o.fillText(line, W / 2, ys[i])
        })
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H)
        const slice = Math.max(2, Math.round(3 * dpr))
        const baseShift = progress * 0.18 * dpr
        for (let x = 0; x < W; x += slice) {
            const phase = (Math.sin(x * 0.018) + Math.sin(x * 0.041) * 0.5) * 8
            const local = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress + phase))
            const sink = Math.max(0, local - 5) * 0.36 * dpr
            const squash = Math.max(0.12, 1 - local * 0.0068)
            const alpha = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.max(0, local - 82) / 18)
            ctx.globalAlpha = alpha
            ctx.drawImage(
                off,
                x,
                0,
                Math.min(slice, W - x),
                H,
                x,
                baseShift + sink,
                Math.min(slice, W - x),
                H * squash
            )
            const col = Math.floor(x / slice)
            if (local > 24 && col % 9 === 0) {
                const drip =
                    (local - 24) * 0.62 * dpr * (0.55 + ((col * 17) % 9) / 10)
                const sy = Math.round(H * 0.28)
                const sh = Math.round(H * 0.38)
                ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.88, alpha + 0.15)
                ctx.drawImage(
                    off,
                    x,
                    sy,
                    Math.min(slice, W - x),
                    sh,
                    x,
                    H * 0.4 + sink,
                    Math.min(slice, W - x),
                    sh + drip
                )
            }
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1
        const dropCount = 10
        for (let i = 0; i < dropCount; i++) {
            const threshold = 18 + i * 6
            if (progress <= threshold) continue
            const travel = (progress - threshold) / (100 - threshold)
            const x = W * (0.16 + i * 0.075) + Math.sin(i * 2.3) * 10 * dpr
            const y = H * (0.58 + 0.24 * travel) + (i % 3) * 5 * dpr
            const rw = (3 + (i % 3)) * dpr
            const rh = (7 + travel * 15 + (i % 2) * 4) * dpr
            const dg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - rh, x, y + rh)
            dg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(210,249,255,.92)")
            dg.addColorStop(0.52, "rgba(83,204,238,.82)")
            dg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(34,111,160,.22)")
            ctx.fillStyle = dg
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.ellipse(x, y, rw, rh, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)
            ctx.fill()
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    }, [text, progress])
    return <canvas ref={ref} className="meltTextCanvas" />
}
function MeltEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => toolWords(entries, 5, 10),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () => meltOrganizedRandomPattern(words.length, entries.join("|")),
        [words.length, entries.join("|")]
    )
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const fieldRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [toolActive, setToolActive] = React.useState(false)
    const [pointerInside, setPointerInside] = React.useState(false)
    const [toolPos, setToolPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 80 })
    const [hits, setHits] = React.useState(() => words.map(() => 0))
    const [melting, setMelting] = React.useState(-1)
    const [melted, setMelted] = React.useState([])
    const [blast, setBlast] = React.useState(0)
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setToolActive(false)
        setPointerInside(false)
        setToolPos({ x: 50, y: 80 })
        setHits(words.map(() => 0))
        setMelting(-1)
        setMelted(words.map(() => false))
        setBlast(0)
        onProgress?.(0, "0% MELTED")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const moveTool = (e) => {
        if (!toolActive) return
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        setToolPos({
            x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
            y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 3, 97),
        })
    }
    const armTool = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        setToolActive(true)
        setPointerInside(true)
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (rect)
            setToolPos({
                x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
                y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
            })
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const meltCube = (i) => {
        if (!toolActive || melting >= 0 || melted[i] || (hits[i] || 0) >= 3)
            return
        const nextHit = Math.min(3, (hits[i] || 0) + 1)
        const next = hits.map((v, n) => (n === i ? nextHit : v))
        setHits(next)
        setMelting(i)
        setBlast((b) => b + 1)
        const totalHits = next.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
        const p = pct((totalHits / Math.max(1, words.length * 3)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% MELTED`)
        const killed = nextHit >= 3
        sfx(killed ? "win" : "soft")
        vibrate(killed ? 28 : 12)
        setTimeout(() => setMelting(-1), killed ? 980 : 520)
        if (killed)
            setTimeout(() => {
                setMelted((a) => a.map((v, n) => (n === i ? true : v)))
                const completed = next.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
                if (completed >= words.length)
                    setTimeout(() => onDone(360), 520)
            }, 980)
    }
    const fireNearCube = (e) => {
        if (!toolActive || melting >= 0) return
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        moveTool(e)
        const rect = fieldRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        const px = e.clientX - rect.left,
            py = e.clientY - rect.top
        const isMobile = rect.width < 700
        const flameTipX = px + (isMobile ? 72 : 88)
        const flameTipY = py - (isMobile ? 10 : 14)
        const targetRadiusPx = Math.max(132, Math.min(168, rect.width * 0.24))
        let best = -1,
            bestCenterDist = 1e9
        pos.forEach((p, i) => {
            if (melted[i] || (hits[i] || 0) >= 3) return
            const cx = (p.x / 100) * rect.width
            const cy = (p.y / 100) * rect.height
            const centerDist = Math.hypot(flameTipX - cx, flameTipY - cy)
            if (centerDist < bestCenterDist) {
                bestCenterDist = centerDist
                best = i
            }
        })
        if (best >= 0 && bestCenterDist <= targetRadiusPx) meltCube(best)
    }
    const completed = hits.filter((v) => v >= 3).length
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={
                "arena literalMeltArena premiumArena meltCubeArena " +
                (toolActive ? "torchArmed" : "")
            }
            onPointerMove={moveTool}
            onPointerEnter={() => {
                if (toolActive) setPointerInside(true)
            }}
            onPointerLeave={() => setPointerInside(false)}
            onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault()
                e.stopPropagation()
            }}
        >
            <div className="meltAmbientV3" />
            <div className="meltFloorV3" />
            <div
                ref={fieldRef}
                className="meltCubeField"
                onPointerDown={fireNearCube}
            >
                {words.map((w, i) => {
                    if (melted[i]) return null
                    const h = hits[i] || 0
                    const active = melting === i
                    const final = active && h >= 3
                    const stageClass =
                        h === 0
                            ? "cubeStageFull"
                            : h === 1
                              ? "cubeStageHalf"
                              : "cubeStageQuarter"
                    return (
                        <motion.button
                            key={i}
                            className={
                                "cartoonIceCube " +
                                stageClass +
                                " meltDamage" +
                                Math.min(h, 2) +
                                (active ? " melting" : "")
                            }
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                                rotate: pos[i]?.r || 0,
                            }}
                            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                                if (!toolActive) return
                                e.preventDefault()
                                e.stopPropagation()
                                fireNearCube(e)
                            }}
                            disabled={!toolActive || melting >= 0}
                            initial={false}
                            animate={
                                final
                                    ? {
                                          scaleX: [
                                              1, 1.05, 0.95, 0.82, 1.12, 0.7,
                                          ],
                                          scaleY: [
                                              1, 0.96, 0.84, 0.62, 0.34, 0.12,
                                          ],
                                          y: [0, 3, 12, 24, 44, 60],
                                          opacity: [1, 1, 1, 0.94, 0.65, 0],
                                          filter: [
                                              "brightness(1)",
                                              "brightness(1.35) saturate(1.2)",
                                              "blur(0px)",
                                              "blur(1px)",
                                              "blur(4px)",
                                              "blur(10px)",
                                          ],
                                      }
                                    : active
                                      ? {
                                            scale: [1, 1.07, 1.01, 0.98, 1],
                                            filter: [
                                                "brightness(1)",
                                                "brightness(2.2) saturate(1.25)",
                                                "brightness(1.18)",
                                                "brightness(1.06)",
                                            ],
                                        }
                                      : reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : {
                                              y: [-3, 3, -3],
                                              rotate: [
                                                  (pos[i]?.r || 0) - 1,
                                                  (pos[i]?.r || 0) + 1,
                                                  (pos[i]?.r || 0) - 1,
                                              ],
                                          }
                            }
                            transition={
                                final
                                    ? {
                                          duration: 0.98,
                                          times: [0, 0.16, 0.34, 0.55, 0.78, 1],
                                          ease: [0.18, 0.8, 0.22, 1],
                                      }
                                    : active
                                      ? { duration: 0.52 }
                                      : {
                                            duration: 2.5 + i * 0.09,
                                            repeat: Infinity,
                                            ease: "easeInOut",
                                        }
                            }
                        >
                            <span className="iceCubeWord">
                                {displayText(w, 28)}
                            </span>
                            <i className="iceCubeFace" />
                            <i className="iceCubeHighlight" />
                            <i className="iceCubeEdge right" />
                            <i className="iceCubeEdge bottom" />
                            <b className="toolHitCount iceHitCount">{h}/3</b>
                            {active ? (
                                <>
                                    <div className="cubeInfernoStream">
                                        <i />
                                        <i className="f2" />
                                        <i className="f3" />
                                        <b />
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="iceMeltDrips">
                                        {Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, n) => (
                                            <i
                                                key={n}
                                                style={{
                                                    left: 10 + n * 12 + "%",
                                                    animationDelay:
                                                        n * 0.04 + "s",
                                                }}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="iceSteam">
                                        {Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, n) => (
                                            <i
                                                key={n}
                                                style={{
                                                    left: 8 + n * 12 + "%",
                                                    animationDelay:
                                                        n * 0.04 + "s",
                                                }}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="torchHitFlare" />
                                    <div className="cubeHeatBloom" />
                                </>
                            ) : null}
                        </motion.button>
                    )
                })}
                {words.map((_, i) =>
                    melted[i] ? (
                        <div
                            key={"puddle-" + i}
                            className="icePuddle"
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: `calc(${pos[i]?.y || 50}% + 50px)`,
                            }}
                        >
                            <i />
                        </div>
                    ) : null
                )}
            </div>
            {toolActive && pointerInside ? (
                <div
                    key={blast}
                    className={
                        "blowTorchCursor " + (melting >= 0 ? "firing" : "")
                    }
                    style={{ left: toolPos.x + "%", top: toolPos.y + "%" }}
                    aria-hidden="true"
                >
                    <div className="torchBody">
                        <i className="torchTank" />
                        <i className="torchGrip" />
                        <i className="torchNozzle" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="torchFlame">
                        <i />
                        <b />
                        <em />
                    </div>
                </div>
            ) : null}
            <button
                className={
                    "meltGroundButton meltToolButton " +
                    (toolActive ? "active" : "")
                }
                onPointerDown={armTool}
            >
                <span>
                    {toolActive ? "BLOW TORCH ACTIVE" : "ACTIVATE BLOW TORCH"}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus meltStatus">
                <b>
                    {completed >= words.length
                        ? "ALL ICE CUBES MELTED"
                        : toolActive
                          ? `${completed} / ${words.length} MELTED · FULL / HALF / QUARTER / GONE`
                          : `${words.length} ICE CUBES READY`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {toolActive
                        ? "Aim with the flame end of the blow torch. Only the front flame tip can melt a cube, and the cube still melts when the flame lands anywhere near it."
                        : "Activate once. Your mouse becomes the blow torch until every cube is gone."}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {completed} / {words.length}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function universalToolWords(entries) {
    const src = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
        .map((s) => String(s || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
    if (!src.length) return ["THIS", "THIS", "THIS", "THIS", "THIS"]
    const total = clamp(src.length, 5, 10)
    if (src.length <= total) {
        const out = []
        const base = Math.floor(total / src.length)
        const rem = total % src.length
        src.forEach((word, i) => {
            const copies = base + (i < rem ? 1 : 0)
            for (let n = 0; n < copies; n++) out.push(word)
        })
        return out.slice(0, total)
    }
    return Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => {
        const start = Math.floor((i * src.length) / total)
        const end = Math.floor(((i + 1) * src.length) / total)
        return src.slice(start, Math.max(start + 1, end)).join(" ")
    })
}

            { x: 50, y: 12, r: 0 },
            { x: 84, y: 16, r: 6 },
            { x: 16, y: 60, r: -4 },
            { x: 50, y: 66, r: 0 },
            { x: 84, y: 60, r: 4 },
        ],
        7: [
            { x: 14, y: 14, r: -6 },
            { x: 50, y: 10, r: 0 },
            { x: 86, y: 14, r: 6 },
            { x: 22, y: 40, r: -4 },
            { x: 78, y: 40, r: 4 },
            { x: 30, y: 66, r: -3 },
            { x: 70, y: 66, r: 3 },
        ],
        8: [
            { x: 12, y: 14, r: -6 },
            { x: 50, y: 10, r: 0 },
            { x: 88, y: 14, r: 6 },
            { x: 16, y: 38, r: -5 },
            { x: 84, y: 38, r: 5 },
            { x: 12, y: 66, r: -4 },
            { x: 50, y: 72, r: 0 },

        ],
        9: [
