        ],
    }
    return map[n] || map[5]
}
function universalToolKind(game) {
    if (game.id === 9) return "laser"
    if (game.id === 3) return "crack"
    if (game.id === 4) return "stomp"
    if (game.id === 16 || game.id === 18) return "torch"
    if (game.id === 6) return "zap"
    if ([22, 23, 24, 25, 41, 61, 71].includes(game.id)) return "device"
    return "generic"
}
function universalToolObjectClass(game) {
    if (game.id === 16) return "toolCube"
    return "toolBubble"
}
function universalToolActionName(game) {
    if (game.id === 16) return "BLOW TORCH"
    if (game.id === 18) return "BURN TOOL"
    if (game.id === 9) return "LASER"
    if (game.id === 3) return "CRACK TOOL"
    if (game.id === 4) return "STOMP TOOL"
    if (game.id === 6) return "ZAP TOOL"
    return game.name.toUpperCase() + " TOOL"
}
function universalToolImpactLabel(kind, game) {
    if (kind === "torch") return game.id === 16 ? "MELT" : "BURN"
    if (kind === "laser") return "FIRE"
    if (kind === "crack") return "CRACK"
    if (kind === "stomp") return "STOMP"
    if (kind === "zap") return "ZAP"
    if (kind === "device") return "RELIEF"
    return game.name.toUpperCase()
}
function UniversalToolModeEngine({
    game,
    entries,
    onDone,
    sfx,
    reduced,
    onProgress,
}) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => universalToolWords(entries),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const pos = React.useMemo(
        () => universalToolPattern(words.length),
        [words.length]
    )
    const kind = universalToolKind(game)
    const objectClass = universalToolObjectClass(game)
    const actionName = universalToolActionName(game)
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [toolActive, setToolActive] = React.useState(false)
    const [pointerInside, setPointerInside] = React.useState(false)
    const [toolPos, setToolPos] = React.useState({ x: 50, y: 82 })
    const [hits, setHits] = React.useState(() => words.map(() => 0))
    const [removed, setRemoved] = React.useState(() => words.map(() => false))
    const [strike, setStrike] = React.useState(0)
    const [firingIndex, setFiringIndex] = React.useState(-1)
    const [bursts, setBursts] = React.useState([])
    const [impactPos, setImpactPos] = React.useState(() =>
        words.map(() => ({ x: 50, y: 50 }))
    )
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setToolActive(false)
        setPointerInside(false)
        setToolPos({ x: 50, y: 82 })
        setHits(words.map(() => 0))
        setRemoved(words.map(() => false))
        setStrike(0)
        setFiringIndex(-1)
        setBursts([])
        setImpactPos(words.map(() => ({ x: 50, y: 50 })))
        onProgress?.(0, `0% CLEARED`)
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const updatePointer = (e) => {
        const rect = arenaRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return
        if (
            !e ||
            typeof e.clientX !== "number" ||
            typeof e.clientY !== "number"
        )
            return
        setToolPos({
            x: clamp(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100, 2, 98),
            y: clamp(((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100, 2, 98),
        })
    }
    const armTool = (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        e.stopPropagation()
        setToolActive(true)
        setPointerInside(true)
        updatePointer(e)
        sfx("soft")
        vibrate(8)
    }
    const totalHits = hits.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)
    const completed = removed.filter(Boolean).length
    const hitObject = (i, e) => {
        if (!toolActive || removed[i]) return
        e?.preventDefault?.()
        e?.stopPropagation?.()
        updatePointer(e || {})
        const targetRect = e?.currentTarget?.getBoundingClientRect?.()
        let localX = 50,
            localY = 50
        if (
            targetRect &&
            typeof e?.clientX === "number" &&
            typeof e?.clientY === "number"
        ) {
            localX = clamp(
                ((e.clientX - targetRect.left) / targetRect.width) * 100,
                8,
                92
            )
            localY = clamp(
                ((e.clientY - targetRect.top) / targetRect.height) * 100,
                8,
                92
            )
        }
        setImpactPos((prev) => {
            const n = [...prev]
            n[i] = { x: localX, y: localY }
            return n
        })
        const nextHits = [...hits]
        if (nextHits[i] >= 3) return
        nextHits[i] = Math.min(3, nextHits[i] + 1)
        setHits(nextHits)
        setStrike((s) => s + 1)
        setFiringIndex(i)
        const fx = {
            id: Date.now() + i + nextHits[i],
            x: pos[i]?.x || 50,
            y: pos[i]?.y || 50,
            tone:
                nextHits[i] >= 3
                    ? i % 2
                        ? "violet"
                        : "gold"
                    : i % 2
                      ? "violet"
                      : "cyan",
        }
        setBursts((a) => [...a.slice(-10), fx])
        setTimeout(() => setBursts((a) => a.filter((x) => x.id !== fx.id)), 850)
        sfx(nextHits[i] >= 3 ? "win" : "tap")
        vibrate(nextHits[i] >= 3 ? 22 : 10)
        const progress =
            (nextHits.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / (words.length * 3)) * 100
        onProgress?.(pct(progress), `${pct(progress)}% CLEARED`)
        if (nextHits[i] >= 3) {
            setTimeout(
                () =>
                    setRemoved((prev) => {
                        const n = [...prev]
                        n[i] = true
                        const done = n.every(Boolean)
                        if (done) setTimeout(() => onDone(300), 320)
                        return n
                    }),
                360
            )
        }
        setTimeout(() => setFiringIndex(-1), 240)
    }
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className={`arena universalToolArena premiumArena tool-kind-${kind} ${toolActive ? "toolArmed" : ""}`}
            onMouseEnter={() => setPointerInside(true)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setPointerInside(false)}
            onMouseMove={updatePointer}
            onDoubleClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        >
            <div className="universalToolFieldGlow" />
            <div className="universalToolField">
                {words.map((w, i) =>
                    !removed[i] ? (
                        <motion.button
                            key={i}
                            onClick={(e) => hitObject(i, e)}
                            className={`universalToolObject ${objectClass} damage-${Math.min(2, hits[i] || 0)} ${toolActive ? "armed" : ""} ${firingIndex === i ? "targeted" : ""}`}
                            style={{
                                left: (pos[i]?.x || 50) + "%",
                                top: (pos[i]?.y || 50) + "%",
                                rotate: pos[i]?.r || 0,
                            }}
                            animate={
                                hits[i] >= 3
                                    ? {
                                          scale: [1, 1.12, 0.16],
                                          opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                          rotate: [
                                              pos[i]?.r || 0,
                                              (pos[i]?.r || 0) +
                                                  (i % 2 ? 9 : -9),
                                              (pos[i]?.r || 0) +
                                                  (i % 2 ? 26 : -26),
                                          ],
                                          filter: [
                                              "brightness(1)",
                                              "brightness(2.3) saturate(1.35)",
                                              "blur(14px) brightness(2)",
                                          ],
                                      }
                                    : firingIndex === i
                                      ? {
                                            scale: [1, 1.08, 1],
                                            x: [0, -3, 3, 0],
                                            y: [0, 2, -2, 0],
                                            filter: [
                                                "brightness(1)",
                                                "brightness(1.9)",
                                                "brightness(1.05)",
                                            ],
                                        }
                                      : reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : {
                                              y: [-3, 3, -3],
                                              scale: [1, 1.02, 1],
                                          }
                            }
                            transition={
                                hits[i] >= 3
                                    ? {
                                          duration: 0.58,
                                          ease: [0.16, 0.82, 0.23, 1],
                                      }
                                    : firingIndex === i
                                      ? { duration: 0.24 }
                                      : {
                                            duration: 2.6 + i * 0.08,
                                            repeat: Infinity,
                                            ease: "easeInOut",
                                        }
                            }
                        >
                            <ExactWords text={w} max={18} min={8} />
                            <i className="objectSheen" />
                            <i className="objectRing" />
                            {hits[i] >= 1 ? (
                                <i className="objectMark m1" />
                            ) : null}
                            {hits[i] >= 2 ? (
                                <i className="objectMark m2" />
                            ) : null}
                            <b className="toolHitCount">
                                {Math.min(hits[i], 3)} / 3
                            </b>
                            {firingIndex === i ? (
                                <div
                                    className={`localToolImpact kind-${kind}`}
                                    style={{
                                        ["--ix"]: `${impactPos[i]?.x || 50}%`,
                                        ["--iy"]: `${impactPos[i]?.y || 50}%`,
                                    }}
                                >
                                    <em />
                                    <span>
                                        {universalToolImpactLabel(kind, game)}
                                    </span>
                                    {kind === "torch" ? (
                                        <>
                                            <i className="heatBloom" />
                                            <i className="meltDripFx d1" />
                                            <i className="meltDripFx d2" />
                                            <i className="meltSteamFx s1" />
                                            <i className="meltSteamFx s2" />
                                        </>
                                    ) : null}
                                </div>
                            ) : null}
                        </motion.button>
                    ) : null
                )}
                {bursts.map((f) => (
                    <PremiumBurst
                        key={f.id}
                        x={f.x}
                        y={f.y}
                        tone={f.tone}
                        big={f.tone === "gold"}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>
            <button
                className={`toolActivateDock kind-${kind} ${toolActive ? "selected" : ""}`}
                onClick={armTool}
            >
                <span>
                    {toolActive
                        ? actionName + " ACTIVE"
                        : "ACTIVATE " + actionName}
                </span>
                <i />
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus universalToolStatus">
                <b>
                    {completed >= words.length
                        ? `ALL ${words.length} CLEARED`
                        : toolActive
                          ? `${completed} / ${words.length} CLEARED · 3 HITS EACH`
                          : `${words.length} OBJECTS READY`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    {toolActive
                        ? kind === "torch"
                            ? `Aim the blow torch anywhere on any cube and fire. Heat lands exactly where you point, and the 3rd hit fully melts that cube.`
                            : `Point the ${actionName.toLowerCase()} at any object and click it. Each object dies on the 3rd hit.`
                        : `Activate once. Your mouse becomes the ${actionName.toLowerCase()} until every object is gone.`}
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {completed} / {words.length}
            </div>
            {toolActive && pointerInside ? (
                <div
                    className={`universalToolCursor kind-${kind} ${firingIndex >= 0 ? "firing" : ""}`}
                    style={{ left: toolPos.x + "%", top: toolPos.y + "%" }}
                >
                    <i className="toolBody" />
                    <i className="toolAccent" />
                    <b>{game.name.toUpperCase()}</b>
                </div>
            ) : null}
        </div>
    )
}
function BinLiteralEngine({ entries, onDone, sfx, reduced, onProgress }) {
    const words = React.useMemo(
        () => exactInputWords(entries, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES),
        [entries.join("|")]
    )
    const arenaRef = React.useRef(null),
        binMouthRef = React.useRef(null),
        bubbleRefs = React.useRef([])
    const [binned, setBinned] = React.useState([]),
        [allMode, setAllMode] = React.useState(false),
        [slam, setSlam] = React.useState(0)
    const [targets, setTargets] = React.useState({})
    React.useEffect(() => {
        setBinned(words.map(() => false))
        setAllMode(false)
        setSlam(0)
        setTargets({})
        onProgress?.(0, "0% BINNED")
    }, [entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const positions = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            [
                { x: 10, y: 16 },
                { x: 28, y: 10 },
                { x: 48, y: 14 },
                { x: 68, y: 10 },
                { x: 86, y: 17 },
                { x: 13, y: 44 },
                { x: 31, y: 38 },
                { x: 69, y: 38 },
                { x: 87, y: 44 },
                { x: 50, y: 50 },
            ].slice(0, Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)),
        [words.length]
    )
    const measureTarget = (i) => {
        const el = bubbleRefs.current[i],
            b = el?.getBoundingClientRect(),
            m = binMouthRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!b || !m) return { x: 0, y: 150 }
        // EOS I3-E7: x/y animate from the home slot → subtract the visible drag translation (screen px → CSS px)
        let tx = 0,
            ty = 0,
            k = 1
        try {
            const t = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(getComputedStyle(el).transform)
            tx = t.m41 || 0
            ty = t.m42 || 0
            const kk = b.width / (el.offsetWidth * Math.hypot(t.a, t.b))
            if (Number.isFinite(kk) && kk > 0.05) k = kk
        } catch {}
        return {
            x: (m.left + m.width / 2 - (b.left + b.width / 2)) / k + tx,
            y: (m.top + m.height / 2 - (b.top + b.height / 2)) / k + ty,
        }
    }
    const finishIf = (next) => {
        if (next.length && next.every(Boolean))
            setTimeout(() => onDone(340), 900)
    }
    const binOne = (i, force = false) => {
        if (allMode || binned[i]) return
        if (!force) {
            const b = bubbleRefs.current[i]?.getBoundingClientRect(),
                m = binMouthRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (!b || !m) return
            const cx = b.left + b.width / 2,
                cy = b.top + b.height / 2
            const hit =
                cx >= m.left - 70 &&
                cx <= m.right + 70 &&
                cy >= m.top - 80 &&
                cy <= m.bottom + 90
            if (!hit) {
                sfx("soft")
                vibrate(4)
                return
            }
        }
        setTargets((prev) => ({ ...prev, [i]: measureTarget(i) }))
        const next = [...binned]
        next[i] = true
        setBinned(next)
        setSlam((v) => v + 1)
        const count = next.filter(Boolean).length,
            p = pct((count / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% BINNED`)
        sfx(next.every(Boolean) ? "win" : "pop")
        vibrate(next.every(Boolean) ? 22 : 10)
        finishIf(next)
    }
    const binAll = () => {
        if (allMode || binned.every(Boolean)) return
        setAllMode(true)
        const remaining = words.map((_, i) => i).filter((i) => !binned[i])
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(24)
        const measured = {}
        remaining.forEach((i) => (measured[i] = measureTarget(i)))
        setTargets((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...measured }))
        remaining.forEach((i, n) =>
            setTimeout(
                () =>
                    setBinned((prev) => {
                        const next = [...prev]
                        next[i] = true
                        const count = next.filter(Boolean).length,
                            p = pct((count / Math.max(1, words.length)) * 100)
                        onProgress?.(p, `${p}% BINNED`)
                        setSlam((v) => v + 1)
                        return next
                    }),
                n * 85
            )
        )
        setTimeout(() => onDone(400), remaining.length * 85 + 900)
    }
    const count = binned.filter(Boolean).length,
        slotCount = Math.max(MIN_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES, words.length)
    return (
        <div
            ref={arenaRef}
            className="arena binLiteralArena premiumArena freeAngleBinArena"
        >
            <div className="binBubbleField">
                {Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const word = words[i],
                        p = positions[i] || { x: 50, y: 20 }
                    if (!word)
                        return (
                            <div
                                key={`bin-empty-${i}`}
                                className="binBubbleSlot"
                                style={{ left: p.x + "%", top: p.y + "%" }}
                            >
                                <div
                                    className="binWordBubble emptyBubble"
                                    aria-hidden="true"
                                />
                            </div>
                        )
                    const gone = !!binned[i],
                        target = targets[i] || { x: 0, y: 0 }
                    return (
                        <div
                            key={`bin-slot-${i}-${word}`}
                            className="binBubbleSlot"
                            style={{ left: p.x + "%", top: p.y + "%" }}
                        >
                            <motion.button
                                ref={(el) => {
                                    bubbleRefs.current[i] = el
                                }}
                                className={
                                    "binWordBubble allCircularBubble " +
                                    (gone ? "binned" : "")
                                }
                                drag={!gone && !allMode}
                                dragConstraints={arenaRef}
                                dragElastic={0.05}
                                dragMomentum={false}
                                onDragEnd={() => binOne(i, false)}
                                onDoubleClick={() => binOne(i, true)}
                                disabled={gone || allMode}
                                initial={false}
                                animate={
                                    gone
                                        ? {
                                              x: target.x,
                                              y: target.y,
                                              scale: [1, 0.82, 0.08],
                                              rotate: [0, i % 2 ? 18 : -18, 34],
                                              opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                          }
                                        : reduced
                                          ? {}
                                          : { y: [-2, 3, -2] }
                                }
                                transition={
                                    gone
                                        ? {
                                              duration: 0.58,
                                              delay: allMode
                                                  ? (i % 10) * 0.025
                                                  : 0,
                                              ease: "easeIn",
                                          }
                                        : {
                                              duration: 2.4 + i * 0.06,
                                              repeat: Infinity,
                                              ease: "easeInOut",
                                          }
                                }
                            >
                                <span>{displayText(word, 22)}</span>
                                <b>DRAG</b>
                            </motion.button>
                        </div>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <div
                className={"neonBin masterBin " + (slam ? "slam" : "")}
                key={`bin-slam-${slam}`}
            >
                <div ref={binMouthRef} className="binMouthTarget" />
                <i className="binLid" />
                <span>THINKSTILL BIN</span>
                <b>{count}</b>
            </div>
            <button
                className="bigAction binAllButton"
                onClick={binAll}
                disabled={allMode || count >= words.length}
            >
                {count >= words.length
                    ? "ALL BINNED"
                    : allMode
                      ? "BINNING EVERYTHING…"
                      : "BIN THEM ALL"}
            </button>
            <div className="literalStatus">
                <b>
                    {count >= words.length
                        ? "BIN CLEARED"
                        : `${count} / ${words.length} WORDS IN THE BIN`}
                </b>
                <span>
                    No scrolling. Grab any circular word bubble and throw it
                    toward the bin from the left, right, above or diagonally. It
                    only disappears when it actually reaches the bin opening.
                    Double-click also sends that one directly; BIN THEM ALL
                    sends every remaining bubble in together.
                </span>
            </div>
            <div className="literalProgress">
                {count} / {words.length} BINNED
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

function splitThoughtIntoSix(text) {
    const raw = String(text || "").trim()
    const tokens = raw.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    if (!tokens.length) return Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => "THIS THOUGHT")
    if (tokens.length >= 6) {
        const out = Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => [])
        tokens.forEach((token, i) => {
            const bucket = Math.min(5, Math.floor((i * 6) / tokens.length))
            out[bucket].push(token)
        })
        return out.map((part, i) => part.join(" ") || tokens[i % tokens.length])
    }
    return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => tokens[i % tokens.length] || raw)
}

function releaseEmotionProfile(input) {
    {
        const eosProfile = EosProfileOverride(input)
        if (eosProfile) return eosProfile
    }
    const raw = Array.isArray(input) ? input.join(" ") : String(input || "")
    return (
        RELEASE_INPUT_EMOTION_PROFILES.find((p) => p.test.test(raw)) ||
        RELEASE_DEFAULT_EMOTION_PROFILE
    )
}
function releaseGestureForGame(game) {
    const a = `${game?.action || ""} ${game?.hook || ""}`.toLowerCase()
    if (Number(game?.id) >= 111) return { arrow: "", verb: ({ hold: "HOLD", holdRelease: "HOLD", drag: "DRAG", dragTo: "DRAG", slow: "DRAG", swipe: "SWIPE", sling: "PULL" })[EOS_GAME_META[Number(game.id)]?.gesture] || "TAP" }
    if (
        game?.id === 97 ||
        /drag[^.]*right|move[^.]*right|swipe[^.]*right|\bright\b/.test(a)
    )
        return { arrow: "→", verb: /swipe/.test(a) ? "SWIPE" : "DRAG" }
    if (
        game?.id === 101 ||
        /drag[^.]*left|pull[^.]*left|move[^.]*left|swipe[^.]*left|\bleft\b/.test(
            a
        )
    )
        return {
            arrow: "←",
            verb: /swipe/.test(a) ? "SWIPE" : /pull/.test(a) ? "PULL" : "DRAG",
        }
    if (/\bup\b|lift|raise/.test(a))
        return { arrow: "↑", verb: /lift|raise/.test(a) ? "LIFT" : "DRAG" }
    if (/apart|outward|away|throw|launch|flick/.test(a))
        return {
            arrow: "↗",
            verb: /throw|launch|flick/.test(a) ? "FLICK" : "DRAG",
        }
    if (/into|bin|target/.test(a)) return { arrow: "↘", verb: "DRAG" }
    if (game?.id === 105) return { arrow: "", verb: "TAP" }
    if (
        /drag[^.]*down|pull[^.]*down|\bdown\b|lower|drop|drain|lever|cloud/.test(
            a
        ) ||
        [98, 103, 110].includes(game?.id)
    )
        return {
            arrow: "↓",
            verb: /lower/.test(a) ? "LOWER" : /drag/.test(a) ? "DRAG" : "PULL",
        }
    if (/swipe/.test(a)) return { arrow: "↔", verb: "SWIPE" }
    if (/drag|move|slide|peel/.test(a)) return { arrow: "↔", verb: "DRAG" }
    const legacyArrow = Number(game?.id || 0) > 0 && Number(game?.id || 0) < 100
    if (/hold|press and hold|keep pressing/.test(a) || game?.id === 99)
        return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↑" : "", verb: "HOLD" }
    if (/scratch/.test(a))
        return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↗" : "", verb: "SCRATCH" }
    if (/shake/.test(a))
        return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↔" : "", verb: "SHAKE" }
    if (/turn|rotate|knob|dial/.test(a))
        return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↻" : "", verb: "TURN" }
    if (/stomp/.test(a)) return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↓" : "", verb: "STOMP" }
    if (/tap|click|choose|select|press|pop|zap|burn/.test(a))
        return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↑" : "", verb: "TAP" }
    if (/pull/.test(a)) return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↔" : "", verb: "PULL" }
    return { arrow: legacyArrow ? "↑" : "", verb: "TAP" }
}
function dynamicReleaseActionCue(game, entries, index = 0) {
    const profile = releaseEmotionProfile(entries)
    const gesture = releaseGestureForGame(game)
    const offset = Math.abs((Number(game?.id) || 0) + Number(index || 0))
    const target = profile.actions[offset % profile.actions.length]
    return {
        ...gesture,
        target,
        label: `${gesture.verb} TO ${target}`,
        profile,
    }
}

function releaseGamePositiveFlavor(game, index = 0, sessionSeed = 0) {
    const family = game?.family || "Release"
    const bank =
        RELEASE_GAME_POSITIVE_FLAVORS[family] ||
        RELEASE_GAME_POSITIVE_FLAVORS.Release
    const n = Math.abs(
        (Number(index) || 0) +
            (Number(game?.id) || 0) * 5 +
            (Number(sessionSeed) || 0)
    )
    return bank[n % bank.length]
}

function dynamicReleaseStepFeedback(
    entries,
    index = 0,
    characterName = "",
    game = null,
    sessionSeed = 0
) {
    const profile = releaseEmotionProfile(entries)
    const bank =
        RELEASE_COMPACT_FEEDBACK[profile.id] || RELEASE_COMPACT_FEEDBACK.general
    const n = Math.abs(
        Number(index || 0) + Number(game?.id || 0) + Number(sessionSeed || 0)
    )
    return {
        headline: bank[n % bank.length],
    }
}
function dynamicReleaseFinishFeedback(
    entries,
    index = 0,
    characterName = "",
    game = null,
    sessionSeed = 0
) {
    if (Number(game?.id) === 108) {
        return {
            headline: "LESS GRIP ✓",
            shift: "MORE ROOM",
        }
    }
    if (Number(game?.id) === 105) {
        return {
            headline: "DRAMA CUT ✓",
            shift: "JUST EFFECTS",
        }
    }
    const profile = releaseEmotionProfile(entries)
    const bank =
        RELEASE_COMPACT_FINISH[profile.id] || RELEASE_COMPACT_FINISH.general
    const n = Math.abs(
        Number(index || 0) + Number(game?.id || 0) + Number(sessionSeed || 0)
    )
    return {
        headline: bank[n % bank.length],
        shift: "✦ FEEL IT ✦",
    }
}

function LiteralScratchSurface({
    active,
    disabled = false,
    reduced = false,
    onProgress,
    onComplete,
    sfx,
}) {
    const canvasRef = React.useRef(null)
    const surfaceRef = React.useRef(null)
    const toolRef = React.useRef(null)
    const contactRef = React.useRef(false)
    const lastPointRef = React.useRef(null)
    const visitedRef = React.useRef(new Set())
    const completeRef = React.useRef(false)
    const lastSoundRef = React.useRef(0)
    const sizeRef = React.useRef({ w: 0, h: 0 })
    const paintFreshCoating = React.useCallback(() => {
        const canvas = canvasRef.current
        const surface = surfaceRef.current
        if (!canvas || !surface) return
        const rect = surface.getBoundingClientRect()
        const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width))
        const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height))
        sizeRef.current = { w, h }
        const dpr = Math.min(
            2,
            Math.max(
                1,
                typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.devicePixelRatio || 1 : 1
            )
        )
        canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr)
        canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr)
        canvas.style.width = `${w}px`
        canvas.style.height = `${h}px`
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
        if (!ctx) return
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over"
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
        const base = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h)
        base.addColorStop(0, "#dbe7ed")
        base.addColorStop(0.18, "#708b99")
        base.addColorStop(0.34, "#c8d7de")
        base.addColorStop(0.52, "#5e7480")
        base.addColorStop(0.7, "#d7e3e8")
        base.addColorStop(1, "#718895")
        ctx.fillStyle = base
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
        const sheen = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
        sheen.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,.48)")
        sheen.addColorStop(0.22, "rgba(255,255,255,.05)")
        sheen.addColorStop(0.58, "rgba(13,31,42,.24)")
        sheen.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,.18)")
        ctx.fillStyle = sheen
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
        ctx.save()
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22
        for (let y = 5; y < h; y += 7) {
            const offset = ((y / 7) % 2) * 6
            for (let x = 4 + offset; x < w; x += 13) {
                const tone = ((x + y) / 7) % 3
                ctx.fillStyle =
                    tone < 1
                        ? "rgba(255,255,255,.34)"
                        : tone < 2
                          ? "rgba(20,39,50,.22)"
                          : "rgba(90,236,255,.13)"
                ctx.fillRect(x, y, 6, 1)
            }
        }
        ctx.restore()
        ctx.save()
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(18,34,44,.34)"
        ctx.lineWidth = 1
        for (let c = 1; c < 3; c += 1) {
            const x = (w * c) / 3
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.moveTo(x, 0)
            ctx.lineTo(x, h)
            ctx.stroke()
        }
        for (let r = 1; r < 3; r += 1) {
            const y = (h * r) / 3
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.moveTo(0, y)
            ctx.lineTo(w, y)
            ctx.stroke()
        }
        ctx.restore()
        ctx.save()
        ctx.font = `900 ${Math.max(12, Math.min(17, w / 31))}px system-ui, sans-serif`
        ctx.textAlign = "center"
        ctx.textBaseline = "middle"
        ctx.letterSpacing = "1px"
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(14,31,42,.58)"
        ctx.fillText("SCRATCH TO REVEAL", w / 2, h / 2)
        ctx.restore()
    }, [])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        visitedRef.current = new Set()
        completeRef.current = false
        lastPointRef.current = null
        onProgress?.(0)
        paintFreshCoating()
        const surface = surfaceRef.current
        if (!surface || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return
        const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            if (visitedRef.current.size === 0) paintFreshCoating()
        })
        ro.observe(surface)
        return () => ro.disconnect()
    }, [paintFreshCoating])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (!active) {
            contactRef.current = false
            lastPointRef.current = null
            if (toolRef.current) toolRef.current.style.opacity = "0"
        }
    }, [active])
    const markCoverage = (x, y, radius) => {
        const { w, h } = sizeRef.current
        if (!w || !h) return 0
        const cols = 34
        const rows = 20
        const cellW = w / cols
        const cellH = h / rows
        const cx = Math.floor(x / cellW)
        const cy = Math.floor(y / cellH)
        const rx = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(radius / cellW))
        const ry = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(radius / cellH))
        const set = visitedRef.current
        for (let yy = cy - ry; yy <= cy + ry; yy += 1) {
            if (yy < 0 || yy >= rows) continue
            for (let xx = cx - rx; xx <= cx + rx; xx += 1) {
                if (xx < 0 || xx >= cols) continue
                const px = (xx + 0.5) * cellW
                const py = (yy + 0.5) * cellH
                if ((px - x) ** 2 + (py - y) ** 2 <= (radius * 1.14) ** 2) {
                    set.add(yy * cols + xx)
                }
            }
        }
        const raw = set.size / (cols * rows)
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((raw / 0.62) * 100)))
    }
    const carve = (x, y, pointerType = "mouse") => {
        const canvas = canvasRef.current
        if (!canvas || disabled || !active || completeRef.current) return
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
        if (!ctx) return
        const radius = pointerType === "touch" ? 23 : 19
        const prev = lastPointRef.current || { x, y }
        ctx.save()
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "destination-out"
        ctx.lineCap = "round"
        ctx.lineJoin = "round"
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.58
        ctx.lineWidth = radius * 2.25
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y)
        ctx.lineTo(x, y)
        ctx.stroke()
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1
        ctx.lineWidth = radius * 1.42
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y)
        ctx.lineTo(x, y)
        ctx.stroke()
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.2
        ;[-7, -3, 4, 8].forEach((off, k) => {
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.moveTo(prev.x + off, prev.y + (k % 2 ? 2 : -2))
            ctx.lineTo(x + off, y + (k % 2 ? -2 : 2))
            ctx.stroke()
        })
        ctx.restore()
        lastPointRef.current = { x, y }
        const pct = markCoverage(x, y, radius)
        onProgress?.(pct)
        const now =
            typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now()
        if (now - lastSoundRef.current > 115) {
            lastSoundRef.current = now
            sfx?.("soft")
        }
        if (pct >= 100 && !completeRef.current) {
            completeRef.current = true
            onComplete?.()
        }
    }
    const localPoint = (e) => {
        const rect = surfaceRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect) return { x: 0, y: 0 }
        return {
            x: Math.max(0, Math.min(rect.width, e.clientX - rect.left)),
            y: Math.max(0, Math.min(rect.height, e.clientY - rect.top)),
        }
    }
    const placeTool = (x, y) => {
        const tool = toolRef.current
        if (!tool) return
        tool.style.opacity = active && !disabled ? "1" : "0"
        tool.style.transform = `translate3d(${x - 28}px, ${y - 56}px, 0) rotate(-16deg)`
    }
    const handlePointerMove = (e) => {
        if (!active || disabled) return
        const { x, y } = localPoint(e)
        placeTool(x, y)
        const shouldScratch =
            e.pointerType === "mouse" ||
            contactRef.current ||
            (typeof e.buttons === "number" && e.buttons > 0)
        if (!shouldScratch) {
            lastPointRef.current = null
            return
        }
        e.preventDefault()
        carve(x, y, e.pointerType)
    }
    return (
        <div
            ref={surfaceRef}
            className={`literalScratchSurface ${active ? "isActive" : ""} ${disabled ? "isDisabled" : ""}`}
            onPointerEnter={(e) => {
                if (!active || disabled) return
                const { x, y } = localPoint(e)
                placeTool(x, y)
            }}
            onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
            onPointerDown={(e) => {
                if (!active || disabled) return
                contactRef.current = true
                const { x, y } = localPoint(e)
                placeTool(x, y)
                carve(x, y, e.pointerType)
                try {
                    e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId)
                } catch {}
            }}
            onPointerUp={() => {
                contactRef.current = false
                lastPointRef.current = null
            }}
            onPointerCancel={() => {
                contactRef.current = false
                lastPointRef.current = null
            }}
            onPointerLeave={() => {
                contactRef.current = false
                lastPointRef.current = null
                if (toolRef.current) toolRef.current.style.opacity = "0"
            }}
        >
            <canvas
                ref={canvasRef}
                className="literalScratchCanvas"
                aria-label="Scratch coating"
            />
            <div
                ref={toolRef}
                className={`realScratchTool ${active ? "toolLive" : ""}`}
                aria-hidden="true"
            >
                <span className="scratchBlade">
                    <i />
                </span>
                <span className="scratchFerrule" />
                <span className="scratchHandle">
                    <i className="grip g1" />
                    <i className="grip g2" />
                    <i className="grip g3" />
                    <i className="grip g4" />
                </span>
                {!reduced ? <span className="scratchDust" /> : null}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}

    const echoWords = imageOnlyMode

        : words.length <= 5
          ? words

        () => splitThoughtIntoSix(phraseText),

            },
        ]
        return map[i % map.length]
    }
    const juggleTapTarget = 3
    const weirdBubbleFontPx = (text) => {

        if (n > 90) return 7
        if (n > 72) return 8
        if (n > 56) return 9
        if (n > 42) return 10
        if (n > 30) return 11

                    : imageSrc
                      ? [imageSrc]
                      : [],

    )

    const hotPotatoPositiveSlots = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            expandUploadImageSlots(
                positiveImageSources && positiveImageSources.length
                    ? positiveImageSources
                    : [],
                IMAGE_ONLY_BUBBLE_SLOTS
            ),
        [(positiveImageSources || []).join("|")]
    )

                                                            {letter}
                                                        </span>
                                                    )
                                                })
                                            })}
                                    </div>
                                ) : null}
                                {uploadImageSlots.length ? (
                                    <div className="rainWashedPics">
                                        {words
                                            .slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
                                            .map((_, i) => {
                                                const cloud =
                                                    UNIQUE_SPREAD[
                                                        i % UNIQUE_SPREAD.length
                                                    ]
                                                const src = uploadImageFor(i)
                                                if (!src) return null
                                                return (
                                                    <img
                                                        key={`pic-${i}`}
                                                        className="rainWashedPic"
                                                        src={src}
                                                        alt=""
                                                        draggable={false}
                                                        style={{
                                                            left: `${clamp(cloud.x, 4, 96)}%`,
                                                            top: `${clamp(cloud.y + 7, 8, 56)}%`,
                                                            animationDelay: `${0.08 + i * 0.08}s`,
                                                            animationDuration: `${1.95 + (i % 3) * 0.12}s`,

                                    <i />
                                    <i />

                                <div className="rainCaption">
                                    WASH IT ALL THE WAY OUT
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                </>,
                "All 5–6 word-clouds stay visible together. Pull every cloud down; when the final cloud is pulled, heavy rain starts and the actual letters wash off the clouds, fall to the ground and die away.",
                "allWords"
            )
        default:
            return shell(
                <>
                    <W />
                    <U onClick={() => advance()}>COMPLETE {game.name}</U>
                </>,
                "Dedicated fallback for this release."
            )
    }
}
function globalReleaseGuideTextLegacy(game, value = 0, status = "") {
    const v = pct(value)
    const action = guideSentenceCase(shortHint(game, game.action))
    const cleanStatus = guideSentenceCase(String(status || "").trim())
    if (v <= 0) return `How to play · ${action}`
    if (v >= 100) return "Complete · Released"
    if (cleanStatus && !/^\d+%\s/.test(cleanStatus))
        return `Next move · ${cleanStatus}`
    return `Next move · ${action}${cleanStatus ? ` · ${cleanStatus}` : ""}`
}
function globalReleaseMindBendTextLegacy(game) {
    const learning = String(game?.mindBend || game?.mind || "").trim()
    if (learning) return learning
    const mechanism = String(game?.mechanism || "").trim()
    if (mechanism)
        return `This move helps loosen the thought by helping you ${mechanism.toLowerCase()}.`
    return "The thought can be present without needing to stay in control."
}
// Stage drags (8, 28, 34, 47 …): a press that started just off a dragged object selected its word, and the next
// grab then began a native text drag (dragstart → pointercancel), so the object froze for good. The game stage
// never needs selectable text or native drag-and-drop: block both, and drop any stray selection on press.
const TS_STAGE_NO_SELECT = {
    userSelect: "none",
    WebkitUserSelect: "none",
    WebkitTouchCallout: "none",
}
function tsClearStageSelection() {
    try {
        const sel = window.getSelection && window.getSelection()
        if (sel && sel.rangeCount && !sel.isCollapsed) sel.removeAllRanges()
    } catch (e) {}
}
function tsBlockNativeDrag(e) {
    e.preventDefault()
}
function UniqueReleaseEngineLegacy({

    reduced,

    const words = React.useMemo(() => {
        const src = (entries.length ? entries : ["THIS"])
            .map((x) => String(x || "").trim())
            .filter(Boolean)
        return src.length ? src : ["THIS"]
    }, [entries.join("|")])
    const phraseText = React.useMemo(() => words.join(" "), [words.join("|")])
    const [idx, setIdx] = React.useState(0)
    const [step, setStep] = React.useState(0)
    const [meter, setMeter] = React.useState(0)

    const [scratchCells, setScratchCells] = React.useState([])
    const [hitsByIndex, setHitsByIndex] = React.useState(() =>
        words.map(() => 0)
    )
    const timer = React.useRef(null)
    const busy = React.useRef(false)
    const dragStart = React.useRef({ x: 0, y: 0, t: 0 })
    // bumped when a pull falls short: the piece remounts back at its start, so the
    // next pull always has a full screen of room (a phone has no space past the edge)
    const [regrip, setRegrip] = React.useState(0)
    const [selectedWeirdProp, setSelectedWeirdProp] = React.useState(null)
    const [weirdAssignments, setWeirdAssignments] = React.useState([
        -1, -1, -1, -1, -1,
    ])
    const weirdBubbleRefs = React.useRef([])
    const [echoHoldingIndex, setEchoHoldingIndex] = React.useState(null)
    const echoHoldingRef = React.useRef(null)
    const echoHoldTimer = React.useRef(null)
    const current =
        words[Math.min(idx, Math.max(0, words.length - 1))] || game.name
    const engineBubbleTextPx = Math.max(
        15,
        Math.min(18, Number(bubbleTextPx) || 4)
    )
    const imageOnlyMode = isImageOnlyEntries(words)
    const fingerTrapWords = imageOnlyMode
        ? words.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
        : words.length <= 5
          ? words
          : [...words.slice(0, 4), words.slice(4).join(" ")]
    const echoWords = imageOnlyMode
        ? words.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
        : words.length <= 5
          ? words
          : [...words.slice(0, 4), words.slice(4).join(" ")]
    const weirdProps = [
        { label: "GOOGLY", icon: "◉ ◉" },
        { label: "MOUSTACHE", icon: "〰" },
        { label: "TINY HAT", icon: "△" },
        { label: "STAR", icon: "✦" },
        { label: "WIGGLE", icon: "≈" },
    ]
    const weirdWords = words.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
    const tugParts = React.useMemo(
        () => splitThoughtIntoSix(phraseText),
        [phraseText]
    )
    const hotPotatoWords = words.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
    const juggleTapTarget = 3
    const weirdBubbleFontPx = (text) => {
        const n = String(text || "").length
        if (n > 90) return 7
        if (n > 72) return 8
        if (n > 56) return 9
        if (n > 42) return 10
        if (n > 30) return 11
        if (n > 22) return 12
        if (n > 15) return 13
        return 15
    }
    const weirdPropBadgeStyle = (propIndex) => {
        switch (propIndex) {
            case 0:
                return {
                    top: "14%",
                    left: "50%",
                    right: "auto",
                    bottom: "auto",
                    transform: "translate(-50%, 0)",
                }
            case 1:
                return {
                    top: "54%",
                    left: "50%",
                    right: "auto",
                    bottom: "auto",
                    transform: "translate(-50%, -50%)",
                }
            case 2:
                return {
                    top: "2%",
                    left: "50%",
                    right: "auto",
                    bottom: "auto",
                    transform: "translate(-50%, 0)",
                }
            case 3:
                return {

                    transform: "translate(-50%, 0)",
                }
            default:

                    top: "14%",
                    left: "50%",
                    right: "auto",
                    bottom: "auto",
                    transform: "translate(-50%, 0)",
                }

    }
    const uploadImageSlots = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            expandUploadImageSlots(
                imageSources && imageSources.length
                    ? imageSources
                    : imageSrc
                      ? [imageSrc]
                      : [],
                IMAGE_ONLY_BUBBLE_SLOTS
            ),
        [(imageSources || []).join("|"), imageSrc || ""]
    )
    const uploadImageFor = (i) => uploadImageAt(uploadImageSlots, i)
    const ThoughtImage = ({ label = "UPLOADED IMAGE", className = "" }) => null
    const resetMoment = () => {
        setStep(0)
        setMeter(0)
        setMeter2(0)
        setPhase(0)
        setChoice("")
        setBeat(0)
        setWait(0)
        setArmed(false)
        setFlash(0)
        setScratchCells([])
        setSelectedWeirdProp(null)
        setWeirdAssignments([-1, -1, -1, -1, -1])
        setEchoHoldingIndex(null)
        echoHoldingRef.current = null
        clearInterval(echoHoldTimer.current)
        setHitsByIndex(words.map(() => 0))

            clearInterval(echoHoldTimer.current)
        }
    }, [game.id, entries.join("|"), words.length])
    const report = (fraction, label) => {
        const p = pct(fraction * 100)
        onProgress?.(p, label || `${p}% ${game.name}`)
    }
    const advance = (gain = 250, delay = 380) => {
        if (busy.current) return
        busy.current = true
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(18)
        report((idx + 1) / Math.max(1, words.length))
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (idx >= words.length - 1) {
                onDone(gain)
            } else {
                setIdx((i) => i + 1)
                resetMoment()
                busy.current = false
            }
        }, delay)
    }
    const completeAll = (gain = 280, delay = 420) => {
        if (busy.current) return
        busy.current = true
        sfx("win")
        vibrate(22)
        report(1)
        setTimeout(() => onDone(gain), delay)
    }
    const addDone = (i, finish = true) => {
        if (doneSet.includes(i)) return
        const next = [...doneSet, i]
        setDoneSet(next)
        sfx("pop")
        vibrate(10)
        report(next.length / Math.max(1, words.length))
        if (finish && next.length === words.length)
            setTimeout(() => completeAll(300, 260), 280)
    }
    const releaseFingerTrap = (i) => {
        if (doneSet.includes(i) || busy.current) return
        const next = [...doneSet, i]
        setDoneSet(next)
        sfx(next.length === fingerTrapWords.length ? "win" : "pop")
        vibrate(next.length === fingerTrapWords.length ? 24 : 11)
        report(
            next.length / Math.max(1, fingerTrapWords.length),
            `${next.length}/${fingerTrapWords.length} TRAPS RELEASED`
        )
        if (next.length === fingerTrapWords.length)
            setTimeout(() => completeAll(340, 260), 420)
    }
    const stopEchoHold = (reset = true) => {
        clearInterval(echoHoldTimer.current)
        const holding = echoHoldingRef.current
        if (reset && holding !== null && !doneSet.includes(holding)) {
            setHitsByIndex((prev) => {
                const next = [...prev]
                next[holding] = 0
                return next
            })
        }
        echoHoldingRef.current = null
        setEchoHoldingIndex(null)
    }
    const startEchoHold = (i) => {
        if (doneSet.includes(i) || busy.current) return
        stopEchoHold(true)
        echoHoldingRef.current = i
        setEchoHoldingIndex(i)
        sfx("tap")
        vibrate(6)
        echoHoldTimer.current = setInterval(() => {
            setHitsByIndex((prev) => {
                const next = [...prev]
                const currentVal = next[i] || 0
                const value = Math.min(100, currentVal + 2)
                next[i] = value
                if (value >= 100) {
                    clearInterval(echoHoldTimer.current)
                    echoHoldingRef.current = null
                    setEchoHoldingIndex(null)
