                                        return
                                    }
                                    const n = Math.min(3, step + 1)
                                    setStep(n)
                                    sfx(n >= 3 ? "win" : "tap")
                                    vibrate(n >= 3 ? 26 : 10)
                                    report(
                                        0.12 + n * 0.27,
                                        `TRAP LOCK ${n} / 3`
                                    )
                                    if (n >= 3) {
                                        setPhase(1)
                                        report(1, "TRAPDOOR RELEASED")
                                        setTimeout(
                                            () => completeAll(420, 280),
                                            1050
                                        )
                                    }
                                }}
                            >
                                <span>↓</span>
                                <b>DRAG</b>
                                <em>LEVER</em>
                            </motion.button>
                            {choice !== "" && !phase ? (
                                <motion.div
                                    className="magicLeverGuide"
                                    animate={
                                        reduced
                                            ? {}
                                            : {
                                                  y: [0, 10, 0],
                                                  opacity: [0.55, 1, 0.55],
                                              }
                                    }
                                    transition={{
                                        duration: 0.9,
                                        repeat: Infinity,
                                    }}
                                >
                                    ↓ PULL DOWN
                                </motion.div>
                            ) : null}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </>,
                "1) SELECT any box. The drag-down tool jumps directly underneath that exact selected box. 2) DRAG the tool DOWN 3 separate times. 3) On the third pull, only that selected box drops through the trapdoor. WHY: choosing first isolates one thought, and the three deliberate downward pulls make the release feel intentional and physical.",
                "allWords"
            )
        case 99:
            return shell(
                <>
                    <div
                        className={`echoSplitStage ${phase ? "silenced" : ""}`}
                    >
                        <div className="echoSplitGrid">
                            {echoWords.map((w, i) => {
                                const gone = doneSet.includes(i)
                                const holdPct = Math.max(
                                    0,
                                    Math.min(100, hitsByIndex[i] || 0)
                                )
                                const secondsLeft = Math.max(
                                    0,
                                    5 - holdPct / 20
                                )
                                return (
                                    <motion.button
                                        key={i}
                                        type="button"
                                        className={`echoHoldBubble allCircularBubble ${gone ? "gone" : ""} ${echoHoldingIndex === i ? "holding" : ""}`}
                                        disabled={gone}
                                        onPointerDown={() => startEchoHold(i)}
                                        onPointerUp={() => stopEchoHold(false)}
                                        onPointerCancel={() =>
                                            stopEchoHold(false)
                                        }
                                        onPointerLeave={() =>
                                            stopEchoHold(false)
                                        }
                                        animate={
                                            gone
                                                ? {
                                                      scale: [1, 1.08, 0.12],
                                                      opacity: [1, 1, 0],
                                                      filter: [
                                                          "brightness(1)",
                                                          "brightness(1.28)",
                                                          "blur(10px)",
                                                      ],
                                                  }
                                                : reduced
                                                  ? {}
                                                  : {
                                                        y: [0, -4, 0],
                                                        scale: [1, 1.02, 1],
                                                    }
                                        }
                                        transition={
                                            gone
                                                ? {
                                                      duration: 0.44,
                                                      ease: "easeIn",
                                                  }
                                                : {
                                                      duration: 1.6 + i * 0.1,
                                                      repeat: Infinity,
                                                      ease: "easeInOut",
                                                  }
                                        }
                                    >
                                        <span
                                            className="echoBubbleWord"
                                            ref={(el) => {
                                                if (el)
                                                    el.style.setProperty(
                                                        "font-size",
                                                        `${engineBubbleTextPx}px`,
                                                        "important"
                                                    )
                                            }}
                                        >
                                            {displayText(w, 18)}
                                        </span>
                                        <b className="echoBubbleTimer">
                                            {gone
                                                ? "QUIET"
                                                : `${secondsLeft.toFixed(1)}s`}
                                        </b>
                                        <i
                                            className="echoBubbleHoldFill"
                                            style={{ width: `${holdPct}%` }}
                                        />
                                    </motion.button>
                                )
                            })}
                        </div>
                        {!phase ? (
                            <motion.div
                                className="echoHoldGuide echoSplitGuide"
                                animate={
                                    reduced
                                        ? {}
                                        : {
                                              y: [0, 7, 0],
                                              opacity: [0.6, 1, 0.6],
                                          }
                                }
                                transition={{
                                    duration: 0.95,
                                    repeat: Infinity,
                                }}
                            >
                                <strong>↓</strong>
                                <span>HOLD EACH BUBBLE FOR 5 SECONDS</span>
                            </motion.div>
                        ) : (
                            <div className="echoSilencePayoff">
                                ALL 5 ECHOES SILENCED
                            </div>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </>,
                "The Echo Chamber is now split into 5 circular bubbles. Each bubble fits one grouped word and the attached picture. The user must press and hold each bubble continuously for 5 seconds for that bubble to disappear.",
                "allWords"
            )
        default:
            return shell(
                <>
                    <W />
                    <U onClick={() => advance()}>COMPLETE {game.name}</U>
                </>,
                "Dedicated fallback for this release."
            )
    }
}
function RoutedGameContentLegacy(p) {
    if (!UNIQUE_HERO_IDS.has(p.game.id))
        return <UniqueReleaseEngineLegacy {...p} />
    switch (p.game.id) {
        case 1:
            return <BurstEngine {...p} />
        case 3:
            return <CrackEngine {...p} />
        case 4:
            return <StompEngine {...p} />
        case 6:
            // founder F4: the real handheld zapper + RUSH helper (src/eos/26_eos_game_zap.jsx); classic kept as fallback
            return typeof EosZapperEngine === "function" ? <EosZapperEngine {...p} /> : <ZapEngine {...p} />
        case 9:
            return <LaserSliceEngine {...p} />
        case 15:
            return <ShredEngine {...p} />
        case 16:
            return <MeltEngine {...p} />
        case 18:
            return <BurnEngine {...p} />
        case 19:
            return <EraseClickEngine {...p} />
        case 21:
            return <BinLiteralEngine {...p} />
        case 22:
            return <FlushEngine {...p} />
        case 23:
            return <VacuumEngine {...p} />
        case 24:
            return <SlingshotEngine {...p} />
        case 25:
            return <SwipeAwayEngine {...p} />
        case 41:
            return <UnhookLiteralEngine {...p} />
        case 43:
            return <CutLoopLiteralEngine {...p} />
        case 50:
            return (
                <UnfinishedSentence
                    entries={p.entries}
                    onDone={p.onDone}
                    sfx={p.sfx}
                />
            )
        case 61:
            return <FreezeLiteralEngine {...p} />
        case 71:
            return <DefuseLiteralEngine {...p} />
    }
    switch (p.game.engine) {
        case "E01":
            return <BurstEngine {...p} />
        case "E02":
            return <ImpactEngine {...p} />
        case "E03":
            return <ThrowEngine {...p} />
        case "E04":
            return <DissolveEngine {...p} />
        case "E05":
            return <DetachEngine {...p} />
        case "E06":
            return <RhythmEngine {...p} />
        case "E07":
            return <SortEngine {...p} />
        case "E08":
            return <BalanceEngine {...p} />
        case "E09":
            return <LensEngine {...p} />
        case "E10":
            return <TransformEngine {...p} />
        case "E11":
            return <CatchEngine {...p} />
        case "E12":
            return <ChoiceEngine {...p} />
        case "E13":
            return <ChargeEngine {...p} />
        case "E14":
            return <EraseEngine {...p} />
        case "E15":
            return <SequenceEngine {...p} />
        default:
            return <UniversalToolModeEngine {...p} />
    }
}
function GameEngineLegacy(p) {
    const [progress, setProgress] = React.useState(0)
    const [label, setLabel] = React.useState(progressLabel(p.game, 0))
    const [guideText, setGuideText] = React.useState(() =>
        globalReleaseGuideTextLegacy(p.game, 0)
    )
    const [stepFx, setStepFx] = React.useState(0)
    const [finishFx, setFinishFx] = React.useState(0)
    const [stepRewardVisible, setStepRewardVisible] = React.useState(false)
    const [finishRewardVisible, setFinishRewardVisible] = React.useState(false)
    const [stepBurstVariant, setStepBurstVariant] = React.useState(0)
    const [finishBurstVariant, setFinishBurstVariant] = React.useState(0)
    const [stepRewardAnchor, setStepRewardAnchor] = React.useState({
        x: 74,
        y: 14,
    })
    const [finishRewardAnchor, setFinishRewardAnchor] = React.useState({
        x: 74,
        y: 14,
    })
    const collisionHostRef = React.useRef(null)
    const stepFeedbackRef = React.useRef(null)
    const finishFeedbackRef = React.useRef(null)
    const rewardCursorRef = React.useRef({ x: 74, y: 14 })
    const progressRef = React.useRef(0),
        rewardBucketRef = React.useRef(0),
        lastRewardAt = React.useRef(0),
        finishLock = React.useRef(false),
        stepRewardTimer = React.useRef(null),
        finishRewardTimer = React.useRef(null)
    const rewardSize = Math.max(
        12,
        Math.min(34, 100 / Math.max(3, Math.min(7, p.entries.length || 1)))
    )
    const stepRewardDurationMs = 980
    const finishHoldMs = Math.max(2050, Number(p.finishHoldMs || 2050))
    const finishRewardDurationMs = finishHoldMs
    const finishAdvanceDelayMs = finishHoldMs
    React.useEffect(() => {
        progressRef.current = 0
        rewardBucketRef.current = 0
        lastRewardAt.current = 0
        finishLock.current = false
        setProgress(0)
        setLabel(progressLabel(p.game, 0))
        setGuideText(globalReleaseGuideTextLegacy(p.game, 0))
        setStepFx(0)
        setFinishFx(0)
        setStepRewardVisible(false)
        setFinishRewardVisible(false)
        setStepBurstVariant(0)
        setFinishBurstVariant(0)
        rewardCursorRef.current = { x: 74, y: 14 }
        setStepRewardAnchor({ x: 74, y: 14 })
        setFinishRewardAnchor({ x: 74, y: 14 })
        if (stepRewardTimer.current) clearTimeout(stepRewardTimer.current)
        if (finishRewardTimer.current) clearTimeout(finishRewardTimer.current)
        stepRewardTimer.current = null
        finishRewardTimer.current = null
    }, [p.game.id, p.entries.join("|"), p.imageSrc || "", p.variationSeed || 0])
    React.useEffect(() => {
        return () => {
            if (stepRewardTimer.current) clearTimeout(stepRewardTimer.current)
            if (finishRewardTimer.current)
                clearTimeout(finishRewardTimer.current)
        }
    }, [])
    const updateRewardCursor = React.useCallback((e) => {
        const host = collisionHostRef.current
        if (!host) return
        const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect()
        if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return
        const cx =
            typeof e?.clientX === "number"
                ? e.clientX
                : rect.left + rect.width * 0.74
        const cy =
            typeof e?.clientY === "number"
                ? e.clientY
                : rect.top + rect.height * 0.14
        rewardCursorRef.current = {
            x: clamp(
                ((cx - rect.left) / Math.max(1, rect.width)) * 100,
                0,
                100
            ),
            y: clamp(
                ((cy - rect.top) / Math.max(1, rect.height)) * 100,
                0,
                100
            ),
        }
    }, [])
    const updateRewardCursorWhileDragging = React.useCallback(
        (e) => {
            if (typeof e?.buttons !== "number" || e.buttons !== 0)
                updateRewardCursor(e)
        },
        [updateRewardCursor]
    )
    const fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow = React.useCallback(
        (node, anchor, kind = "step") => {
            const host = collisionHostRef.current
            if (!node || !host) return
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-x", "0px")
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-y", "0px")
            const width = Math.min(node.offsetWidth || 0, rect.width)
            const height = Math.min(node.offsetHeight || 0, rect.height)
            if (!width || !height) return
            const cursorX = (clamp(anchor.x, 0, 100) / 100) * rect.width
            const cursorY = (clamp(anchor.y, 0, 100) / 100) * rect.height
            const rawLeft = cursorX - width / 2
            const rawTop = cursorY - height / 2
            const sidePad = kind === "finish" ? 42 : 34
            const topPad = kind === "finish" ? 58 : 50
            const bottomPad = kind === "finish" ? 28 : 22
            const minLeft = sidePad
            const maxLeft = Math.max(minLeft, rect.width - sidePad - width)
            const minTop = topPad
            const maxTop = Math.max(minTop, rect.height - bottomPad - height)
            const safeLeft = clamp(rawLeft, minLeft, maxLeft)
            const safeTop = clamp(rawTop, minTop, maxTop)
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-x", `${safeLeft - rawLeft}px`)
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-y", `${safeTop - rawTop}px`)
        },
        []
    )
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        if (!stepRewardVisible || !stepFeedbackRef.current) return
        fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow(
            stepFeedbackRef.current,
            stepRewardAnchor,
            "step"
        )
    }, [
        stepRewardVisible,
        stepFx,
        stepRewardAnchor.x,
        stepRewardAnchor.y,
        fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow,
    ])
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        if (!finishRewardVisible || !finishFeedbackRef.current) return
        fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow(
            finishFeedbackRef.current,
            finishRewardAnchor,
            "finish"
        )
    }, [
        finishRewardVisible,
        finishFx,
        finishRewardAnchor.x,
        finishRewardAnchor.y,
        fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow,
    ])
    const triggerStepReward = () => {
        const now = Date.now()
        if (now - lastRewardAt.current < 220) return
        lastRewardAt.current = now
        const anchor = { ...rewardCursorRef.current }
        setStepRewardAnchor(anchor)
        setStepBurstVariant(nextTsRewardVariant(p.game.id))
        setStepFx((x) => x + 1)
        setStepRewardVisible(true)
        if (stepRewardTimer.current) clearTimeout(stepRewardTimer.current)
        stepRewardTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
            setStepRewardVisible(false)
            stepRewardTimer.current = null
        }, stepRewardDurationMs)
        vibrate(12)
    }
    const reportProgress = (value, nextLabel, eosFromSfx) => {
        const v = eosGateProgress(progressRef, value, eosFromSfx),
            previous = progressRef.current
        progressRef.current = v
        const resolvedLabel = nextLabel || progressLabel(p.game, v)
        setProgress(v)
        setLabel(resolvedLabel)
        setGuideText(globalReleaseGuideTextLegacy(p.game, v, resolvedLabel))
        if (v > previous && v < 99) {
            const bucket = Math.floor(v / rewardSize)
            if (bucket > rewardBucketRef.current) {
                rewardBucketRef.current = bucket
                triggerStepReward()
            }
        }
    }
    const wrappedSfx = (kind) => {
        p.sfx(kind)
        if (eosSfxMiss(p.game, kind)) return
        const explicit = usesExplicitProgress(p.game)
        if (!explicit || kind !== "soft") triggerStepReward()
        if (!explicit) {
            const next = pct(progressRef.current + gameProgressStep(p.game))
            reportProgress(next, progressLabel(p.game, next), true)
        }
    }
    const wrappedDone = (bonus = 0) => {
        if (finishLock.current) return
        finishLock.current = true
        progressRef.current = 100
        setProgress(100)
        setLabel(progressLabel(p.game, 100))
        setGuideText(globalReleaseGuideTextLegacy(p.game, 100))
        setFinishRewardAnchor({ ...rewardCursorRef.current })
        setFinishBurstVariant(nextTsRewardVariant(p.game.id))
        setFinishFx((x) => x + 1)
        setStepRewardVisible(false)
        setFinishRewardVisible(true)
        if (stepRewardTimer.current) {
            clearTimeout(stepRewardTimer.current)
            stepRewardTimer.current = null
        }
        if (finishRewardTimer.current) clearTimeout(finishRewardTimer.current)
        finishRewardTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
            setFinishRewardVisible(false)
            finishRewardTimer.current = null
        }, finishRewardDurationMs)
        p.sfx("win")
        vibrate(24)
        setTimeout(() => {
            p.sfx("win")
            vibrate(30)
        }, 170)
        setTimeout(() => {
            p.sfx("win")
            vibrate(40)
        }, 340)
        setTimeout(() => p.onDone(bonus), finishAdvanceDelayMs)
    }
    const ep = {
        ...p,
        imageSrc: p.imageSrc,
        sfx: wrappedSfx,
        onDone: wrappedDone,
        onProgress: reportProgress,
    }
    const content = <RoutedGameContentLegacy {...ep} />
    // F8: shared bubble face (default emotional pictures / uploads, text below inside the bubble)
    useTsBubbleFaces(collisionHostRef, {
        game: p.game,
        entries: p.entries,
        uploads: p.hasUserImages ? p.imageSources || [] : [],
        progress,
        seed: Number(p.variationSeed || 0),
    })
    React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const host = collisionHostRef.current
        if (!host) return
        let raf = 0
        const audit = () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
            raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                const normalise = (value) =>
                    String(value || "")
                        .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase()
                const exactEntries = new Set(
                    p.entries.map(normalise).filter(Boolean)
                )
                Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".tsExactUserText")).forEach(
                    (el) => el.classList.remove("tsExactUserText")
                )
                Array.from(
                    host.querySelectorAll(
                        "span,b,strong,em,button,div,text,tspan"
                    )
                ).forEach((el) => {
                    if (
                        el.closest(
                            ".engineProgressHud,.globalGestureGuide,.globalStepReward,.globalTripleReward,.uniqStatus,.literalStatus,.cleanseStatus"
                        )
                    )
                        return
                    if (
                        Array.from(el.children).some((child) =>
                            normalise(child.textContent || "")
                        )
                    )
                        return
                    const value = normalise(el.textContent || "")
                    if (!value || value.length > 160) return
                    if (exactEntries.has(value))
                        el.classList.add("tsExactUserText")
                })
                const bubblePhotoSelectors =
                    ".allCircularBubble,.wordBubble,.stompWordBubble,.laserTargetBubble,.catchTarget,.choiceObject,.cleanseStone,.chargeOrb,.multiEgg,.zapMultiBubble,.cutLoopWord,.unhookWordBubble,.binWordBubble,.doorThoughtBubble,.echoHoldBubble,.tinySoundBubble,.tugThoughtBubble,.xrayThoughtBubble,.magicTrapBubble,.echoSourceHold,.thoughtPotato,.shelfThoughtBubble,.juggleBall,.coinReleaseBubble,.sinkWordBubble,.uniqWord,.weirdWordBubble,.spaceTile,.ownershipCard,.keepDropCard,.tradeToken,.controlThoughtToken,.scaleDownThought,.stamped,.dramaThoughtBox,.priorityBubbleTray button,.shelfCard,.u104 .volumeRow > span,.exactWordsWithImage"
                const photoVars = Array.from(
                    { length: MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES },
                    (_, i) =>
                        `var(--upload-image-${i + 1}, var(--upload-image-1, var(--upload-image)))`
                )
                const photoGroups = new Map()
                Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(bubblePhotoSelectors)).forEach(
                    (el) => {
                        const owner =
                            el.closest(
                                ".arena,.uniqArena,.cinematicContentShell,.playFocus"
                            ) || host
                        if (!photoGroups.has(owner)) photoGroups.set(owner, [])
                        photoGroups.get(owner).push(el)
                    }
                )
                photoGroups.forEach((nodes) => {
                    nodes.forEach((el, idx) => {
                        el.style.setProperty(
                            "--ts-ref-photo",
                            photoVars[idx % photoVars.length]
                        )
                    })
                })
                const arenas = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".uniqArena"))
                arenas.forEach((arena) => {
                    const status = arena.querySelector(".uniqStatus")
                    if (!status) return
                    Array.from(
                        arena.querySelectorAll("[data-ts-auto-lift='1']")
                    ).forEach((el) => {
                        el.style.removeProperty("translate")
                        delete el.dataset.tsAutoLift
                    })
                    const arenaRect = arena.getBoundingClientRect()
                    const statusRect = status.getBoundingClientRect()
                    const safeTop = statusRect.top - 12
                    Array.from(arena.children).forEach((node) => {
                        const el = node
                        if (
                            el === status ||
                            el.classList.contains("uniqGlow") ||
                            el.classList.contains("literalProgress")
                        )
                            return
                        const cs = getComputedStyle(el)
                        if (
                            cs.display === "none" ||
                            cs.visibility === "hidden" ||
                            cs.pointerEvents === "none"
                        )
                            return
                        const cls = String(el.className || "")
                        const interactive =
                            el.tagName === "BUTTON" ||
                            !!el.querySelector(
                                "button,[role='button'],input,textarea,select"
                            ) ||
                            /(tray|keys|choice|control|action|button|btn|knob|dial|handle|picker|pads|console|toolbar)/i.test(
                                cls
                            )
                        if (!interactive) return
                        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                        if (rect.width < 2 || rect.height < 2) return
                        if (
                            rect.width > arenaRect.width * 0.9 &&
                            rect.height > arenaRect.height * 0.7
                        )
                            return
                        const xOverlap =
                            Math.min(rect.right, statusRect.right) -
                            Math.max(rect.left, statusRect.left)
                        const yOverlap =
                            Math.min(rect.bottom, statusRect.bottom) -
                            Math.max(rect.top, statusRect.top)
                        if (xOverlap <= 8 || yOverlap <= 2) return
                        const needed = Math.max(0, rect.bottom - safeTop + 6)
                        const roomAbove = Math.max(
                            0,
                            rect.top - arenaRect.top - 10
                        )
                        const lift = Math.min(needed, roomAbove, 170)
                        if (lift <= 1) return
                        el.style.setProperty("translate", `0 -${lift}px`)
                        el.dataset.tsAutoLift = "1"
                    })
                })
            })
        }
        audit()
        const RO = window.ResizeObserver
        const ro = RO ? new RO(audit) : null
        if (ro) {
            ro.observe(host)
            Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".uniqArena")).forEach((arena) =>
                ro.observe(arena)
            )
        }
        const retryTimers = [40, 120, 280, 600, 1100].map((ms) =>
            window.setTimeout(audit, ms)
        )
        try {
            const fontsReady = document.fonts?.ready
            if (fontsReady?.then) fontsReady.then(audit).catch(() => {})
        } catch {}
        const MO = window.MutationObserver
        const mo = MO ? new MO(audit) : null
        if (mo)
            mo.observe(host, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true,
                characterData: true,
            })
        window.addEventListener("resize", audit)
        window.addEventListener("orientationchange", audit)
        return () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
            retryTimers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id))
            if (ro) ro.disconnect()
            if (mo) mo.disconnect()
            window.removeEventListener("resize", audit)
            window.removeEventListener("orientationchange", audit)
        }
    }, [p.game.id, p.entries.join("|"), progress, stepFx, finishFx])
    const rewardWords = [
        "RELEASED",
        "NAILED IT",
        "YESSS",
        "CLEAN HIT",
        "SHIFTED",
        "GONE",
        "LOCKED IN",
        "CHAIN +1",
        "FLOW",
        "THERE IT IS",
        "STILL +1",
        "NICE ONE",
        "THAT MOVED",
        "SMOOTH",
        "BOOM — LIGHTER",
    ]
    const releaseChain = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.ceil(progress / 17)))
    const guideParts = splitGlobalGuideText(guideText)
    return (
        <div
            className={`engineProgressWrap cinematicEngineShell engine-${p.game.engine.toLowerCase()} family-${p.game.family.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}`}
        >
            <div className="engineProgressHud">
                <div
                    className="engineProgressTrack"
                    role="progressbar"
                    aria-label="Game progress"
                    aria-valuemin={0}
                    aria-valuemax={100}
                    aria-valuenow={progress}
                >
                    <i style={{ width: progress + "%" }} />
                    <span className="engineProgressText">
                        {eosMeterWord(p.game)} · {progress}%
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div
                className="cinematicContentShell"
                ref={collisionHostRef}
                onPointerMoveCapture={updateRewardCursorWhileDragging}

                        style={{

                        }}

                    </div>
                ) : null}

}
function RoutedGameContent(p) {
    {
        const EosE = EosEngineFor(p.game)
        if (EosE) return <EosE {...p} />
    }
    if (!UNIQUE_HERO_IDS.has(p.game.id)) return <UniqueReleaseEngine {...p} />
    switch (p.game.id) {
        case 109:
            return <CleanseEngine {...p} />
    }
    switch (p.game.engine) {
        case "E01":
            return <BurstEngine {...p} />
        case "E02":
            return <ImpactEngine {...p} />
        case "E03":
            return <ThrowEngine {...p} />
        case "E04":
            return <DissolveEngine {...p} />
        case "E05":
            return <DetachEngine {...p} />
        case "E06":
            return <RhythmEngine {...p} />
        case "E07":
            return <SortEngine {...p} />
        case "E08":
            return <BalanceEngine {...p} />
        case "E09":
            return <LensEngine {...p} />
        case "E10":
            return <TransformEngine {...p} />
        case "E11":
            return <CatchEngine {...p} />
        case "E12":
            return <ChoiceEngine {...p} />
        case "E13":
            return <ChargeEngine {...p} />
        case "E14":
            return <EraseEngine {...p} />
        case "E15":
            return <SequenceEngine {...p} />
        default:
            return <UniversalToolModeEngine {...p} />
    }
}
const TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT = 110
const tsRewardRotationByRelease = new Map()
function tsRewardRng(seed) {
    let t = seed >>> 0 || 0x6d2b79f5
    return () => {
        t += 0x6d2b79f5
        let x = t
        x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), x | 1)
        x ^= x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), x | 61)
        return ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
    }
}
function buildTsRewardDeck(releaseId, cycle, previousLast) {
    const deck = Array.from({ length: TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT }, (_, i) => i)
    const id = Number(releaseId) || 0
    const rand = tsRewardRng(
        Math.imul(id + 17, 0x45d9f3b) ^ Math.imul(cycle + 101, 0x27d4eb2d)
    )
    for (let i = deck.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(rand() * (i + 1))
        const t = deck[i]
        deck[i] = deck[j]
        deck[j] = t
    }
    if (previousLast != null && deck[0] === previousLast && deck.length > 1) {
        const swapIndex = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * (deck.length - 1))
        const t = deck[0]
        deck[0] = deck[swapIndex]
        deck[swapIndex] = t
    }
    return deck
}
function tsRewardStorageKey(releaseId) {
    return `thinkstill:reward-rotation:v1:${Number(releaseId) || 0}`
}
function isValidTsRewardDeck(deck) {
    return (
        Array.isArray(deck) &&
        deck.length === TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT &&
        new Set(deck).size === TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT &&
        deck.every(
            (v) => Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v < TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT
        )
    )
}
function loadTsRewardRotation(releaseId) {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) return null
    try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(
            window.localStorage.getItem(tsRewardStorageKey(releaseId)) || "null"
        )
        if (!saved || !isValidTsRewardDeck(saved.deck)) return null
        const position = Math.max(
            0,
            Math.min(TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT, Number(saved.position) || 0)
        )
        const cycle = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(saved.cycle) || 0))
        const last =
            Number.isInteger(saved.last) &&
            saved.last >= 0 &&
            saved.last < TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT
                ? saved.last
                : null
        return { cycle, position, last, deck: saved.deck.slice() }
    } catch {
        return null
    }
}
function saveTsRewardRotation(releaseId, state) {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) return
    try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(
            tsRewardStorageKey(releaseId),
            JSON.stringify({
                cycle: state.cycle,
                position: state.position,
                last: state.last,
                deck: state.deck,
            })
        )
    } catch {}
}
function getTsRewardRotation(releaseId) {
    const key = Number(releaseId) || 0
    let state = tsRewardRotationByRelease.get(key)
    if (!state) {
        state = loadTsRewardRotation(key) || {
            cycle: 0,
            position: 0,
            last: null,
            deck: buildTsRewardDeck(key, 0, null),
        }
        tsRewardRotationByRelease.set(key, state)
    }
    return state
}
function nextTsRewardVariant(releaseId) {
    const state = getTsRewardRotation(releaseId)
    if (state.position >= TS_REWARD_BURST_COUNT) {
        state.cycle += 1
        state.position = 0
        state.deck = buildTsRewardDeck(releaseId, state.cycle, state.last)
    }
    const variant = state.deck[state.position++]
    state.last = variant
    saveTsRewardRotation(releaseId, state)
    return variant
}
function tsRewardPoint(i, n, variant, seed, power = 1) {
    const form = variant % 11,
        motion = Math.floor(variant / 11)
    const tau = Math.PI * 2,
        q = (i + 0.5) / Math.max(1, n)
    const jitter = noveltyNoise(i + 401, seed + variant * 17 + 409) - 0.5
    let x = 0,
        y = 0,
        a = q * tau
    const r = (68 + noveltyNoise(i + 419, seed + 421) * 42) * power
    if (form === 0) {
        a = q * tau + motion * 0.19 + jitter * 0.22
        x = Math.cos(a) * r
        y = Math.sin(a) * r
    } else if (form === 1) {
        a = q * tau * (1.8 + (motion % 4) * 0.32) + motion * 0.31
        const rr = r * (0.38 + q * 0.72)
        x = Math.cos(a) * rr
        y = Math.sin(a) * rr
    } else if (form === 2) {
        const t = q * tau
        x = ((16 * Math.pow(Math.sin(t), 3)) / 17) * r
        y =
            (-(
                13 * Math.cos(t) -
                5 * Math.cos(2 * t) -
                2 * Math.cos(3 * t) -
                Math.cos(4 * t)
            ) /
                17) *
            r
    } else if (form === 3) {
        a = q * tau + Math.PI / 4
        const d = Math.max(0.55, Math.abs(Math.cos(a)) + Math.abs(Math.sin(a)))
        x = (Math.cos(a) / d) * r
        y = (Math.sin(a) / d) * r
    } else if (form === 4) {
        const spoke = Math.round(q * 7) % 8
        a = (spoke * tau) / 8 + jitter * 0.13
        x = Math.cos(a) * r
        y = Math.sin(a) * r
    } else if (form === 5) {
        const k = i % 10
        a = (k * tau) / 10 - Math.PI / 2
        const rr = r * (k % 2 ? 0.48 : 1)
        x = Math.cos(a) * rr
        y = Math.sin(a) * rr
    } else if (form === 6) {
        a = q * tau + motion * 0.23
        x = Math.cos(a) * r
        y = Math.sin(a) * r * 0.58
    } else if (form === 7) {
        const side = i % 2 ? 1 : -1
        a = (side > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI) + jitter * 1.05
        x = Math.cos(a) * r
        y = Math.sin(a) * r * 0.72
    } else if (form === 8) {
        a = -Math.PI / 2 + (q - 0.5) * 1.58 + jitter * 0.24
        x = Math.cos(a) * r * 0.9
        y = Math.sin(a) * r * 1.08
    } else if (form === 9) {
        const t = q * tau
        x = Math.sin(t) * r
        y = Math.sin(t) * Math.cos(t) * r * 0.74
    } else {
        x = (noveltyNoise(i + 431, seed + variant * 23 + 433) - 0.5) * r * 1.9
        y = (noveltyNoise(i + 439, seed + variant * 29 + 443) - 0.5) * r * 1.65
    }
    const rot = ((motion * 17 + (motion % 2 ? -6 : 7)) * Math.PI) / 180
    const stretchX = [1, 1.12, 0.82, 1.24, 0.9, 1.08, 0.76, 1.18, 0.94, 1.04][
        motion
    ]
    const stretchY = [1, 0.84, 1.18, 0.76, 1.1, 0.92, 1.22, 0.8, 1.14, 0.96][
        motion
    ]
    const xr = x * Math.cos(rot) - y * Math.sin(rot)
    const yr = x * Math.sin(rot) + y * Math.cos(rot)
    return { x: xr * stretchX, y: yr * stretchY }
}
function RewardSurgeBurst({ seed, mega, reduced, variant = 0 }) {

    const mode = burstVariant % 6
    const hue =

    const bubbleCount = reduced ? 7 : mega ? 52 : 34

    return (

        >

                    const pt = tsRewardPoint(

                    )
                    const x = pt.x,

                    const size =
                        (mega ? 20 : 18) +
                        noveltyNoise(i + 233, seed + 239) * (mega ? 24 : 17)
                    const wave = i % (mega ? 5 : 4)
                    const delay =
                        0.035 +
                        wave * 0.027 +
                        noveltyNoise(i + 241, seed + 251) * 0.026
                    const dur =
                        (mega ? 1.16 : 0.96) +
                        noveltyNoise(i + 257, seed + 263) * (mega ? 0.24 : 0.18)
                    const rotate = -65 + noveltyNoise(i + 269, seed + 271) * 130
                    const bubble = ALL_BUBBLES[(i + seed) % ALL_BUBBLES.length]

                        rewardMoods[(i * 3 + seed) % rewardMoods.length]
                    return (

                                alt=""
                                draggable={false}
                            />
                        </span>
                    )
                })}
            </div>
            <div className="surgeTunnel">
                {Array.from({ length: tunnelCount }, (_, i) => (
                    <i
                        key={`t-${seed}-${i}`}
                        style={{
                            ["--n"]: i,
                            ["--dl"]: `${0.045 + i * (mega ? 0.06 : 0.055)}s`,
                            ["--hh"]: `${Math.round(noveltyNoise(i + 5, seed + 29) * 130)}deg`,
                        }}
                    />
                ))}
            </div>
            <div className="surgeRays">
                {Array.from({ length: rayCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const angle = Math.round(
                        noveltyNoise(i + 31, seed + 37) * 360
                    )
                    const distance =
                        38 + noveltyNoise(i + 41, seed + 43) * (mega ? 88 : 68)
                    const length =
                        20 + noveltyNoise(i + 47, seed + 53) * (mega ? 106 : 78)
                    const thick =
                        1 + noveltyNoise(i + 59, seed + 61) * (mega ? 3.0 : 2.4)
                    const delay = 0.055 + noveltyNoise(i + 67, seed + 71) * 0.1
                    return (
                        <i
                            key={`r-${seed}-${i}`}
                            style={{
                                ["--r"]: `${angle}deg`,
                                ["--d"]: `${distance}vmax`,

                })}
            </div>
            <div className="surgeSparks">
                {Array.from({ length: sparkCount }, (_, i) => {
                    const x =

                    const y =
                        (noveltyNoise(i + 97, seed + 101) - 0.5) *
                        (mega ? 124 : 104)
                    const size =

                })}
            </div>
            <div className="tsSignatureGlyphField">
                {Array.from(
                    { length: reduced ? 8 : mega ? 24 : 16 },

        Math.abs(
            (Date.now() +
                (Number(p.game?.id) || 0) * 997 +
                (Number(p.variationSeed) || 0) * 37) %
                2147483647
        )
    )
    const [reactionEpoch, setReactionEpoch] = React.useState(0)
    const lastBubbleIndexRef = React.useRef(null)
    const [label, setLabel] = React.useState(progressLabel(p.game, 0))

        globalReleaseGuideText(p.game, 0, "", p.entries)
    )

    const [stepBurstVariant, setStepBurstVariant] = React.useState(0)
    const [finishBurstVariant, setFinishBurstVariant] = React.useState(0)
    const [rewardCharacter, setRewardCharacter] = React.useState(null)
    const [shiftXp, setShiftXp] = React.useState(() =>
        lsNum(RELEASE_SHIFT_XP_KEY, 0)
    )
    const [shiftTokens, setShiftTokens] = React.useState(() =>
        lsNum(RELEASE_SHIFT_TOKEN_KEY, 0)
    )
    const [rewardChain, setRewardChain] = React.useState(0)
    const [lastSparkGain, setLastSparkGain] = React.useState(0)
    const [lastFinishGain, setLastFinishGain] = React.useState(0)
    const rewardChainRef = React.useRef(0)
    const [stepRewardAnchor, setStepRewardAnchor] = React.useState({
        x: 74,

            typeof e?.clientX === "number"
                ? e.clientX
                : rect.left + rect.width * 0.74
        const cy =
            typeof e?.clientY === "number"
                ? e.clientY
                : rect.top + rect.height * 0.14
        rewardCursorRef.current = {
            x: clamp(
                ((cx - rect.left) / Math.max(1, rect.width)) * 100,
                0,
                100
            ),
            y: clamp(
                ((cy - rect.top) / Math.max(1, rect.height)) * 100,
                0,
                100
            ),
        }
    }, [])

            lastBubbleIndexRef.current = Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null

    const fitFeedbackInsideGameWindow = React.useCallback(
        (node, anchor, kind = "step") => {
            const host = collisionHostRef.current
            if (!node || !host) return
            const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect()
            if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-x", "0px")
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-y", "0px")
            const width = Math.min(node.offsetWidth || 0, rect.width)
            const height = Math.min(node.offsetHeight || 0, rect.height)
            if (!width || !height) return
            const cursorX = (clamp(anchor.x, 0, 100) / 100) * rect.width
            const cursorY = (clamp(anchor.y, 0, 100) / 100) * rect.height
            const rawLeft = cursorX - width / 2
            const rawTop = cursorY - height / 2
            const sidePad = kind === "finish" ? 42 : 34
            const topPad = kind === "finish" ? 58 : 50
            const bottomPad = kind === "finish" ? 28 : 22
            const minLeft = sidePad
            const maxLeft = Math.max(minLeft, rect.width - sidePad - width)
            const minTop = topPad
            const maxTop = Math.max(minTop, rect.height - bottomPad - height)
            const safeLeft = clamp(rawLeft, minLeft, maxLeft)
            const safeTop = clamp(rawTop, minTop, maxTop)
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-x", `${safeLeft - rawLeft}px`)
            node.style.setProperty("--fb-shift-y", `${safeTop - rawTop}px`)
        },
        []
    )

    const showPositiveReactionForFeedback = (

        forceAll = false
    ) => {
        if (Number(p.game?.id) === 108) {
            feedbackPositiveIndexRef.current = null
            return

        const total = MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
        const parsed = Number(targetIndex)
        if (forceAll) {
            feedbackPositiveIndexRef.current = "all"
            setPositiveSlots(Array(total).fill(true))
            setReactionEpoch((x) => x + 1)
            return
        }
        const resolvedIndex =
            Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed >= 0 ? parsed % total : 0
        feedbackPositiveIndexRef.current = resolvedIndex
        setPositiveSlots(
            Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i === resolvedIndex)
        )
        setReactionEpoch((x) => x + 1)
    }
    const hidePositiveReactionWithFeedback = () => {
        feedbackPositiveIndexRef.current = null
        if (Number(p.game?.id) === 108) return
        setPositiveSlots(Array(MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES).fill(false))
        setReactionEpoch((x) => x + 1)
    }
    const triggerStepReward = (targetIndex = null) => {
        const now = Date.now()
        if (now - lastRewardAt.current < 220) return
        lastRewardAt.current = now
        const nextChain = rewardChainRef.current + 1
        rewardChainRef.current = nextChain
        setRewardChain(nextChain)
        const sparkGain = 8 + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, nextChain - 1) * 2)
        setLastSparkGain(sparkGain)
        setShiftXp((prev) => {
            const next = prev + sparkGain
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(RELEASE_SHIFT_XP_KEY, String(next))
            } catch {}
            return next
        })
        showPositiveReactionForFeedback(targetIndex)
        const anchor = { ...rewardCursorRef.current }
        setStepRewardAnchor(anchor)
        setStepBurstVariant(nextTsRewardVariant(p.game.id))

            setStepRewardVisible(false)
            hidePositiveReactionWithFeedback()
            stepRewardTimer.current = null
        }, stepRewardDurationMs)
        vibrate(12)

    const reportProgress = (value, nextLabel, eosFromSfx) => {
        const v = eosGateProgress(progressRef, value, eosFromSfx),
            previous = progressRef.current
        progressRef.current = v
        const resolvedLabel = nextLabel || progressLabel(p.game, v)
        setProgress(v)
        if (v > previous) {
            const directRewardIndex = lastBubbleIndexRef.current
            const rewardImageBank = p.hasUserImages
                ? []
                : uploadedPositiveImages
            const totalVisible = Math.max(
                1,
                Math.min(
                    MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES,
                    rewardImageBank.length || MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES
                )
            )
            const fallbackIndex =
                (rewardChainRef.current +
                    Math.floor(v / Math.max(1, rewardSize))) %
                totalVisible
            const resolvedArcIndex =
                Number.isFinite(directRewardIndex) && directRewardIndex >= 0
                    ? directRewardIndex % totalVisible
                    : fallbackIndex
            const rewardSource =
                rewardImageBank[
                    resolvedArcIndex % Math.max(1, rewardImageBank.length)
                ] || rewardImageBank.find(Boolean)
            const rewardState = bubbleCharacterFromEmotionSrc(rewardSource)
            if (rewardState?.profile)
                setRewardCharacter({
                    name: rewardState.profile.name,
                })
        }
        setLabel(resolvedLabel)
        setGuideText(
            globalReleaseGuideText(p.game, v, resolvedLabel, p.entries)
        )
        if (v > previous && v < 99) {
            const bucket = Math.floor(v / rewardSize)
            if (bucket > rewardBucketRef.current) {
                rewardBucketRef.current = bucket
                triggerStepReward(lastBubbleIndexRef.current)
            }
        }
    }
