                    ".echoBubbleWord",
                    ".plainUserThoughtText",
                    ".tsGlobalThoughtText",
                    ".tsExactUserText",
                    ".tsStandardThoughtText",
                ].join(",")
                const externalHosts = [
                    ...new Set(
                        externalHostSelectors.flatMap((sel) =>
                            Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(sel))
                        )
                    ),
                ]
                externalHosts.forEach((unit, externalIndex) => {
                    if (unit.closest(".u107")) return
                    if (unit.classList.contains("tsStandardBubble")) return
                    if (unit.classList.contains("thoughtPotato")) {
                        unit.classList.remove(
                            "tsThoughtLabelHost",
                            "tsEmotionNegative",
                            "tsEmotionPositive"
                        )
                        Array.from(
                            unit.querySelectorAll(
                                ":scope > .tsAutoEmotionPic, :scope > .tsExternalThoughtLabel, :scope > .tsDynamicActionCue, :scope > .tsBubbleTextContainer, :scope > .tsCharacterBond"
                            )
                        ).forEach((el) => el.remove())
                        Array.from(
                            unit.querySelectorAll(".tsBubbleTextSourceHidden")
                        ).forEach((el) => {
                            el.classList.remove("tsBubbleTextSourceHidden")
                        })
                        return
                    }
                    const mappedIndex =
                        externalIndex % Math.max(1, MAX_VISIBLE_WORD_BUBBLES)
                    unit.dataset.tsBubbleIndex = String(mappedIndex)
                    const desiredExternalSrc =
                        liveImages[
                            mappedIndex % Math.max(1, liveImages.length)
                        ] || ""
                    const emotionPic = unit.querySelector(
                        "img[src*='bubble-expressions/']"
                    )
                    const visualPic =
                        emotionPic ||
                        unit.querySelector(
                            ".rainCloudImage,.uniqWordMaterialImage,img:not(.tsNoStandardPic)"
                        )
                    if (desiredExternalSrc && visualPic) {
                        const desiredAbsolute = (() => {
                            try {
                                return new URL(
                                    desiredExternalSrc,
                                    window.location.href
                                ).href
                            } catch {
                                return desiredExternalSrc
                            }
                        })()
                        if (visualPic.src !== desiredAbsolute)
                            visualPic.src = desiredExternalSrc
                    }
                    const externalSrc =
                        desiredExternalSrc ||
                        visualPic?.src ||
                        emotionPic?.src ||
                        ""
                    updateCharacterBond(unit, externalSrc)
                    if (unit.classList.contains("weirdWordBubble")) {
                        unit.classList.remove("tsThoughtLabelHost")
                        Array.from(
                            unit.querySelectorAll(
                                ":scope > .tsExternalThoughtLabel, :scope > .tsDynamicActionCue"
                            )
                        ).forEach((el) => el.remove())
                        Array.from(
                            unit.querySelectorAll(".tsBubbleTextSourceHidden")
                        ).forEach((el) => {
                            el.classList.remove("tsBubbleTextSourceHidden")
                        })
                        return
                    }
                    if (
                        unit.classList.contains("rainCloudUnit") &&
                        unit.querySelector("[data-thought-cloud='1']")
                    ) {
                        Array.from(
                            unit.querySelectorAll(
                                ":scope > .tsExternalThoughtLabel"
                            )
                        ).forEach((el) => el.remove())
                        return
                    }
                    const explicit = Array.from(
                        unit.querySelectorAll(explicitThoughtSelectors)
                    ).filter(
                        (n) => !n.classList.contains("tsExternalThoughtLabel")
                    )
                    const leaves = Array.from(
                        unit.querySelectorAll("span,b,strong,em,div")
                    ).filter(
                        (n) =>
                            !n.children.length &&
                            !n.classList.contains("tsExternalThoughtLabel") &&
                            !n.closest(".tsCharacterBond")
                    )
                    const allCandidates = [...new Set([...explicit, ...leaves])]
                    const scored = allCandidates
                        .map((n) => {
                            const rawValue = normalise(n.textContent || "")
                            const v = rawValue.replace(/[.…]+$/, "")
                            let s = -1
                            if (!v || v.length > 160 || bad.test(v)) s = -1
                            else if (entryList.includes(v)) s = 7
                            else if (
                                entryList.some(
                                    (e) => e.startsWith(v) && v.length >= 4
                                )
                            )
                                s = 6
                            else if (
                                entryList.some(
                                    (e) => v.startsWith(e) && e.length >= 4
                                )
                            )
                                s = 5
                            else if (explicit.includes(n)) s = 4
                            return { n, s, rawValue }
                        })
                        .sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s)
                    const best = scored[0]
                    let label = unit.querySelector(
                        ":scope > .tsExternalThoughtLabel"
                    )
                    if (best && best.s >= 4 && best.rawValue) {
                        unit.classList.add("tsThoughtLabelHost")
                        best.n.classList.add("tsBubbleTextSourceHidden")
                        if (!label) {
                            label = document.createElement("div")
                            label.className = "tsExternalThoughtLabel"
                            label.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true")
                            unit.appendChild(label)
                        }
                        if (label.textContent !== best.rawValue)
                            label.textContent = best.rawValue
                    } else if (label) {
                        label.remove()
                    }
                })
                const actionCueHosts = [
                    ...new Set(
                        Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".tsThoughtLabelHost"))
                    ),
                ]
                actionCueHosts.forEach((unit, actionIndex) => {
                    let cue = unit.querySelector(":scope > .tsDynamicActionCue")
                    if (unit.classList.contains("rainCloudUnit")) {
                        if (cue) cue.remove()
                        return
                    }
                    const cueData = dynamicReleaseActionCue(
                        p.game,
                        p.entries,
                        actionIndex + (p.variationSeed || 0)
                    )
                    if (!cue) {
                        cue = document.createElement("div")
                        cue.className = "tsDynamicActionCue"
                        cue.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true")
                        const arrow = document.createElement("span")
                        arrow.className = "tsDynamicActionArrow"
                        const copy = document.createElement("span")
                        copy.className = "tsDynamicActionText"
                        cue.append(arrow, copy)
                        unit.appendChild(cue)
                    }
                    const arrow = cue.querySelector(".tsDynamicActionArrow")
                    const copy = cue.querySelector(".tsDynamicActionText")
                    if (arrow) {
                        if (arrow.textContent !== cueData.arrow)
                            arrow.textContent = cueData.arrow
                        arrow.style.display = cueData.arrow ? "" : "none"
                        arrow.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true")
                    }
                    if (copy && copy.textContent !== cueData.label)
                        copy.textContent = cueData.label
                })
                const arenas = Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".uniqArena"))
                arenas.forEach((arena) => {
                    const status = arena.querySelector(".uniqStatus")
                    if (!status) return
                    Array.from(
                        arena.querySelectorAll("[data-ts-auto-lift='1']")
                    ).forEach((el) => {
                        el.style.removeProperty("translate")
                        el.style.removeProperty("--ts-auto-lift-y")
                        delete el.dataset.tsAutoLift
                    })
                    const arenaRect = arena.getBoundingClientRect()
                    const statusRect = status.getBoundingClientRect()
                    const safeTop = statusRect.top - 12
                    Array.from(arena.children).forEach((node) => {
                        const el = node
                        if (
                            el === status ||
                            el.classList.contains("uniqGlow") ||
                            el.classList.contains("literalProgress")
                        )
                            return
                        const cs = getComputedStyle(el)
                        if (
                            cs.display === "none" ||
                            cs.visibility === "hidden" ||
                            cs.pointerEvents === "none"
                        )
                            return
                        const cls = String(el.className || "")
                        const interactive =
                            el.tagName === "BUTTON" ||
                            !!el.querySelector(
                                "button,[role='button'],input,textarea,select"
                            ) ||
                            /(tray|keys|choice|control|action|button|btn|knob|dial|handle|picker|pads|console|toolbar)/i.test(
                                cls
                            )
                        if (!interactive) return
                        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                        if (rect.width < 2 || rect.height < 2) return
                        if (
                            rect.width > arenaRect.width * 0.9 &&
                            rect.height > arenaRect.height * 0.7
                        )
                            return
                        const xOverlap =
                            Math.min(rect.right, statusRect.right) -
                            Math.max(rect.left, statusRect.left)
                        const yOverlap =
                            Math.min(rect.bottom, statusRect.bottom) -
                            Math.max(rect.top, statusRect.top)
                        if (xOverlap <= 8 || yOverlap <= 2) return
                        const needed = Math.max(0, rect.bottom - safeTop + 6)
                        const roomAbove = Math.max(
                            0,
                            rect.top - arenaRect.top - 10
                        )
                        const lift = Math.min(needed, roomAbove, 170)
                        if (lift <= 1) return
                        if (el.classList.contains("tsThoughtLabelHost")) {
                            el.style.setProperty(
                                "--ts-auto-lift-y",
                                `-${lift}px`
                            )
                        } else {
                            el.style.setProperty("translate", `0 -${lift}px`)
                        }
                        el.dataset.tsAutoLift = "1"
                    })
                })
            })
            const collisionBoundary = host.getBoundingClientRect()
            const legacyGlobalPolish =
                Number(p.game?.id || 0) > 0 && Number(p.game?.id || 0) < 100
            const collisionGap = legacyGlobalPolish
                ? Math.max(26, Math.min(38, collisionBoundary.width * 0.024))
                : Math.max(18, Math.min(26, collisionBoundary.width * 0.016))
            const obstacleGap = legacyGlobalPolish
                ? Math.max(22, Math.min(34, collisionBoundary.width * 0.021))
                : Math.max(16, Math.min(24, collisionBoundary.width * 0.015))
            const edgePad = legacyGlobalPolish ? 16 : 12
            const maxShift = legacyGlobalPolish
                ? Math.max(110, Math.min(220, collisionBoundary.width * 0.145))
                : Math.max(90, Math.min(190, collisionBoundary.width * 0.11))
            const collisionHosts = [
                ...new Set(
                    Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".tsThoughtLabelHost"))
                ),
            ].filter((el) => {
                const cs = getComputedStyle(el)
                if (cs.display === "none" || cs.visibility === "hidden")
                    return false
                const r = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                return (
                    r.width > 8 &&
                    r.height > 8 &&
                    r.width < collisionBoundary.width * 0.55 &&
                    r.height < collisionBoundary.height * 0.55
                )
            })
            const shiftState = new Map(
                collisionHosts.map((el) => [el, { x: 0, y: 0 }])
            )
            const unionRect = (el) => {
                const parts = [el]
                const label = el.querySelector(
                    ":scope > .tsBubbleTextContainer,:scope > .tsExternalThoughtLabel,:scope > [data-thought-cloud='1'],:scope > .tsCharacterBond"
                )
                if (label) parts.push(label)
                const helper = el.querySelector(
                    ":scope > .rainPullHint,:scope > .coinReleaseHint,:scope > .tsDynamicActionCue,:scope > .cleanseBubbleHoldButton"
                )
                if (helper) parts.push(helper)
                const rects = parts
                    .map((node) => node.getBoundingClientRect())
                    .filter((r) => r.width > 0 && r.height > 0)
                if (!rects.length) return el.getBoundingClientRect()
                const left = Math.min(...rects.map((r) => r.left))
                const top = Math.min(...rects.map((r) => r.top))
                const right = Math.max(...rects.map((r) => r.right))
                const bottom = Math.max(...rects.map((r) => r.bottom))
                return {
                    left,
                    top,
                    right,
                    bottom,
                    width: right - left,
                    height: bottom - top,
                }
            }
            const clampShift = (el, nextX, nextY) => {
                const current = shiftState.get(el) || { x: 0, y: 0 }
                const rect = unionRect(el)
                let dx = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, nextX))
                let dy = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, nextY))
                let deltaX = dx - current.x
                let deltaY = dy - current.y
                if (rect.left + deltaX < collisionBoundary.left + edgePad) {
                    dx +=
                        collisionBoundary.left + edgePad - (rect.left + deltaX)
                }
                deltaX = dx - current.x
                if (rect.right + deltaX > collisionBoundary.right - edgePad) {
                    dx -=
                        rect.right +
                        deltaX -
                        (collisionBoundary.right - edgePad)
                }
                if (rect.top + deltaY < collisionBoundary.top + edgePad) {
                    dy += collisionBoundary.top + edgePad - (rect.top + deltaY)
                }
                deltaY = dy - current.y
                if (rect.bottom + deltaY > collisionBoundary.bottom - edgePad) {
                    dy -=
                        rect.bottom +
                        deltaY -
                        (collisionBoundary.bottom - edgePad)
                }
                dx = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, dx))
                dy = Math.max(-maxShift, Math.min(maxShift, dy))
                shiftState.set(el, { x: dx, y: dy })
                el.style.setProperty(
                    "--ts-collision-x",
                    `${Math.round(dx * 10) / 10}px`
                )
                el.style.setProperty(
                    "--ts-collision-y",
                    `${Math.round(dy * 10) / 10}px`
                )
                el.dataset.tsCollisionSpace = "1"
            }
            const obstacleRoot =
                host.closest(".engineProgressWrap") ||
                host.parentElement ||
                host
            const strongPropPattern =
                /(guide|mindbend|progress|button|btn|machine|vacuum|shred|tool|knob|dial|lever|scanner|xray|burn|nozzle|handle|panel|board|control|action|toolbar|platform|slingshot|eraser|sink|toilet|bin|furnace|torch|laser|magnet|fan|press|slider|switch|trap|scale|meter|conveyor|scratch|hammer|stomp|zap|cleanse|flush|drain|crusher|roller|juggle|trade|echo|launch|paddle|tug|rope|gate|portal|suction)/i
            const decorativePattern =
                /(glow|ambient|sweep|particle|burst|spark|trail|shadow|halo|backdrop|background|field|starfield|smoke|mist|confetti)/i
            const insideBubbleUnit = (el) =>
                collisionHosts.some(
                    (unit) =>
                        unit === el || unit.contains(el) || el.contains(unit)
                )
            const rawObstacles = Array.from(
                obstacleRoot.querySelectorAll("*")
            ).filter((el) => {
                if (insideBubbleUnit(el)) return false
                const cs = getComputedStyle(el)
                if (
                    cs.display === "none" ||
                    cs.visibility === "hidden" ||
                    Number(cs.opacity || 1) < 0.03
                )
                    return false
                const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                if (rect.width < 12 || rect.height < 10) return false
                const cls = String(el.className || "")
                const interactive =
                    el.matches?.(
                        "button,[role='button'],input,textarea,select,[role='slider']"
                    ) ||
                    !!el.querySelector?.(
                        "button,[role='button'],input,textarea,select,[role='slider']"
                    )
                const fixedProtected =
                    el.classList?.contains("globalPlayGuide") ||
                    el.classList?.contains("engineProgressHud") ||
                    el.classList?.contains("literalProgress")
                const strongProp = strongPropPattern.test(cls)
                if (!interactive && !fixedProtected && !strongProp) return false
                if (
                    decorativePattern.test(cls) &&
                    !interactive &&
                    !fixedProtected
                )
                    return false
                if (
                    rect.width > collisionBoundary.width * 0.88 &&
                    rect.height > collisionBoundary.height * 0.72 &&
                    !fixedProtected
                )
                    return false
                return true
            })
            const obstacles = [...new Set(rawObstacles)].filter((el) => {
                const er = el.getBoundingClientRect()
                return !rawObstacles.some((other) => {
                    if (other === el || !other.contains(el)) return false
                    const or = other.getBoundingClientRect()
                    if (or.width <= 0 || or.height <= 0) return false
                    const otherArea = or.width * or.height
                    const boundaryArea =
                        collisionBoundary.width * collisionBoundary.height
                    return (
                        otherArea < boundaryArea * 0.5 &&
                        or.left <= er.left + 1 &&
                        or.top <= er.top + 1 &&
                        or.right >= er.right - 1 &&
                        or.bottom >= er.bottom - 1
                    )
                })
            })
            const rectOverlap = (a, b, gap) => {
                const x =
                    Math.min(a.right + gap / 2, b.right + gap / 2) -
                    Math.max(a.left - gap / 2, b.left - gap / 2)
                const y =
                    Math.min(a.bottom + gap / 2, b.bottom + gap / 2) -
                    Math.max(a.top - gap / 2, b.top - gap / 2)
                return { x, y, hit: x > 0 && y > 0 }
            }
            const moveAwayFromObstacle = (unit, obstacleRect) => {
                const hr = unionRect(unit)
                const hit = rectOverlap(hr, obstacleRect, obstacleGap)
                if (!hit.hit) return false
                const state = shiftState.get(unit) || { x: 0, y: 0 }
                const moves = [
                    { dx: obstacleRect.left - obstacleGap - hr.right, dy: 0 },
                    { dx: obstacleRect.right + obstacleGap - hr.left, dy: 0 },
                    { dx: 0, dy: obstacleRect.top - obstacleGap - hr.bottom },
                    { dx: 0, dy: obstacleRect.bottom + obstacleGap - hr.top },
                ]
                const scoreMove = (m) => {
                    const nx = state.x + m.dx
                    const ny = state.y + m.dy
                    const predicted = {
                        left: hr.left + m.dx,
                        right: hr.right + m.dx,
                        top: hr.top + m.dy,
                        bottom: hr.bottom + m.dy,
                    }
                    let penalty = Math.abs(m.dx) + Math.abs(m.dy)
                    if (Math.abs(nx) > maxShift || Math.abs(ny) > maxShift)
                        penalty += 100000
                    if (predicted.left < collisionBoundary.left + edgePad)
                        penalty +=
                            (collisionBoundary.left +
                                edgePad -
                                predicted.left) *
                            500
                    if (predicted.right > collisionBoundary.right - edgePad)
                        penalty +=
                            (predicted.right -
                                (collisionBoundary.right - edgePad)) *
                            500
                    if (predicted.top < collisionBoundary.top + edgePad)
                        penalty +=
                            (collisionBoundary.top + edgePad - predicted.top) *
                            500
                    if (predicted.bottom > collisionBoundary.bottom - edgePad)
                        penalty +=
                            (predicted.bottom -
                                (collisionBoundary.bottom - edgePad)) *
                            500
                    return penalty
                }
                moves.sort((a, b) => scoreMove(a) - scoreMove(b))
                const best = moves[0]
                clampShift(unit, state.x + best.dx, state.y + best.dy)
                return true
            }
            for (let pass = 0; pass < 12; pass++) {
                let moved = false
                for (let i = 0; i < collisionHosts.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < collisionHosts.length; j++) {
                        const a = collisionHosts[i]
                        const b = collisionHosts[j]
                        const ar = unionRect(a)
                        const br = unionRect(b)
                        const overlap = rectOverlap(ar, br, collisionGap)
                        if (!overlap.hit) continue
                        const acx = (ar.left + ar.right) / 2
                        const bcx = (br.left + br.right) / 2
                        const acy = (ar.top + ar.bottom) / 2
                        const bcy = (br.top + br.bottom) / 2
                        const sa = shiftState.get(a) || { x: 0, y: 0 }
                        const sb = shiftState.get(b) || { x: 0, y: 0 }
                        if (overlap.y <= overlap.x) {
                            const push = overlap.y / 2 + 1
                            const dir = acy <= bcy ? -1 : 1
                            clampShift(a, sa.x, sa.y + dir * push)
                            clampShift(b, sb.x, sb.y - dir * push)
                        } else {
                            const push = overlap.x / 2 + 1
                            const dir = acx <= bcx ? -1 : 1
                            clampShift(a, sa.x + dir * push, sa.y)
                            clampShift(b, sb.x - dir * push, sb.y)
                        }
                        moved = true
                    }
                }
                for (const unit of collisionHosts) {
                    for (const obstacle of obstacles) {
                        if (!obstacle.isConnected) continue
                        const or = obstacle.getBoundingClientRect()
                        if (or.width < 8 || or.height < 8) continue
                        if (moveAwayFromObstacle(unit, or)) moved = true
                    }
                }
                if (!moved) break
            }
        }
        audit()
        const RO = window.ResizeObserver
        const ro = RO ? new RO(audit) : null
        if (ro) {
            ro.observe(host)
            Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".uniqArena")).forEach((arena) =>
                ro.observe(arena)
            )
        }
        const retryTimers = [40, 120, 280, 600, 1100].map((ms) =>
            window.setTimeout(audit, ms)
        )
        try {
            const fontsReady = document.fonts?.ready
            if (fontsReady?.then) fontsReady.then(audit).catch(() => {})
        } catch {}
        const MO = window.MutationObserver
        const mo = MO ? new MO(audit) : null
        if (mo)
            mo.observe(host, {
                childList: true,
                subtree: true,
                characterData: true,
                attributes: true,
                attributeFilter: ["src"],
            })
        window.addEventListener("resize", audit)
        window.addEventListener("orientationchange", audit)
        return () => {
            cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
            retryTimers.forEach((id) => window.clearTimeout(id))
            if (ro) ro.disconnect()
            if (mo) mo.disconnect()
            window.removeEventListener("resize", audit)
            window.removeEventListener("orientationchange", audit)
        }
    }, [
        p.game.id,
        p.entries.join("|"),
        progress,
        stepFx,
        finishFx,
        p.hasUserImages,
        liveImages.join("|"),
    ])
    const rewardWords = [
        "RELEASED",
        "NAILED IT",
        "YESSS",
        "CLEAN HIT",
        "SHIFTED",
        "GONE",
        "LOCKED IN",
        "CHAIN +1",
        "FLOW",
        "THERE IT IS",
        "STILL +1",
        "NICE ONE",
        "THAT MOVED",
        "SMOOTH",
        "BOOM — LIGHTER",
    ]
    const releaseChain = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, Math.ceil(progress / 17)))
    const rewardCharacterName = rewardCharacter?.name || ""
    const dynamicStepFeedback = dynamicReleaseStepFeedback(
        p.entries,
        stepFx + p.game.id + (p.variationSeed || 0) + reactionEpoch,
        rewardCharacterName,
        p.game,
        emotionSessionSeed
    )
    const dynamicFinishFeedback = dynamicReleaseFinishFeedback(
        p.entries,
        finishFx + p.game.id + (p.variationSeed || 0) + reactionEpoch,
        rewardCharacterName,
        p.game,
        emotionSessionSeed
    )
    const shiftReward = releaseRewardProfile(p.entries)
    const shiftLevel = Math.floor(shiftXp / RELEASE_SHIFT_LEVEL_SIZE) + 1
    const shiftLevelPct = Math.max(
        4,
        Math.min(
            100,
            ((shiftXp % RELEASE_SHIFT_LEVEL_SIZE) / RELEASE_SHIFT_LEVEL_SIZE) *
                100
        )
    )
    const microReward =
        shiftReward.micro[
            Math.abs(stepFx + p.game.id + (p.variationSeed || 0)) %
                shiftReward.micro.length
        ]
    const guideParts = splitGlobalGuideText(guideText)
    const guideGesture = releaseGestureForGame(p.game)
    return (
        <div
            className={`engineProgressWrap cinematicEngineShell engine-${p.game.engine.toLowerCase()} family-${p.game.family.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}`}
        >
            <div className="engineProgressHud">
                <div
                    className="engineProgressTrack"
                    role="progressbar"
                    aria-label="Game progress"
                    aria-valuemin={0}
                    aria-valuemax={100}
                    aria-valuenow={progress}
                >
                    <i style={{ width: progress + "%" }} />
                    <span className="engineProgressText">
                        {shiftReward.meter} · {progress}%
                    </span>
                </div>
                <div
                    className={`tsShiftRewardHud ${stepRewardVisible ? "isHit" : ""}`}
                    aria-label="Release rewards"
                >
                    <span className="tsShiftRewardPill spark">
                        {shiftReward.icon} {shiftXp.toLocaleString()}{" "}
                        {shiftReward.spark}
                    </span>
                    <span className="tsShiftRewardPill token">
                        ◆ {shiftTokens} TOKENS
                    </span>
                    <span className="tsShiftRewardPill chain">
                        CHAIN ×{Math.max(0, rewardChain)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="tsShiftLevel">
                        <i style={{ width: `${shiftLevelPct}%` }} />
                        <b>LVL {shiftLevel}</b>
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div
                className="cinematicContentShell"
                ref={collisionHostRef}
                onPointerMoveCapture={updateRewardCursorWhileDragging}
                onPointerDownCapture={rememberBubbleTarget}
                onPointerUpCapture={updateRewardCursor}
            >
                <CinematicStageFX
                    game={p.game}
                    progress={progress}
                    reduced={p.reduced}
                />
                <CharacterEmotionFX
                    game={p.game}
                    progress={progress}
                    reduced={p.reduced}
                />
                <div
                    className={`globalPlayGuide hypnoticGuide ${progress > 0 ? "isActive" : ""} ${progress >= 100 ? "isComplete" : ""} ${stepRewardVisible && progress < 100 ? "guideHit" : ""}`}
                    aria-live="polite"
                >
                    <div className="guideAmbient" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <div className="guideSweep" aria-hidden="true" />
                    <div className="guideHeaderRow">
                        <b>{p.game.name} · LIVE GUIDE</b>
                        <i className="guidePulseDot" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </div>
                    <div
                        key={`guide-${p.game.id}-${guideText}`}
                        className="guideStepCard"
                    >
                        {true ? (
                            <i className="guideActionArrow" aria-hidden="true">
                                {eosGlyph(p.game) || guideGesture.arrow || "↑"}
                            </i>
                        ) : null}
                        <small>{guideParts.label}</small>
                        <span>{guideParts.copy}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="globalMindBend">
                        <strong>MIND BEND</strong>
                        <em>{globalReleaseMindBendText(p.game)}</em>
                    </div>
                </div>
                {content}
                {stepRewardVisible && stepFx > 0 && finishFx === 0 ? (
                    <RewardSurgeBurst
                        key={`reward-surge-step-${stepFx}-${stepBurstVariant}`}
                        seed={
                            p.game.id * 97 +
                            stepFx * 31 +
                            (p.variationSeed || 0)
                        }
                        variant={stepBurstVariant}
                        reduced={p.reduced}
                    />
                ) : null}
                {finishRewardVisible && finishFx > 0 ? (
                    <RewardSurgeBurst
                        key={`reward-surge-finish-${finishFx}-${finishBurstVariant}`}
                        seed={
                            p.game.id * 193 +
                            finishFx * 61 +
                            (p.variationSeed || 0)
                        }
                        variant={finishBurstVariant}
                        mega
                        reduced={p.reduced}
                    />
                ) : null}
                {stepRewardVisible && stepFx > 0 && finishFx === 0 ? (
                    <div
                        ref={stepFeedbackRef}
                        key={`step-feedback-copy-${stepFx}`}
                        className={`globalFeedbackCopyLayer globalStepFeedbackCopy feedbackFlavor${((stepFx + p.game.id) % 6) + 1} feedbackFamily-${p.game.family.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}`}
                        style={{
                            ["--fx-x"]: `${stepRewardAnchor.x}%`,
                            ["--fx-y"]: `${stepRewardAnchor.y}%`,
                        }}
                        aria-live="polite"
                        aria-atomic="true"
                    >
                        <b>{dynamicStepFeedback.headline}</b>
                        <i className="tsRewardPayout">
                            {shiftReward.icon} +{lastSparkGain} · ×
                            {Math.max(1, rewardChain)}
                        </i>
                    </div>
                ) : null}
                {finishRewardVisible && finishFx > 0 ? (
                    <div
                        ref={finishFeedbackRef}
                        key={`finish-feedback-copy-${finishFx}`}
                        className={`globalFeedbackCopyLayer globalFinishFeedbackCopy feedbackFlavor${((finishFx + p.game.id) % 6) + 1} feedbackFamily-${p.game.family.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")}`}
                        style={{
                            ["--fx-x"]: `${finishRewardAnchor.x}%`,
                            ["--fx-y"]: `${finishRewardAnchor.y}%`,
                        }}
                        aria-live="polite"
                        aria-atomic="true"
                    >
                        <b>{dynamicFinishFeedback.headline}</b>
                        <span>{dynamicFinishFeedback.shift}</span>
                        <strong className="tsFinishRewardPayout">
                            ◆ +1 · {shiftReward.icon} +{lastFinishGain}
                        </strong>
                    </div>
                ) : null}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function InfinityField({ seed, reduced, stage }) {
    const count = reduced ? 8 : 18
    return (
        <div className={`infinityField infinity-${stage}`} aria-hidden="true">
            {Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
                const x = 4 + Math.round(noveltyNoise(i + 1, seed + 7) * 92)
                const y = 5 + Math.round(noveltyNoise(i + 11, seed + 13) * 86)
                const size = 2 + Math.round(noveltyNoise(i + 19, seed + 23) * 6)
                const dur = 8 + noveltyNoise(i + 29, seed + 31) * 9
                const delay = -noveltyNoise(i + 37, seed + 41) * dur
                return (
                    <i
                        key={`${seed}-${i}`}
                        style={{
                            left: `${x}%`,
                            top: `${y}%`,
                            width: `${size}px`,
                            height: `${size}px`,
                            animationDuration: `${dur}s`,
                            animationDelay: `${delay}s`,
                            ["--ix"]: `${Math.round((noveltyNoise(i + 47, seed + 53) - 0.5) * 42)}px`,
                            ["--iy"]: `${Math.round((noveltyNoise(i + 59, seed + 61) - 0.5) * 34)}px`,
                        }}
                    />
                )
            })}
        </div>
    )
}
function GameCard({ g, onPick, featured = false }) {
    return (
        <button
            className={"gameCard " + (featured ? "featured" : "")}
            onClick={() => onPick(g)}
        >
            <div className="gameIcon emotionGameIcon">
                <img
                    className="cardEmotionPic"
                    src={(() => {
                        const cardBubble = FAMILY_BUBBLE[g.family] || "drop"
                        const bank =
                            RELEASE_PHASE_EMOTIONS.negative[cardBubble] ||
                            RELEASE_PHASE_EMOTIONS.negative.drop
                        return emotionSrc(cardBubble, bank[g.id % bank.length])
                    })()}
                    draggable={false}
                    onError={(e) => {
                        e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"
                    }}
                />
                <span>{FAMILY_ICON[g.family] || "◇"}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="gameName">{g.name}</div>
            <div className="gameFamily">{familyLabel(g.family)}</div>
            <div className="gameAction">{shortAction(g)}</div>
            <span className="playTag">STILL A THOUGHT</span>
        </button>
    )
}

            GAMES.forEach((g, index) => {

                const hay = normaliseThought(
                    `${g.name} ${g.family} ${g.prompt} ${g.object} ${g.action} ${g.mechanism} ${g.hook} ${g.mindBend}`
                )
                let scoreForGame = 0
                tokens.forEach((token) => {
                    if (hay.includes(token)) scoreForGame += 1.1
                })
                ;(keywordBoost[g.id] || []).forEach((word) => {
                    if (q.includes(word)) scoreForGame += 4.25

                    contextGame?.family === "Release" &&
                    normaliseThought(g.mechanism).includes("distanc")
                )
                    scoreForGame += 2.75
                const recentGames = played
                    .slice(-6)
                    .map((id) => GAMES.find((item) => item.id === id))
                    .filter(Boolean)
                const familyAffinity = recentGames.filter(
                    (item) => item.family === g.family
                ).length
                scoreForGame += familyAffinity * 0.12
                if (contextGame && g.family !== contextGame.family)
                    scoreForGame += 0.18
                if (recent.has(g.id)) scoreForGame -= 1.2
                scoreForGame += (GAMES.length - index) * 0.0005
                if (!played.includes(g.id)) scoreForGame += 0.18
                if (scoreForGame > bestScore) {
                    bestScore = scoreForGame
                    best = g
                }
            })
            return best || GAMES[0]
        },

    }, [])
    const toggleMic = React.useCallback(() => {
        if (typeof window === "undefined") return
        const clearSpeechTimers = () => {
            if (speechRestartTimerRef.current) {
                clearTimeout(speechRestartTimerRef.current)
                speechRestartTimerRef.current = null
            }
            if (speechSilenceTimerRef.current) {
                clearTimeout(speechSilenceTimerRef.current)
                speechSilenceTimerRef.current = null
            }
        }
        const stopMicSession = (quiet = true) => {
            speechKeepListeningRef.current = false
            clearSpeechTimers()
            const active = speechRef.current
            speechRef.current = null
            try {
                active?.stop?.()
            } catch {}
            setListening(false)
            if (!quiet) showStatus("MIC STOPPED")
        }
        if (listening || speechKeepListeningRef.current) {
            stopMicSession(true)
            return
        }
        const SpeechCtor =
            window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition
        if (!SpeechCtor) {
            showStatus("VOICE INPUT ISN'T AVAILABLE IN THIS BROWSER")
            return
        }
        speechBaseTextRef.current = raw.trim()
        speechCommittedRef.current = ""
        speechCurrentSegmentRef.current = ""
        speechLastHeardAtRef.current = 0
        speechHasHeardWordsRef.current = false
        speechKeepListeningRef.current = true
        setListening(true)
        const normaliseSpeech = (value) =>
            String(value || "")
                .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                .trim()
        const mergeWithoutRepeatedOverlap = (left, right) => {
            const a = normaliseSpeech(left)
            const b = normaliseSpeech(right)
            if (!a) return b
            if (!b) return a
            const aw = a.split(" ")
            const bw = b.split(" ")
            const max = Math.min(12, aw.length, bw.length)
            let overlap = 0
            for (let n = max; n >= 1; n--) {
                const tail = aw.slice(-n).join(" ").toLowerCase()
                const head = bw.slice(0, n).join(" ").toLowerCase()
                if (tail === head) {
                    overlap = n
                    break
                }
            }
            return [...aw, ...bw.slice(overlap)].join(" ")
        }
        const renderMicText = (currentSegment = "") => {
            const micText = mergeWithoutRepeatedOverlap(
                speechCommittedRef.current,
                currentSegment
            )
            const nextText = [speechBaseTextRef.current, micText]
                .filter(Boolean)
                .join(" ")
                .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
                .trim()
                .slice(0, 2000)
            setRaw(nextText)
        }
        const SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS = 3000
        const INITIAL_WAIT_FOR_SPEECH_MS = 10000
        const armFinishTimer = (delay = SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS) => {
            if (speechSilenceTimerRef.current)
                clearTimeout(speechSilenceTimerRef.current)
            speechSilenceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
                if (!speechKeepListeningRef.current) return
                if (!speechHasHeardWordsRef.current) {
                    stopMicSession(true)
                    return
                }
                const quietFor = Date.now() - speechLastHeardAtRef.current
                if (quietFor >= SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS) {
                    stopMicSession(true)
                    return
                }
                armFinishTimer(Math.max(120, SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS - quietFor))
            }, delay)
        }
        const startRecognition = () => {
            if (!speechKeepListeningRef.current) return
            try {
                const recognition = new SpeechCtor()
                recognition.lang = "en-AU"
                recognition.continuous = true
                recognition.interimResults = true
                recognition.maxAlternatives = 1
                speechCurrentSegmentRef.current = ""
                recognition.onstart = () => {
                    if (speechKeepListeningRef.current) setListening(true)
                }
                recognition.onresult = (event) => {
                    if (!speechKeepListeningRef.current) return
                    const parts = []
                    for (let i = 0; i < event.results.length; i++) {
                        const piece = normaliseSpeech(
                            event.results[i]?.[0]?.transcript || ""
                        )
                        if (piece) parts.push(piece)
                    }
                    const segment = normaliseSpeech(parts.join(" "))
                    if (segment) {
                        speechHasHeardWordsRef.current = true
                        speechLastHeardAtRef.current = Date.now()
                    }
                    speechCurrentSegmentRef.current = segment
                    renderMicText(segment)
                    if (segment) armFinishTimer(SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS)
                }
                recognition.onend = () => {
                    if (speechRef.current === recognition)
                        speechRef.current = null
                    const segment = normaliseSpeech(
                        speechCurrentSegmentRef.current
                    )
                    if (segment) {
                        speechCommittedRef.current =
                            mergeWithoutRepeatedOverlap(
                                speechCommittedRef.current,
                                segment
                            )
                        speechCurrentSegmentRef.current = ""
                        renderMicText("")

                        const quietFor = speechHasHeardWordsRef.current
                            ? Date.now() - speechLastHeardAtRef.current
                            : 0
                        if (
                            speechHasHeardWordsRef.current &&
                            quietFor >= SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS
                        ) {
                            stopMicSession(true)
                        } else {
                            speechRestartTimerRef.current = setTimeout(
                                startRecognition,
                                180
                            )
                        }
                    } else {
                        setListening(false)
                    }
                }
                recognition.onerror = (event) => {
                    const code = String(event?.error || "")
                    if (
                        code === "not-allowed" ||
                        code === "service-not-allowed" ||
                        code === "audio-capture"
                    ) {
                        speechKeepListeningRef.current = false
                        clearSpeechTimers()
                        if (speechRef.current === recognition)
                            speechRef.current = null
                        setListening(false)
                        showStatus(
                            code === "audio-capture"
                                ? "MIC ISN'T AVAILABLE"
                                : "MIC PERMISSION IS NEEDED"
                        )
                        return
                    }
                    if (
                        code === "no-speech" &&
                        speechHasHeardWordsRef.current

                            Date.now() - speechLastHeardAtRef.current
                        if (quietFor >= SILENCE_TO_FINISH_MS) {
                            stopMicSession(true)
                            return
                        }
                    }
                }
                speechRef.current = recognition
                recognition.start()
            } catch {
                if (speechKeepListeningRef.current) {
                    speechRestartTimerRef.current = setTimeout(
                        startRecognition,
                        300
                    )
                } else {
                    setListening(false)
                }
            }
        }
        armFinishTimer(INITIAL_WAIT_FOR_SPEECH_MS)
        startRecognition()

                            try {
                                const added = (
                                    await Promise.all(
                                        allowed.map(fileToDataUrl)
                                    )
                                ).filter(Boolean)
                                const nextCount = Math.min(
                                    MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES,
                                    uploadedImages.length + added.length
                                )
                                setUploadedImages((current) =>
                                    [...current, ...added].slice(
                                        0,
                                        MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES
                                    )
                                )
                                // P6.2-a: files over the limit are never dropped silently; P6.1-e: the 6th image closes the popup
                                const dropped = Math.max(0, selectedFiles.length - files.length)
                                showStatus(
                                    dropped
                                        ? `MAX ${MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES} IMAGES · ${dropped} NOT ADDED`
                                        : `${nextCount} / ${MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES} IMAGES READY`,
                                    dropped ? 2600 : 1800
                                )
                                if (nextCount >= MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES) setUploadPopupOpen(false)
                                e.target.value = ""
                            } catch {
                                e.target.value = ""
                                showStatus("IMAGE COULDN'T BE MATERIALISED")
                            }
                        }}
                    />

                    <button
                        ref={uploadTriggerRef}
                        className={`releaseIconButton ${uploadedImages.length ? "active" : ""}`}
                        onClick={() => setUploadPopupOpen((v) => !v)}
                        title="Add up to 6 JPG, PNG or GIF images"
                        aria-label="Add images"
                        aria-haspopup="dialog"
                        aria-expanded={uploadPopupOpen}
                    >
                        ＋
                        {uploadedImages.length ? (
                            <span className="releaseUploadCount">
                                {uploadedImages.length}
                            </span>
                        ) : null}
                    </button>

                    {uploadPopupOpen ? (
                        <div
                            className="releaseUploadBackdrop"
                            role="presentation"
                            onPointerDown={() => setUploadPopupOpen(false)}
                        >
                            <div
                                ref={uploadPopupRef}
                                className="releaseUploadPopup"
                                role="dialog"
                                aria-modal="false"
                                aria-label="Attach images"
                                onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            >
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="releaseUploadClose"
                                    onClick={() => setUploadPopupOpen(false)}
                                    aria-label="Close image upload"
                                >
                                    ×
                                </button>
                                <div className="releaseUploadHeading">
                                    <strong>ATTACH IMAGES</strong>
                                    <span>
                                        {uploadedImages.length} /{" "}
                                        {MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES}
                                    </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="releaseUploadSlotGrid">
                                    {Array.from(
                                        { length: MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES },
                                        (_, index) => {
                                            const src = uploadedImages[index]
                                            return src ? (
                                                <div
                                                    className="releaseUploadSlot filled"
                                                    key={`upload-slot-${index}`}
                                                >
                                                    <img
                                                        src={src}
                                                        draggable={false}
                                                        alt={`Uploaded image ${index + 1}`}
                                                    />
                                                    <button
                                                        type="button"
                                                        className="releaseUploadRemove"
                                                        onClick={() =>
                                                            removeUploadedImage(
                                                                index
                                                            )
                                                        }
                                                        aria-label={`Remove uploaded image ${index + 1}`}
                                                    >
                                                        ×
                                                    </button>
                                                </div>
                                            ) : (
                                                <button
                                                    type="button"
                                                    className="releaseUploadSlot empty"
                                                    key={`upload-slot-${index}`}
                                                    onClick={chooseUploadFiles}
                                                    aria-label={`Add image ${index + 1}`}
                                                >
                                                    ＋
                                                </button>
                                            )
                                        }
                                    )}
                                </div>
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    className="releaseChooseFiles"
                                    onClick={chooseUploadFiles}
                                    disabled={
                                        uploadedImages.length >=
                                        MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES
                                    }
                                >
                                    {uploadedImages.length >= MAX_UPLOAD_IMAGES
                                        ? "6 IMAGES ATTACHED"
                                        : "CHOOSE FILE"}
                                </button>
                                <small className="releaseUploadHint">
                                    JPG, PNG or GIF · up to 6 images
                                </small>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ) : null}

                    {eosMenuOn /* F3: the game menu is owner-only ("Show game menu" property) */ ? (
                    <div className="releaseChoiceWrap" ref={gameMenuRef}>
                        <button
                            className={`releaseChoiceButton ${gameMenuOpen ? "open" : ""} ${releaseReadyToStart ? "ready" : ""}`}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                                if (releaseReadyToStart) {
                                    launchRelease()
                                    return
                                }
                                setGameMenuOpen((v) => !v)
                            }}
                            aria-haspopup="listbox"
                            aria-expanded={gameMenuOpen}
                            aria-label={
                                releaseReadyToStart
                                    ? "Start selected release. Use the arrow to change release."
                                    : "Choose a release game"
                            }
                        >
                            {gameChoice === "auto" ? (
                                <span
                                    className="releaseChoiceAutoIcon"
                                    aria-hidden="true"
                                >
                                    ✦
                                </span>
                            ) : selectedChoiceGame ? (
                                <img
                                    src={emotionSrc(
                                        FAMILY_BUBBLE[
                                            selectedChoiceGame.family
                                        ] || "drop",
                                        (FAMILY_EMOTIONS[
                                            selectedChoiceGame.family
                                        ] || FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release)[
                                            selectedChoiceGame.id % 4
                                        ]
                                    )}
                                    draggable={false}
                                    onError={(e) => {
                                        e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"
                                    }}
                                />
                            ) : (
                                <img
                                    src={emotionSrc(
                                        "drop",
                                        FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release[0]
                                    )}
                                    draggable={false}
                                    aria-hidden="true"
                                    onError={(e) => {
                                        e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"
                                    }}
                                />
                            )}
                            <span className="choiceCopy">
                                {gameChoice === "auto"
                                    ? "LET THINKSTILL CHOOSE"
                                    : selectedChoiceGame
                                      ? selectedChoiceGame.name
                                      : "CHOOSE TO RELEASE"}
                            </span>
                            <span
                                className="choiceArrow"
                                title="Change release"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation()
                                    setGameMenuOpen((v) => !v)
                                }}
                            >
                                ▾
                            </span>
                        </button>

                        {gameMenuOpen ? (
                            <div
                                className="releaseChoiceMenu"
                                role="listbox"
                                aria-label="Release games"
                            >
                                <button
                                    className={`releaseChoiceItem ${gameChoice === "auto" ? "active" : ""}`}
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={startThinkStillChoice}
                                >
                                    <span
                                        className="releaseChoiceAutoIcon"
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                    >
                                        ✦
                                    </span>
                                    <span>
                                        <b>LET THINKSTILL CHOOSE</b>
                                    </span>
                                </button>
                                <EosMenuGroup played={played} gameChoice={gameChoice} onPick={startChosenGame} />
                                <div className="releaseChoiceGroupLabel">
                                    15 SIGNATURE RELEASES
                                </div>
                                {signatureQuickPlay.map((g) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={`core-${g.id}`}
                                        className={`releaseChoiceItem ${gameChoice === String(g.id) ? "active" : ""}`}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => startChosenGame(g)}
                                    >
                                        <img
                                            src={emotionSrc(
                                                FAMILY_BUBBLE[g.family] ||
                                                    "drop",
                                                (FAMILY_EMOTIONS[g.family] ||
                                                    FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release)[
                                                    g.id % 4
                                                ]
                                            )}
                                            draggable={false}
                                            onError={(e) => {
                                                e.currentTarget.style.display =
                                                    "none"
                                            }}
                                        />
                                        <span>
                                            <b>{g.name}</b>
                                        </span>
                                    </button>
                                ))}

                                <div className="releaseChoiceGroupLabel">
                                    MORE RELEASES ·{" "}
                                    {GAMES.length - signatureQuickPlay.length}
                                </div>
                                {GAMES.filter(
                                    (g) => !SIGNATURE_QUICK_PLAY.includes(g.id)
                                ).map((g) => (
                                    <button
                                        key={`all-${g.id}`}
                                        className={`releaseChoiceItem ${gameChoice === String(g.id) ? "active" : ""}`}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => startChosenGame(g)}
                                    >
                                        <img
                                            src={emotionSrc(
                                                FAMILY_BUBBLE[g.family] ||
                                                    "drop",
                                                (FAMILY_EMOTIONS[g.family] ||
                                                    FAMILY_EMOTIONS.Release)[
                                                    g.id % 4
                                                ]
                                            )}
                                            draggable={false}
                                            onError={(e) => {
                                                e.currentTarget.style.display =
                                                    "none"
                                            }}
                                        />
                                        <span>
                                            <b>{g.name}</b>
                                        </span>
                                    </button>
                                ))}
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                    </div>
                    ) : (
                        <EosPickGoButton
                            ready={stage === "input" && (!!raw.trim() || uploadedImages.length > 0)}
                            next={stage !== "input" && !!selected}
                            onGo={stage !== "input" && selected ? tryRecommendedRelease : launchRelease}
                        />
                    )}

                    {statusText ? (
                        <div className="releaseComposerStatus">
                            {statusText}
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
function useArcadeCss() {
    const [cssText, setCssText] = React.useState("")
    React.useEffect(() => {
        let alive = true
        ;(async () => {
            try {
                const bin = atob(CSS_GZIP_B64)
                const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length)
                for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++)
                    bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i)
                const DS = window.DecompressionStream
                if (!DS)
                    throw new Error(
                        "This browser does not support DecompressionStream"
                    )
                const stream = new Blob([bytes])
                    .stream()
                    .pipeThrough(new DS("gzip"))
                const unpacked = await new Response(stream).text()
                if (alive) setCssText(unpacked)
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(
                    "ThinkStill Release Arcade CSS could not initialise",
                    err
                )
            }
        })()
        return () => {
            alive = false
        }
    }, [])
    return cssText
}

// ===== src/eos/00_eos_core.jsx =====
// ===================================================================================
// EOS · 00 CORE — the FROZEN shared contract for every src/eos/*.jsx module.
// Spec: docs/EOS_SPEC.md §0 (contract) + §12 (build plan). Owned by the lead / foundation.
// Module and game tasks must NOT edit this file; if you need a change, say so in your report.
// Rules for every eos module:
//   * no import lines and no `export` lines (one shared file scope with 00_arcade.jsx, evaluated after it);
//   * every new top-level identifier starts with your task namespace: Eos<Task> / EOS_<TASK>_ / eos<Task>
//     (core owns the bare Eos / EOS_ / eos names below); keyframes are eos<Task><Name>; eosCss key = task id;
//   * never touch PX_B / pxNoise / PIXAR_CSS / PX_SQUASH_TARGETS at module top level
//     (99_pixar.jsx is evaluated AFTER src/eos/*, so its consts are in TDZ here);
//   * no window/document/localStorage access at module top level without a guard;
//   * never store anything the user typed (only emotion ids, numbers, game ids);
//   * never use regex lookbehind assertions: a parse-time SyntaxError on iOS Safari < 16.4 kills all 110 games
//     (build.py rejects them).
// Calling another eos module: use eosApi("name").fn?.(...) or `typeof EosFoo === "function"`
// so isolated builds (only core + your files) never throw a ReferenceError.
// v1.2.0: critique fixes (docs/EOS_SPEC.md §13): per-emotion dial/flip/grade/dial words, wider lexicon,
// safety lexicon + scan + neutral words in core, breath/beat pacer clock, calm haptics, dial digit buffer,
// dev-only window.__eos, a11y/arena/safe-area CSS, retro + keepHistory session rows, win-face pool.
// v1.2.1 (foundation, FROZEN from here on for module builders):
//   * `.eosArena button` starts as a clean shell — the arcade skins EVERY `.arena button` with !important
//     (neon gradient, border, glow, text-shadow, a 180 ms transform transition that lags framer-motion);
//     see the CSS comment at EOS_CORE_CSS for how a game styles its own buttons;
//   * EosCharacterOrb carries data-eos-emotion / data-eos-char (stable test + CSS hooks);
//   * useEosProgress(rootRef) — one shared, self-cleaning 4 Hz progress poll for overlays (mood, companion, …);
//   * eosRegisterGame warns (dev only) about missing GAMES fields, duplicate ids/names, a bad gesture, ids < 111;
//   * EosEnginePreview: `seed` prop + live §8.0 engine-contract checks on window.__eosPreview.checks
//     (dev/eos_preview.* sets emotion / before / safety / calm from URL params before the first render);
//   * eosDayPart() / eosLateNight(): one local-time rule for games (dawn/day/dusk/night palettes), mood, router;
//   * window.__eos.core exposes every transition and table the test harness (dev/eos_drive.mjs) reads.
// ===================================================================================

const EOS_VERSION = "1.2.1"

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- dev gate (privacy, §0.1)
// window.__eos / __eosPreview / __eosArrowMiss exist ONLY in dev (file://, localhost, ?eosdev=1),
// so analytics / session-replay scripts on a published Framer site can never read the emotional state.
function eosIsDev() {
    try {
        if (typeof location === "undefined") return false
        return location.protocol === "file:" || /^(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)$/.test(location.hostname) || /[?&]eosdev=1\b/.test(location.search)
    } catch {
        return false
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- storage (eos_*)
const EOS_KEYS = {
    sessions: "eos_sessions_v1", // [{t, emo, before, after, gameId, ms, act, retro}]  (cap 300, never user text)
    orbs: "eos_orbs_v1", //         [{t, emo, char, face, tier, before, after, gameId}]   (rewards module)
    days: "eos_days_v1", //         ["2026-10-06", …] local days with ≥1 finished game (cap 400)
    learned: "eos_learned_v1", //   {gameId: completions} — arrows go quiet for veterans
    bonds: "eos_bonds_v1", //       {sync: 3, rush: 1, …} loops each character appeared in (rewards module)
    prefs: "eos_prefs_v1", //       see EOS_PREF_DEFAULTS
    pending: "eos_pending_v1", //   reserved
}
const EOS_PREF_DEFAULTS = {
    shareWords: false, //  the share card never shows typed words (no UI to turn on in this build)
    enrich: true, //       EosEntries pads short inputs with the emotion's seed phrases
    keepHistory: true, //  false → no session / orb rows are written (shelf toggle, §9.3)
    calmVisuals: false, // "◐ calm visuals": every EOS surface behaves as reduced motion (§5.2, §6.2)
    dust: "default", //    cosmetic Thought-Dust style unlocked by ⚡ milestones (§9.2)
    namedOnce: false, //   first-use micro-copy shown
    metOnce: false, //     "Meet RUSH, your anger." intro shown
    micNoted: false, //    "Voice typing uses your browser's speech service." shown
    coldOpen: false, //    first-run STILL intro shown
    speak: false, //       116 SQUEAKY THOUGHT may speak (local voices only)
}
function eosGet(key, fallback) {
    try {
        if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return fallback
        const v = localStorage.getItem(key)
        return v == null ? fallback : JSON.parse(v)
    } catch {
        return fallback
    }
}
function eosSet(key, value) {
    try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value))
    } catch {}
}
function eosToday(d = new Date()) {
    const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0")
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`
}
function eosSessions() {
    const v = eosGet(EOS_KEYS.sessions, [])
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v : []
}
function eosDays() {
    const v = eosGet(EOS_KEYS.days, [])
    return Array.isArray(v) ? v : []
}
function eosMarkDay() {
    const day = eosToday()
    const days = eosDays()
    if (!days.includes(day)) eosSet(EOS_KEYS.days, days.concat([day]).slice(-400))
}
// Prefs are read on every cleanEntries call (many per render) → cached in memory.
let eosPrefsCache = null
function eosPrefs() {
    if (eosPrefsCache) return eosPrefsCache
    const v = eosGet(EOS_KEYS.prefs, {})
    eosPrefsCache = { ...EOS_PREF_DEFAULTS, ...(v && typeof v === "object" ? v : {}) }
    return eosPrefsCache
}
function eosSetPref(key, value) {
    const next = { ...eosPrefs(), [key]: value }
    eosPrefsCache = next
    eosSet(EOS_KEYS.prefs, next)
    if (key === "calmVisuals") EOS_STORE.set({ calmVisuals: !!value })
    return next
}
function eosPushSession(rec) {
    // rec = {emo, before, after, gameId, ms, act, retro}; t is added here. NEVER pass user text.
    const clean = {
        t: Date.now(),
        emo: String(rec?.emo || "general").slice(0, 24),
        before: Number.isFinite(+rec?.before) && rec?.before !== null ? +rec.before : null,
        after: Number.isFinite(+rec?.after) && rec?.after !== null ? +rec.after : null,
        gameId: Number(rec?.gameId) || 0,
        ms: Math.max(0, Math.round(+rec?.ms || 0)),
        act: Number(rec?.act) || 1,
        retro: rec?.retro ? 1 : 0, // 1 = "before" was given AFTER the game (recall-biased; excluded from learning)
    }
    if (eosPrefs().keepHistory !== false) eosSet(EOS_KEYS.sessions, eosSessions().concat([clean]).slice(-300))
    eosMarkDay()
    return clean
}
function eosLearnedCount(gameId) {
    const v = eosGet(EOS_KEYS.learned, {})
    return (v && Number(v[Number(gameId)])) || 0
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- CSS registry
// Every module registers its CSS once at top level: eosCss("arrows", EOS_ARROWS_CSS).
// <EosGlobalStyle/> (mounted once by integration step I1) renders all parts in insertion order
// (= file order). Re-registering a name replaces it (safe for hot reload). Key = your task id.
const EOS_CSS_PARTS = new Map()
function eosCss(name, css) {
    EOS_CSS_PARTS.set(String(name), String(css || ""))
    return css
}
function EosGlobalStyle() {
    const css = Array.from(EOS_CSS_PARTS.values()).join("\n")
    return <style data-eos="global">{css}</style>
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- API registry / dev handle
// eosExpose("router", {EosRouteGame, …}) publishes a module API; eosApi("router") returns it
// (or {} when that module is not in this build). Tests read window.__eos.<name> (dev only).
const EOS_DEV = { version: EOS_VERSION }
function eosExpose(name, api) {
    EOS_DEV[name] = { ...(EOS_DEV[name] || {}), ...(api || {}) }
    try {
        if (typeof window !== "undefined" && eosIsDev()) window.__eos = EOS_DEV
    } catch {}
    return api
}
function eosApi(name) {
    return EOS_DEV[name] || {}
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- emotions (12 states)
// char/loud/calm → emotionSrc(char, mood) (faces verified HTTP 200 on raw.githubusercontent).
// profile → id in RELEASE_INPUT_EMOTION_PROFILES (or "general"); drives arcade copy/spark names.
// starter → written into the composer only when the user gives no words (editable).
// seeds → short phrases used to pad short inputs instead of repeating "I / am / I".
//   RULE (§2): starters and seeds are sensations, situations or feeling names — never beliefs,
//   blame, catastrophic predictions or self-judgements (they become big on-screen game words).
// better → "down": lower intensity is relief (default); "up": higher is better (GOOD = savour).
// moment → the reveal's Still Moment flavour: "sigh" (down-regulate), "heart" (soothe), "spark" (up).
// dial → check-in dial pre-light (§6.2); detection intensity floor = dial - 1 (no softener words).
// dialQ → [before question, after question]; {char} / {noun} are filled in by eosDialQuestion.
// dialWords → 5 anchors over 0-10 (EOS_DIAL_ANCHOR) for low-arousal states; else the loudness words.
// flip → 3 positive words that rise out of the Still Point bloom at the finish (§5.2/§6.8).
// grade → colour script: loud pair → calm pair (EosMoodGrade, share card, Still Point hue).
const EOS_EMOTIONS = [
    { id: "panic", label: "PANIC", noun: "panic", sub: "heart racing", char: "sync", loud: 44, calm: 90, hue: 195, meter: "SLOW-DOWN", spark: "CALM", profile: "panic", primary: true, moment: "sigh", better: "down", dial: 8,
      flip: ["safe", "slow", "right here"], grade: { loud: ["#3b1e6e", "#6a2c91"], calm: ["#ffcf7a", "#ff9f6b"] },
      starter: "panic racing heart tight chest too fast right now",
      seeds: ["racing heart", "tight chest", "too fast", "shaky", "what if", "right now"] },
    { id: "anger", label: "ANGRY", noun: "anger", sub: "frustrated · boiling", char: "rush", loud: 29, calm: 44, hue: 355, meter: "COOL-DOWN", spark: "COOL", profile: "anger", primary: true, moment: "sigh", better: "down", dial: 8,
      flip: ["cool", "clear", "strong"], grade: { loud: ["#d7263d", "#ff7a1a"], calm: ["#2ec4b6", "#4fd1e8"] },
